text.body:
oṃ namaḥ śrīdevyai
himavacchikhare ramye surāsuraniṣevite | tatra sthāne sukhāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram ||
surāsurendranamite siddhagaṃdharvapūjite | kṛtāṃjalipūṭā devī idaṃ vacanamavravīt ||
śrīdevyuvāca
sarvaśrotodbhavaṃ jñānaṃ tvatprasādātmayā śrutam | kā vidyā sākinīnāntu daityānāṃ gatināśinī ||
saṃsiddhāyā yuge ghore sarvasaṃśayabhedinī |
śrībhairava uvāca
pūrvaṃ gaurimahāghore śmaśāne karavīrake ||
ārādhito'haṃ devībhiryāge saṃpūjanāya ca | tvāṃ cārusaṃsthāṃ kṛtvā tu pātastatravarānane ||
catuḥṣaṣṭhistu yā koṭyā sākinyādyā mahābalāḥ | yajñabhāgaṃ prayacchanti caruṃ kṛtvāsvabāṃdhavān ||
bhujāmitamahaṃ bhadre krīḍāmi carayāmi ca | yāvadanyatra divase tāvaccāti madotkaṭāḥ ||
caruṃ prayacchabhagavan paripāṭyā samāsataḥ | mayoktaṃ nāsti me kiṃcit kapālī haṃ digambaraḥ ||
śmaśānavāsī satataṃ nāsti me bāṃdhavaḥ kvacit | vihasyatābhiruktaṃ vai asti te tripurāntake ||
kulācārānalupyante vayaṃ tu tava kiṃkarīḥ | tadvayaṃ paribhokṣyāmi dehino varamuttamam ||
mayoktameva tāsāntu gṛhnīdhvamaviśaṅkitāḥ | gṛhītacarukaṃ bhāgaṃ yasyāmi śira uttamam ||
tvadīya vadanākrānta taddṛṣṭvā tu vimohitaṃ | muhyamānamatibhraṃsaṃ tiṣṭhāmikaravīrake ||
praskhalan ḍāmarībhūto hā priyahā priyeti ca | ūrūpaśyāmi tacchūnyaṃ tadāhaṃ mohamāgataḥ ||
evamuḍḍāmarībhūto vismṛtāmasvakāṃ tanuḥ | tatra kāla mahādevi sākinībhirmahābalāt ||
bhakṣitāmṛtamādāya tatasvābhistyayaṃ sati | tasmin niśceṣṭabhāvasthaḥ tadvittomantramutthitaḥ ||
paraṃ samādhimāśritya cetastatra samāśritam | hṛdayādutthitā devī jagadānandakāriṇī ||
prasuptabhujagākārā spandanānandasaṃyutā | akalā madhyabhāgā tu kālāgni sadṛśaprabhā ||
kālasaṃkarṣaṇī khyātā cakre kālāgnibhairavī | ādhārabhūtā jīvaso(?) sthitā sā paramākalā ||
vyāpinī sarvabhūtānāmekāsānekatā gatā | ekā parāparāśakti viśvagrāsaikalaṃpaṭā ||
pūrṇimā pūritā jñeyā racitā sātvamāsmṛtā | sāntyā parāparā sāntā śūnyātītā niraṃjanā ||
mahātejomayī lakṣmī raśmikoṭyā yutopamā | nirmalāniṣkalā devi sakalāsthūlavigrahā ||
paṃcavaktrā daśabhūjā tripaṃcanayanairyutā | śvetavarṇā mahādevī mahāpreto paristhitā ||
mātrāṣṭakasya madhyasthā siddhiyogini pūjitā | saumyogra japabhāvena sādhakecchāsamāsṛtā ||
dāritāsyā lelihānāṃ jvālāpluṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ jagat | ucchvāsocchvāsayogena cālayet kulaparvatān ||
kvaciddhvaṃse kvacit kūpyet kvacit saṃharate prajāḥ | kvacit sṛjet kvacit pālye svatantrecchāpravartate ||
goṇāsā bharaṇairyuktā uragendravibhūṣitā | pāśāṅkuśadharādevī varadābhayapāṇikā ||
savyahaste dhṛtaṃ khaḍgaṃ trailokya kṣobhakārakam | vāme khaṭvāṅgamatyugraṃ dakṣiṇe śūlamuttamam ||
apare kandaraṃ raudraṃ trailokyakṣatajānvitam | tathānye sa sthitaṃ muṇḍaṃ sa keśaṃ śoṇitāṃnvitam ||
vāme tu kalaśaṃ divyaṃ mahāratnaiḥ prapūritam | eṣā pratyaṃgirā khyātā utpannā vyomadehagā ||
ekāsāneka bhedena viśvaṃ vyāpyavyavasthitā | devī tuṣṭamanā sarva sruvanti parayāgirā ||
ḍāmaraṃ hi mahāyāgaṃ tadarthaṃ hi suraiḥ kṛtaṃ | tasyā bhedaṃ prabhedena koṭisaṃkhyātanaṃdini ||
pratyaṅgirātviyaṃ devi siddhilakṣmī jayadrathe | jhaṃkāra bhairava caṇḍā śivāntu kulaḍāmare ||
śrīdevyuvāca
bhagavandeva deveśa śaśāṅkakṛta śekhare | dhyānaṃ yathārthadhyātavyaṃ tvat prasādānmayā prabho ||
adhunā śrotumicchāmi mantraśaucāraṇaṃ paraṃ |
bhairava uvāca
mantraṃ tu hṛdgataṃ bhadre ahaṃ jānāmi tatvataḥ ||
kathayāmi na saṃdehastvayā ca prerito yadā | bhūpradeśe same śuddhe kuṃkumodakalepite ||
mātṛkāṃ prastaret tatra mantrānāṃ jananī parā | adṛṣṭavigrahā cchāntā cchivātparamakāraṇāt ||
utpannā tu parāśaktiradehādeharūpiṇī | tatrotpannā golakākhyaṃ tārārūpaṃ cidātmakam ||
tajjātadhvanirūpeṇa dhvanibindutvamāgataḥ | bindornādasya cotpatti rasvarasya sureśvari ||
tato svarānnusubhage prasūtāmātṛkā śubhā | kūṭayuktā varārohe paṃcaśadbhedavarṇagā ||
yā sā parāparāsūkṣmā prāṇasyāntargatā śivā | sā yoni sarvamantrāṇāṃ kalā saptadaśī parā ||
parākāśa samudbhūtā icchāśaktivarānane | bindukrama jñānaśaktiḥ kriyārtho yā nigadyate ||
sūryarūpaṃ tataḥ prāṇo hyapāṇaḥ śaśi sobhane | samāno varuṇo jñeyo rudānaḥ pāvakaḥ punaḥ ||
māyā sarvāṅgasandhīnāṃ nibaṃdho vyāna ucyate | dvicatuṣkaprakāreṇa udītaḥ piṇḍanāyakaḥ ||
carācarasya jagataḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ | pūrakaṃ ca tataḥ paścādastrayuktaṃ varānane ||
antakapunaruddhṛtya śūnyamādyantayojitam | paṃcamaṃ ca tṛtīyādyaṃ santāntaṃ tu samuddharet ||
graṃthīśvarasamāyuktaṃ dantavarṇagaṇāmvike | sarvagaṃnavamayuktaṃ uduruccharabhūṣitam ||
antyādyameghasahitaṃ rikterādyaṃ tataḥ priye | ādyantapadamarttante dantajīvayutaṃ dadet ||
vedayuktaṃ binduyutaṃ śivavaktraṃ niyojayet | asyādyantantu saṃyojya astrarājamahābalam ||
vedapīyūṣavahnisthaṃ paṃcabindusabindukam | astrarājaṃ yathoktaṃ syāt krameṇasurasuṃdari ||
etat kramadvayaṃ cānya rephaṃ madhyagataṃ nyaset | saptādaśākṣarā yojya sthītāstvīdrāvikā priye ||
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi mālāmantrasuśobhane | oṃ paṃttaṃgirisamuddhṛtya mahārājā tataḥ param ||
mahāśaṃkhaṃ tato yojya diḍaṣāṇe tathaiva ca | haḍḍamaḍḍo tato yojyamabaleti tataḥ param ||
jñāmahikara idadṛkarāva ipadaṃ punaḥ | vidi āva iva tathā attha hatthi padaṃ punaḥ ||
parahatthi sā ihatthijñā giti ci tathaiva ca | pare ca karmaṇe yogyātā hi pattiṃ giriṃ puma ||
nivajri ca tathā matthi ādyanta puṭitā priye | na ca tyekonarahitā yoginīnāṃ mukhe sthitā ||
aśarīrā parācādyā śrutvā padmodbhavesati | etadvidyā prabhāvena sampannāsmijagajjayī ||
āsītpūrvate moghoraṃ carācaravivarjitam | satvamāyāguṇātītaṃ karaṇena samanvitaḥ ||
īdṛśe vajagajjāte icchāśaktiḥ śivasya ca | tanmātradyotayogena svayajñānī prayacchati ||
kriyā ca sṛjate viśvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yadbhaviṣyati | tayā vimalarūpeṇa nirmitantu sadāśivam ||
nādarūpaṃ śivaḥ sākṣādabhedābhedavarjitam | muñcantu te sadānādaṃ bahusthaṃ tripadānvitam ||
eṣa śabdātmakaṃ sohi akṣayaḥ parameśvaraḥ | sarvavyāpi prabhuḥ sohi yenāsau pajanakṣamaḥ ||
asyāpi īśvare jātaḥ śabdasparśaguṇānvitaḥ | sopi kartā śivaḥ śāntā sarvakāryaguṇānvitaḥ ||
ahaṃ tatra samutpanne stritatvaparimaṇḍitaḥ | sṛṣṭisaṃhārakartā ca parecchā hi vyavasthitaḥ ||
mayāpinirmito viṣṇuścaturguṇasamanvitaḥ | pālayan vai jagatsarvaṃ saṃsāre śaraṇātmake ||
tasyanābhigataṃ nālaṃ samutpaṃsukomalam | tatra brahmāsamutpannaḥ paṃcatatvaṃ kṛtātmakaḥ ||
brahmaviṣṇurato yuddhaṃ saṃjātaḥ sṛṣṭikāraṇam | ahaṃ kartābhavedbrahmā viṣṇuravepunastathā ||
śiracchedakṛtastasya mayākruddhena pārvati | sopi kruddho mahādevi dṛṣṭvāviṣṇusamopari ||
mahākrodhānvito brahmā raktavarṇo vibhīṣaṇaḥ | tairevotyāditāḥ puṃsaḥ surūpāstatparākramāḥ ||
abhedyakavacāḥ sarva visvākṛtimahābalāḥ | prāṇaṃ haṃsarathārūḍhā koṭikoṭyāyutāḥ priye ||
prārthayanti mahāyuddhaṃ daṇḍaṃ saṃgṛhyaveṣṭitam | nirmitāstu tadāsarva satyaṃ suragaṇārcite ||
adhunā saṃpravakṣyāmi mālāmantraṃ yathārthataḥ | somārkānalasaṃhāra madhye vyomasamālikhet ||
tṛdhāmalāṃcchitaṃ kṛtvā viṃdvendusamayojhritam | saṃhāravarṇāścaivādho raudrīdevīniyojayet ||
etat piṇḍākṣaraṃ caiva yoginī śrutimaṇḍalam | puruṣe nādhikārosti satyaṃ satyaṃ gaṇāmbike ||
eṣākuṇḍalinīkhyātā prāṇāpānapravāhinī | anacchavadanāttasthā paṃcasthānavyavasthitā ||
natiṃ niyojayet paścāt mantrāṇāṃ dīpanāya ca | sarvasiddhaṃ tato yojya yoginībhyānatiṃ punaḥ ||
sarvasiddhipadaṃ paścātmātṛbhyaḥ padameva ca | namo nityoditānanda naṃditāyai padantathā ||
sakalakulacakreti nāyikāyaipadaṃ tathā | bhagavatyai caṇḍapadaṃ kāpālinyai padantathā ||
tadyathā mātṛkhaṇḍaṃ tu mantrakhaṇḍamathocyate | ādyā vidyādyantayugaṃ māyāntena samanvitam ||
biṃdvendu yojitaṃ kṛtvā prathamaṃ bījanāyakam | sarvādya vidyāsuśroṇi ūrddhādhogrāhayet tataḥ ||
śivabījena sahitaṃ ekatra ca samuddharet | śūnyaṃ śūnyaṃ samāyuktamūrddhādhasyoparisthitam ||
ādyāntāntatamuddhṛtya kuharaṃ mantakonvitaḥ | amāniyojayedbhadre saptapātālabhedakam ||
bhuvanādhipatiṃ gṛhyaṃ śūnyāyenasamanvitam | tadantayojitaṃ kṛtvā varṇarājaṃ mahābalam ||
te biṃdukāmamuddhṛtya tṛtīyāsanasasthitam | namoniyojaye dante mahāmantreṇasaṃyutam ||
paramahaṃsinipadaṃ tathānirvāṇamārgade | viṣamopaplavapadaṃ praśamanipadantathā ||
sakaladuritāriṣṭa kleśadalanipadaṃ tathā | tathā sarvāpadapadaṃ aṃbhodhitaraṇintathā ||
sakalaśatrupramathani devi āgacchayugmakam | hasayugmaṃ valgatathā nararudhirāntrameva ca ||
vasā ca bhakṣaṇipadaṃ mamadevi padaṃ tathā | svaśatruśca padaṃ paścāt mardamardapadantathā ||
khāhikhāhi padaṃ caiva triśūlena padantathā | bhiṃdibhiṃdi dvidhābhadre khaḍgena ca padaṃ punaḥ ||
tāḍayeti dvidhāyojya cchedayeti punastathā | yāvat tāvat padaṃ paścān mamaśabdaṃ tato dadet ||
sakalaṃ ca padaṃ paścāt tathānyaṃ ca manorathān | sādhayeti dvidhāyojya tathā parama eva ca ||
kāruṇiketi ca padaṃ tathā bhagavatīti ca | mahābhairavarūpaṃ ca padadhārinimeva ca ||
tridaśavaraprade ca namite ca samāyutam | tathā sakalaśabdaṃ ca mantramāte padaṃ tathā ||
praṇatajanaśabdaṃ ca vatsalatisamāyutam | deviśabdaṃ tato deyaṃ mahākālipadantathā ||
kālanāsaniśabdaṃ ca anyaṃ ca kathayāmite | paṃcamantrasamuddhṛtya paṃcamaṃ tasya copari ||
paṃcamanasamāyukta etadvarṇatridhākuru | prasīdapada deveśi madanāturasaṃjñakam ||
binduyuktaṃ tathākāraṃ kārayet parameśvari | kuruśabdadvidhāyojya surāsurapadaṃ tathā ||
kanyakāyapadaṃ bhūyo golakenasamāyutam | aṣṭamantrasamuddhṛtya vilomaparameśvari ||
tataḥ śrīkaṇṭhanāthantu biṃdvākhyaṃ kārayet priye | tṛtīye tu maheśāni tṛtīyākṣarabhūṣitam ||
asyā vidyā dvitīyantu jīvahīnaṃ mṛgekṣaṇe | tridhāniyojayedante vahnibhāryāsamanvitam ||
tṛtīyakhaṇḍastu kathitaṃ varṇānāntu śatadvayam | navatyadhika deveśi uddhṛtaṃ śambhunāpurā ||
sāṃgopāṅgā sa vaktrā ca nānyeṣāṃ vidyate bhuvi | ādau tu vaktravinyāsaṃ tridhānavasutaḥ param ||
hṛdayādi tṛtīyaṃ tu āyudhaiḥ śeṣakalpanā | anyaṃ cāṣṭākṣarāvidyā vilomavinyaset priye ||
asmintantravare siddhā nānyatantra kadācana | varṇā utkīlitāhyasyāṃ bhavat prītyā varānane ||
anayā vidyayā gauri janmamṛtyubhayāvahe | jantavāvividhākārā bhaktihīnā gurudviṣaḥ ||
svayaṃ gṛhītaliṅgāntu svayaṃ mantra pratiṣṭhitā | adhikāraṃ prakurvanti gurorājñāṃ vinā priye ||
tathā pratyaṃgirā devī kilitā tu jayadrathe | gurormukhāt samuddiṣṭā śubhāvāya divā śubhā ||
tadā sā siddhyate kṣipraṃ iti satyaṃ gaṇāmbike |
[iti śrītridaśaḍāmare mahātantre catuḥtriṃśatisāhasre śrīpratyaṃgirātpattimūlamantroddhāravidhiṃ ekāśītitamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || (1) ||
śrīdevyuvāca
mantroddhāraviśeṣeṇa varṇitantu samāsataḥ | adhunāśrotumicchāmi devyā yāgamaheśvara ||
śrībhairava uvāca
rakṣāṃsi bhūtānyuktāni rephāścākhilanāḍayaḥ | dvārasobhāpaśobhāśca karaṇaindriyavṛttiyaḥ ||
cittaṃ vīthībhaveddevyā hakāraṃ caiva pīṭhikā | icchākriyātmikāliṅgā pīṭhikā sahasaṅgatiḥ ||
mandamaṣṭacchadabuddhi cāmaśaktiṣaḍasrakam | tadā tu vyaktistambhinnaṃ gajājīvastu kīrtitaḥ ||
adhisthānanirālambaṃ atrāso parameśvarī | tasya saṃdarśanād devi yātyanavahujātmajām ||
ajñānakṣayamatyatimantraḥ sānnidhyakāraṇāt | yajanaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi siddhiṃ yenāśu jāyate ||
prathame haniṣaṣṭyāṃ vāmāvāsyātha caturddaśī | nityaṃ sannihitā devī siddhidāmokṣadāsmṛtā ||
guruṃ vināhyasamaye yo vidyāṃ grāhayet priye | sapacyata mahāghore narakaṃ tyati saṃkaṭe ||
dātāro narakaṃ yānti vidyāsamayapūjanāt | anyathā na bhavet siddhi janmakoṭi śatairapi ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena yāgaṃ kṛtvā pradarśayet | catuḥkoṇapurākṛtvā caturdvāropaśobhitam ||
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vinyasenmadhye bahiḥ patrāṣṭakaṃ tathā | tadbahiḥ ṣoḍaśādhāramālikhet kamalaṃ śubham ||
rajasāśvetavarṇena raṃjayat susumāhitaḥ | śuddhe vasumatī dehe subhage tu manorame ||
hṛtsthāne vātu yaṣṭavyā pūrvoktena yaje cchubhe | eṣā pratyaṃgirābhadre ciccandragatinirmale ||
hṛtpadmodaramadhyasthā suśūkṣmāmṛtarūpiṇī | nādamātā vāyusakhā nityānityapadānugā ||
tato mṛtamayī devī bindunādāntare sthitā | dahanārkendumadhyasthā jagataḥ sṛṣṭikāriṇī ||
yogeśvarī yogaparā bhavabhakṣabhayaṃkarī | āpadādyogamarmāntaṃ vyāpyaṃ viśvavyavasthitā ||
caturddaśavidhehyasmin sṛṣṭisaṃsthitikāriṇī | ajñātān dharmajananī jñātāmokṣapradāyinī ||
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi ihāmutraphalapradā | dhyānaṃ maṇḍalavinyāsa parivārāṅgaṣaṭkakam ||
yena siddhirbhavatyāśu sādhakānāṃ gaṇāmbike | prāgukte tu śucaudeśe duṣṭasatvavivarjite ||
prasannavadano bhūtvā ācāryasusamāhitaḥ | sarvabhūtadayāluṃśca jñānavijñanapāragaḥ ||
tāmbūlapūritamukhot maṃdirānandamanditaḥ | prahṛṣṭaśaktisannaddhaḥ saṃnyāsakṛtavigrahaḥ ||
vāmabhāge gatā śaktī devatārādhanaratā | surūpāmṛtabhāṣī ca sādhakājñānakāriṇī ||
salajjākrodhanirmuktā lobhamohavivarjitā | anyathā vighnabhāgīsyā cchidranta ghorayātanā ||
suprasanne gṛhavare sudhūpāmodasaṃkule | puṣpaprakarasaṃyukte palālipuripūrite ||
prasannavadanobhūtvā dikṣunyāsaṃ prakalpayet | āgneyāṃ hṛdayaṃ nyasya śira īśānagocare ||
nair(-)ṛtyāṃ ca śikhāmantrī vāyavyāṃ kavacaṃ nyaset | netraṃ pūrvadalāgre tu paścime'stu mato nyaset ||
sarvajñatādibhirdevyā jñeyā vidyākṣaraiḥ saha | gokarṇāmajakarṇā ca ajā ākhumukhī tathā ||
paścimanāstrayuktena kādyakhaḍgāgrato yajet | śrīkaṇṭhādikrameṇaiva ājñāgrāhaṇapūrvakam ||
adyādirakṣarevādau sūjayepādayogataḥ | gaṇeśakṣetrapālaṃ ca vidhinānena pūjayet ||
kaṃcakasya jayenādhye sādākhyaṃ pratanāyakam | dvitīyā prathamoddhṛtya mantrenānena pūjayet ||
tat pṛṣṭhacintayed devīṃ svajapadhyānasaṃyutam | nānākārāmahādevī vāmādīnāmagocarām ||
dikkālādyānavacchinnāmavasthaṃ ci prakāśikā | saptādaśīhyavasthā yā parānandasurūpiṇī ||
bhedaiḥ saptadaśaiḥ proktā vidyāyāvyomacāriṇī | anāhataśikhāyāntu tasyecchā tu vinirgatā ||
tejorūpāmahāghorā vyāpiṇī sarvatasthitā | tadāsya vyāpiṇī proktā tejokṣaravimardinī ||
kandamadhrāntarajvālā mahāmanthānamacchitā | sahasrasūryasaṃkāśā niruddhāhṛdayāntare ||
niruddhavīryaprabhavā otaprotakṛtānu sā | yāvacchaktyā tu sasthānaṃ nirodhinyā nirodhayet ||
tāvaddhyānenu mukhataḥ paṃcāvvāre gatā śivā | brāhmyādīnāṃ tato bāhye ādyā vidyādirakṣarā ||
vāsavādyāśca ye vīrā tadrūpā vyomasaṃyutā | eke dvitricatuḥpaṃca ṣaṭsaptāṣṭāthave dviṣā ||
aṣṭamaṃ tu ti pūrveṇa mantramantrī dvidhācca yat | yāmalādi krameṇaiva aṣṭapatre yajet kramāt ||
dvitīyena pade vīryā vyāpivā ca krameṇa ca | kalā bāhya tataḥ paścācchṛṇu ekāgramānasa ||
tṛtīyena yanedbhūtā amṛtākhyā trirakṣarā | vidyānāmavibhāgena śṛṇutasyāmṛgekṣaṇe ||
ajite indrarūpantu udayodadvireva ca | tṛptirekotha ekāṃga tuṃvī aśvarasaṃbhavā ||
ete siddhā samākhyātā yoginyo yāstataḥ śṛṇu | ānandā īśvarī devī uccagāmī ca dāmbhikā ||
yonānurāvatī caiva jaukalā aḥ śaśiprabhā | khalu ekasya siddhasya vallabhasya sadā priye ||
ṣoḍaśāre mahācakre pūjayet siddhimātarāḥ | raviraśmi yathābhinnā raśmī yārvāyathārave ||
śivaśaktistathā bhinnā śaktī ca parameśvarī | adhivāsapurā kṛtvā paścād yajanamārabhet ||
siddhyarthyastu maheśāni tato dīkṣīṃ samārabhet | parikṣite dvādaśābdadaśapaṃcaka ekataḥ ||
anyathā patanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ guravā nātrasaṃśayaḥ | rahasyametat sarvasva manyathā na prakāśate ||
sucinīte tathā bhakte devatārādhane rate | gurumavāgnimantre ca sadṛśaṃ yastu paśyati ||
yotthaṃ vai tṛṇavatmanye gurudevāgikarmaṇi | dayānvito dānarato rāgadveṣavivarjitaḥ ||
samayī putrakānāntu pratimāmāṣitāntathā | parādivastu saṃpūjya abhāvānmānasena tu ||
jijñāsā tāthakeṭilyāt sādhyādvā bhaktibhāvataḥ | grahanaṃ tu bhave cchiṣya ityājñāpārameśvarī ||
śrīdevyuvāca
pūjāmaṇḍalavinyāsa sādhakākāryalakṣaṇaḥ | kathitaṃ devadeveśa kāruṇyena mahātmanā ||
tadavyaṃ śrotumicchāmi vahnisaṃtarpaṇaṃ param |
śrībhairava uvāca
karmakuṇḍalinī buddhyau prajvālya ca cidānalam ||
viṣayendriyasaṃghāta nidhanaṃ dāhayet priye | prāṇāpāṇau śruksuvasyān madānandādyatarpaṇa ||
saṃkalpādivikalapāśca akṣatānīhahomayet | ṣaḍadhvalajñānakāryaṃ saṃvit pūrṇāṃ pradāpayet ||
etadatyantaraṃ jñātvā bāhyapūjā samārabhet | samamānapramānaṃ ca kuṃḍaṃ caiva trimekhale ||
adhaukhaṭikayālekhyaṃ vahnisantarpaṇāya ca | kuṇḍasya daśasaṃskārā stotranādīnikārayet ||
tāḍanaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ caiva ullekhanamataḥ param | udvāna sevanaṃ caiva mārjanaṃ cānu lepanam ||
arvācatuḥpathaṃ caiva akṣavāḍhaṃ ca te daśa | kuṇḍe pūjāprakarttavyā madhye vai viṣṭarā kuru ||
ṛtu snātā tu vāgeśī uttarā iṣamūrddhagā | nīlotpaladalaśyāmā arghapādyādibhiryajet ||
agnerānayanaṃ paścāt sthāpanaṃ tadanantaram | veṣṭanaṃ tāḍanaṃ caiva prokṣaṇodyātanantathā ||
mantrāṇāmamṛtīkāryamarccanaṃ cāvaguṇṭhanam | daśaivakuṇḍabāhye tu aṣṭau kuṇḍāntare sthitā ||
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ tathā | vaktrasaṃkalpaṇaṃ kārya bhavate viktraniḥkṛtiḥ ||
niḥkramojātakramātha vaktrodyātakramāt priye | vaktraśuddhiḥ prakarttavyā nāmaśuddhistathaiva ca ||
aṣṭādaśaivasaṃskāraḥ karttavyā deśikena tu | garbhādhānādināmānta karttavyā hṛdaye na tu ||
tatastu devī vāgeśī marccayitvā vidhānataḥ | paryagnikāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ saṃmukhīkaraṇantathā ||
suradānaṃ viṣṭarācca pūjanaṃ paridhīni ca | lokeśāstu tu saṃpūjyā pūrvādikramayogataḥ ||
praṇīte vahnisaṃpūjya cāstreṇaiva ghaṭaṃ yajet | vahni saṃtarpaṇaṃ pūjā karttavyā ca viśeṣataḥ ||
śruksuvau śodhayāstreṇa upayāmoparisthitam | paścād dvādaśasaṃskāraḥ suvilīnā paṭāntare ||
adhiśravaṇamādau tu upādhi śravaṇantathā | utplavanasaṃplavanaṃ nīrāṃjananirīkṣaṇam ||
āsanaṃ pūjayed devyāḥ pūjayenmaṇḍale śubhe | athāgnau vinyased devī mamṛtāmṛtarūpiṇīm ||
tatastu tarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ cchāgairmadhughṛtādibhiḥ | aṣṭottaraistrikhaṇḍāstu daśāṃśairnādyatarpaṇaiḥ ||
pūrṇā pradhārākarttavyā tato vijñaptikārayet | tvatprasādena deveśi bhūyo dīkṣā samārabhet ||
ā sā kālāgnikuharā dutthitā paramākalā | kaṃpamānākaraṃdhrena viśrāntānābhimaṇḍale ||
bhujaṅgakuṭilākārā divyāpyāparamākalā | tadantavartinī kācid devīpāśakṣayaṃkarī ||
candrārkaubhayamadhyasthā caṃdrārkaubhayavaṃdhitā | caṃdrārkānalasaṃrūḍhā caṃdrārkānalabhakṣiṇī ||
mahāraudrakarasthā ca svasvabhāvasamāviśet | tatastejodgatā bhadre eṣā sā paramā kalā ||
saṃcāryamantravīryeṇa turyamārgena caiva hi | tritatve nāthavai tasya dīkṣākāyāviśeṣataḥ ||
sarvādhvaśodhane naiva tathāmuktobhave śiṣu | sūtravaṃdhādikaraṇe pūrvoktavidhinoditā ||
vinyāsaṃ śodhanaṃ śiṣyā vijñaptitadanantaram | śikhācchedaṃ tataḥ pūrṇā yojanaṃ snānameva ca ||
vijñāpanaṃ pūjanena pare yojanikāśiṣoḥ | abhiṣekasāmayika pūtrake sādhakopi vā ||
krameṇa guṇinākāryā caruṇānānyathā priye | puraraṇyaṃ pravakṣyāmi karmakoṣaṃ yathā sthitā(?) ||
pratyūṣe tu samutthāya madhyāhne vā niśāgame | jayedaṣṭaśataṃ vidyā hyahanyahanisādhakam ||
sarvakāmonavāpnoti vidyājāpaparāyaṇā | śubhagaḥ sarvasantānāmakṣayyaparabhāgbhavet ||
gorocanaśataṃ japtvā nararocanamiśritam | lalāṭe tilakaṃ kāryaṃ yaḥ paśyet savaśaṃ nayet ||
siddhārtha kavacāśvetā pratyūṣe devatālaye | sthāpayitvā caturddaśyāṃ devyārcā saṃpradāpayet ||
mukhe tu prakṣiped devi paravāde jayaṃ labhet | cāṃḍālāgnintu prajvālya kāṣṭhaiḥ khadirasaṃbhavaiḥ ||
arintu sa likhedbhūmau vidyāyā sādhako bhuvi | padaṃ datvābhidhe yasya krodhāviṣṭhantu sādhakaḥ ||
khādirebdasahasrantu ajāraktasamanvitaḥ | māṃsaiḥ parivṛtaṃ kṛtvā dhyānāviṣṭantu mohayet ||
suptāhetu vyatikrānte ānayet puramaṃdiram | citibhasmasamādāya kharasūtrena saṃyutam ||
śatāṣṭajāpānmantreṇa sainye kṣiptvā tu tatkṣaṇāt | pūjayet siddhikāsthāne ucchiṣṭopatyakānale ||
saṃdhyāśrotrānirodhena nisargopaśrutiṃ labhet | tatrasthāne ajedbhūtaṃ dakṣiṇāṅga prapūjayet ||
śubhāśubhaṃ parijñāya tṛtīye labhyate priye | tataḥ pitṛvanaṃ macchet kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥ ||
tayā niśiṃ mokṣayitvā niḥśaṃko nighṛṇaḥ sudhīḥ | palālibhūśca saṃlipta digvāsābhaktilālasaḥ ||
vāmātsaṃgagatā dūtī pūtrālakṣaṇasaṃyutā | maṇḍalaṃ kārayet tatra asthicūrṇenasundari ||
mahāpiśitapānādyai rādyayāgasamāhitaḥ | āvāhayet tato devī mudrāyogena nānyathā ||
prajvālyadanilādyena caṃdrasūrya karendhane | kandotthitāmahāraudrī mūditā prāṇabhāskarāḥ ||
saṃghaṭṭasaṃsthito yogī mantargandhañca ghaṭṭayet | ūrddhamārgapravāhena uddharedudayaṃ param ||
sakṛduccārite naiva viśvakṣobha prajāyate | uddharomabhaved devi paśūnāṃ pātayet kṣaṇāt ||
eṣā pratyaṃgirādevi baddhvācotpadyate pare | bhrūṇahatyā sahasrāṇi brahmahatyāhatāni ca ||
baṃdhanādbhasmasāyāti vṛkṣamindrāśaniryathā | melāpakhecarīṇāntu nidhīni ca rasāni ca ||
lakṣajāpena vidhinā pātālaṃ tu rasātalam | prasenāsatyakathana tathā vidhvaṃsamāraṇam ||
staṃbhanoccāṭanaṃ caiva sainyastambhanameva ca | mantravadastu khārkhodaviṣasthāvarajaṅgama ||
garajvarādayodevi anyeneṣāmanekaśaḥ | paraprayuktānaśyanti tanmuktānya sahasraṇaḥ ||
pratyaṅgirā prabhāvena sarvaṃ siddhyati sādhakaḥ | etad rahasyaṃ paramaṃ nākhyātaṃ kasyacit mayā ||
gopanīyaṃ prayatnena caurebhyodraviṇaṃ yathā | paraśiṣya na dātavyaṃ bhakti ekāntike yathā ||
guruduṣṭe caṃcake ca kāmalobhasamanvite | dātāro narakaṃ yānti satyaṃ satyaṃ na cānyathā ||
[iti śrītridaśaḍāmare mahātantre catustriṃśatisāhasre śrīpratyaṃgirāvidhi dvyaśītitamaḥ paṭala pratyaṅgirā kalpaṃ samāptaṃ] ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīcaṇḍakāpālinyai ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
śrutādevamayā śaṃbho āgamāni hyanekadhā | mukhadoṣagatāmantrī ajñā vaiśvavināśitā ||
aśuddhā staṃbhitā bhinnā dhvaṃsitā jñāna cetasaḥ | aneka kāraṇārthena prastāraṃ vadaśūlina ||
siddhilakṣmīrmahādevī paṃcācalavinirgatā | kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa bījabhūtā vyavasthitā ||
tāmahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatprasādācca bhairava | parituṣṭāsime śaṃbho bhrānti cchedaṃ kuruṣvamām ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
guhyādguhyataraṃ devi tvayāpṛṣṭhaṃ varānane | na mayā brahmaṇe khyātaṃ viṣṇavena ca vāsave ||
na devenā surayakṣena gaṃdharvena kinnare | norage kathitā bhadre mānuṣeya ca kā tathā ||
śṛṇu devi mahāguhyaṃ yastvayā paripṛcchati | tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi vidyā prastāramuttamam ||
prastārarahitā vidyā aśuddhāvaktradūṣitā | anekakāraṇārthena mantraprastāramuddharet ||
susame bhūpradeśe ca nimnānnatavivarjite | gomayanāpalipte ca gaṃdhapuṣpādi vāsite ||
pūrvābhimukha ācārya śitacandane carcite | śvetāmbaradharo bhūtvā śvetālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥ ||
śitapuṣpaśire baddhvā karpūramukhapuritaḥ | śuddhā ca mṛdvatī śuddhā ṣaṭikāṃ dakṣiṇe kare ||
dhṛtā devī prayatnena ālikhedvaravarṇini | caturviṃśāṅgulaṃ sūtraṃ kārayeccaturodiśi ||
pūrvapaścimataścaiva saumyayāmyadiśāṃ nidheḥ | bhāgayed rūdrasaṃkhyā ca prayatnāccaturodiśi ||
koṣṭhakāśatameruṃ hi ekaviṃśādhikaṃ bhavet | tanmadhye lopayeddevi śṛṇuṣvekāgramānasaḥ ||
ekadvitricatuḥpaṃca īśāgnirakṣamārute | lopayeddevi yatnena koṣṭhakākoṇasaṃsthitā ||
endradakṣiṇayormadhye koṣṭhakāśca trayaṃ trayam | vikarṇapakṣibhedena lopayet prāsragālayāt ||
śeṣā anenamārgeṇa rakṣamāruta śūlabhṛt | dvāsaptati varārohe lopayet koṣṭhakāni ca ||
śatārddhatiṣṭhate devi ekonavaravarṇini | caṃdrarāme sarāḥ pūrvadakṣe candrāgni ṇāyakān ||
ekaṃ caiva guṇāvāṇā sthitāpāśabhṛto diśi | kaivalyaṃ lokabhūtāni dhanadeśeṣu saṃsthitā ||
madhyeṣu saṃsthitā koṣṭhā viśvasaṃkhyā calātmaje | caturdvāra yathā vāpī ākāraṃ ca bhavantite ||
udayārddha sthitaṃ pūrvayāmyamalayaparvataṃ | merubhūdharapūrveṇa sthitaṃ pāśabhṛto diśi ||
lokāloka sthitaṃ saumyaṃ madhye kailāśaparvatam | udayādṛk sthitānanda koṣṭhakāvaravarṇini ||
malayādi sthitānaṃdā koṣṭhā saṃkhyā varānane | meronandapuraṃ devi lokāloka tathaiva ca ||
kailāśe saṃsthitā viśvā kramādbhūdhara koṣṭhakāḥ | paṃcācalasamākhyātā tanmadhye mātṛkāṃ nyaset ||
pūrvadakṣe jalasaumye mātṛkādyaddhimakṣarāḥ | trīṇi trīṇi likhet paktiṃ pūrvādārabhyacottaram ||
hakāramadhyakoṣṭhasya tasyādyantā saśaulikhet | hakārārddha vakārañca hakārā ceṣamālikhet ||
kṣakārodhaśakāraṃ ca jhakārādau jamālikhet | aikārorddha ukāraṃ ca akārāntedamālikhet ||
ṭhakārādhoścakāraṃ ca jhakārādhoccamālikhet | jakārordhacchakāraṃ ca jhakāraṃ ādimuddharet ||
ekārārdhe thakāraṃ ca okārārddhe ṭamālikhet | okārānte thakāraṃ ca dhakāraṃ dorddha sasthitaṃ ||
śavamadhye yakāraṃ ca jasamadhye vamālikhet | ṣaḍamadhye makāraṃ ca rehaṃ ca daśamadhyagam ||
śadyādyantoka audevi cchabhorddhādha ca auliket | ṭakārādyaṃ ṭhakārānte ṇaḍhaulikhya kramena vai ||
dhakārārdha thakārādau janaulikhya nagātmaje | paramadhya lakāraṃ ca hakāraṃ pavamadhyagam ||
bhakāraṃ vamamadhyasthaṃ sakārādhau yamālikhet | prastāroyaṃ mahāgūḍhaṃ nāma paṃcācalaṃ mahat ||
tanmadhye tu mahādevi mahāvidyācalātmaje | siddhilakṣmīti vikhyātā śṛṇuṣvekāgramānasaḥ ||
ṇāntorddha saṃsthitaṃ varṇaṃ mīkārāntena bhūṣitam | ādyapraṇavamityuktaṃ smaraṇāt kilviṣāpahaṃ ||
lokālokā sthitaṃ gṛhya dhakārādhve sthitaṃ tu yat | tasyādha ṣaḍamadhyasthaṃ dhakārādyena bhūṣitaṃ ||
kailāśe haramadhyasthaṃ tadagre phalamadhyagam | rephākrāntaṃ śirasthāne tadagre layamadhyagaṃ ||
merumādyenasaṃbhinnaṃ rakārādi samālikhet | lokālokāṣṭasaṃyojya ramamadhye tadagrataḥ ||
i na madhyena saṃbhinnaṃ aṣṭamaṃ akṣaraṃ bhavet | khāntaṃvarṇasamuddhṛtya udayācalasaptamaṃ ||
merumādyena saṃbhinnaṃ dhakārorddhenadagrataḥ | lokālokādisaṃyuktaṃ saṃśamaṃbījamuttamam ||
vamamadhyagataṃ varṇaṃ ramamadhyagataṃ tathā | i ṇamadhyakramāyojya namaskāraṃ tadagrataḥ ||
caturthaṃ paṃcamaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃmasyāvidyāśca saptamam | catvārakramamālikhya ḍorddhamalayādi saṃyutaṃ ||
auṇamadhyaṃ daśamadhyaṃ merumādyakramāyutam | vidyāmekādaśaṃ varṇaṃ namo agre tataḥ punaḥ ||
nityoditā padaṃ likhyadhorddha induvibhūṣitam | rādyavarṇasamuddhṛtyadhorddhantu bindulāṃcchitaṃ ||
ditā padaṃ ca tasyāgre ramamadhyaṃ iḍamadhyagam | yuktaṃ devi prayatnena dvātriṃśadakṣaroddhṛtā ||
kailāśe layamadhyasthaṃ khādyaṃ udayaparvate | kailāśe paramadhyasthaṃ kevalāni samālikhet ||
kulacakrapadaṃ pūrvadhorddhantu rayamadhyagau | kalā dvitrikramāyukto khādyaṃ parakalānvitam ||
rāntodhasasthitaṃ varṇaṃ ṭhāntorddhena samanvitam | kailāśe vamamadhyasthaṃ udayācala ṣaṣṭhamam ||
paphamadhye tadagre ca kevalāni samuddharet | auṇamadhye ramamadhya idamadhye kramāyutam ||
cchorddhaṃ tithikalāyuktaṃ ekārāntorddha kevalam | khādyaṃ parakalāyuktaṃ gavamadhye parāyutam ||
kailāśe hādimadhyasthaṃ merumādyenabhūṣitam | dhorddhasthaṃ ra madhyasthaṃ iḍamadhyena bheditam ||
auṇamadhyagataṃ devi rakārādyaṃ tadagrataḥ | ramadhyagataṃ yojya takārāntaṃ samanvitam ||
vedādyakṣaramuddhṛtya māyābījaṃ tadagrataḥ | nābhidvisthāna khaṃmūrddhau ṣaṣṭhaṃ parakalānvitau ||
pādadāntasamārūḍhaṃ mūrddhamakārasaṃyutam | tasyāgre tu cakṣokāraṃ kroṃnamonta samuddharet ||
vidyādyakṣarasaṃlikhya gavamadhyaṃ thalamadhyagam | ṣaḍamadhyapunardevi kevalāni samuddharet ||
nisihaṃlikhya deveśi vilomenādhvijātmaje | lokālokāntamuddhṛtya taṃ corddhayadvyavasthitam ||
merumādyenasaṃbhinnaṃ takārādyantu kevalam | mārgadevi samālikhya padaṃ tasyāgra sasthitam ||
tasyāgre tu samālikhya kevalaṃ laghamadhyagaṃ | gavamadhye paramadhye ekīkṛtya varānane ||
kailāśe phalamadhyeṣu tadante gavamadhyagam | daśamadhyāsamārūḍhaṃ śamari padamagrataḥ ||
haramadhye uramadhyaṃ paramadhyaṃ ca kevalam | rādyaṃ khārddha samārūḍhaṃ dāntaṃ pāśabhṛtānvitaḥ ||
auṇamadhyasthitaṃ varṇaṃ mahiṣāsanasaṃyutaḥ | riṣṭakleśapadaṃ magrerādyaṃ vādyaṃ ca kevarau ||
dhorddhapāśabhṛte naiva bheditaṃ rāntakevalam | lāntaṃ parakalākrāntaṃ rephabhinnaṃ ca mastakam ||
kevalaṃ gavamadhyasthaṃ rādyaṃ parakalānvitam | ṣaḍamadhyaṃ vamamadhyaṃ i na madhyena bheditam ||
visargānta sthitaṃ varṇaṃ merumādhyenamaṇḍitam | taraṇi pada tasyāgre ālikhedvaravarṇini ||
rahamadhyaṃ umamadhyaṃ paramadhyaṃ vadāntagam | kevalāni samuddhṛtya tara u ādisaṃyutam ||
nithamapravilomena radyemakārabhūṣitam | phalamadhyagataṃ varṇaṃ merumādyenamaṃtritam ||
ādyaṃ malayamuddhṛtya ūrddhacādhaṃ tu kevalam | trayādviguṇamuccārya hasadvisthānamālikhet ||
phalamadhyagataṃ varṇaṃ tasyāgre paramadhyagam | tasyādho khagamadhyasthaṃ dvayo dviguṇamuccaret ||
lokālokā sthitaṃ corddhaṃ kailāśe daśamadhyagam | thalamadhyagataṃ likhya akamadhyādhasasthitam ||
visargānte sthitaṃ varṇaṃ ikāreṇa vibhūṣitam | dāntaṃ parakalāyuktaṃ mī antena samanvitam ||
tarajaṃ likhyadeveśi tadagre phalamadhyagaṃ | phabhamadhyagataṃ varṇaṃ malayādyenabhūṣitam ||
bhakṣiṇīmadamuccārya dvisthāne ṣaḍamadhyagam | kailāse haramadhyasthaṃ phalamadhyādhasasthitam ||
kevalaṃ hāntagaṃ varṇaṃ oṇamadhyaṃ tadagrataḥ | tasyādho daśamadhyasthaṃ binduṣaṣṭhasvarānvitam ||
ṣaḍamadhyagataṃ varṇaṃ rādyaṃ sarephamūrddhagam | dvayādvisthānamālikhya gādyaṃ malayādibhūṣitam ||
śaśamadhyagataṃ varṇaṃ vāruṇenaivamaṇḍitam | ubhau dviguṇamuccārya triśūlena padaṃ punaḥ ||
kailāse khāntasovastha īśvaraṃ bindulāṃcchitam | visargādhasamuddhṛtya merumādyenabhūṣitam ||
dvayo dviguṇamuccārya cchiṃdhidvisthānamālikhet | kailāse bhayamadhyasthaṃ kevalam bhūdharādbhave ||
aimamadhyaṃ kha gha madhyaṃ ai ūrddhaṃ yojayet kramāt | lokālokasyadhorddhasthaṃ auṇamadhye tadagrataḥ ||
malayādi yutaṃ kṛtvā ṭhāntaṃ sāgraṃ samālikhet | trayo dviguṇamucārya cchedaye dviguṇaṃ likhet ||
tāvadyāvatpadaṃ likhyavisargāntorddhamālikhet | nārathānpadasaṃlikhya sādhayeddviguṇolikhet ||
gavamadhyatadagre ca thalamadhyaṃ ṣaḍamadhyagam | kevalāni trayāvarṇātkaṇirukāvilomataḥ ||
vamamadhyaṃ khaghamadhyaṃ phalamadhyaṃ tathaiva ca | tadagre auṇamadhyasthaṃ tṛtīyasvarabheditam ||
mahābhairavamuddhṛtya tejaṣaṭṣṭhasvarāsthitaḥ | kevalaṃ gavamadhyasthaṃ dodhaparakalānvitam ||
thalamadhyaṃ ḍhakārāḍhaṃ ubhau īśvarabheditau | tarajaṃ īśvaraiḥ sārddhaṃ tadagre thadhamadhyagam ||
vahamadhyaṃ phalamadhyaṃ dodhantu dhāvasaṃlikhet | kevalāni varārohe cedavarṇasamuddharet ||
ṣoddhantu īśvarā krāntaṃ auṇāmadhye ca e yutam | haramadhyaṃ uramadhyaṃ paramadhyaṃ tathaiva ca ||
kevalāni trayovarṇā trārddhañca biṃdulakṣitam | auṇamadhyaṃ daśamadhyaṃ yuktaṃ ca dorddhamagrataḥ ||
malayādi yutaṃ kuryāṇādhasthaṃ savisargayuk | kailāśe gavamadhyasthaṃ adhohyagniṃ pradāpayet ||
tādyaṃ thādyaṃ cchakārāntaṃ dhorddhavakāramālikhet | kevalāni varārohe bhūtasaṃkhyākṣarāṇi ca ||
tadagre auṇamadhyasthaṃ haramadhyādhasasthitam | tadagre paramadhyasthaṃ iṭamadhyena bheditam ||
anusvārāntamālikhya aikārādyantu mūrddhagam | kailāśe phalamadhyasthaṃ pahamadhyasthitaṃ tu yut ||
ikārādyenasaṃyuktaṃ ālikhedvaravarṇini | kevalaṃ bhaḍhamadhyasthaṃ sāntaṃ ḷ ādyabhūṣitam ||
khādyaṃ parakalāyuktaṃ vādyamīśvarabheditam | asya bījādimaṃ bījamagrataḥ punarālikhet ||
kevalaṃ paramadhyasthaṃ ālikhedvaravarṇini | visargāntoddhamālikhya ādyena ca vibhūṣitam ||
vahamadhyagataṃ varṇaṃ dhorddhaña tadanantaram | kalātṛtīyasaṃyukto atarurddhaṃ śṛṇu priye ||
sānte ṣaṣṭhakalārūḍho vyomamastakabhūṣitam | trividhoccāraṇaṃ tasya kuryāt parvata saṃbhave ||
prasīdamadanālikhya oṇamadhyaṃ khorddhasasthitam | agratejaṃ samuddhṛtya malayādyenabhūṣitam ||
khādyaṃdāntaṃ samuddhṛtyau ukārāsanasaṃsthitau | ubhaudviguṇamuccārya rāntaṃ u ādisaṃsthitam ||
dāntaṃ parakalāyuktaṃ hādyaṃ khārddha sthitaṃ kuru | kailāśe daśamadhyasthaṃ uṇamadhyo dayā cale ||
lokālokedhakārārddha kailāśeṣādisaṃyutam | khādyaṃ parakalākrāntaṃ vyomamastakabhūṣitam ||
lokālokādisaṃyuktaṃ vyaṃjanaṃ mūrdhnisaṃsthitam | kailāśe vahamadhyasthaṃ tasyādho havyavāhanam ||
nādabiṃdukalopetaṃ lokālokādibheditam | sāntavarṇasamuddhṛtya u jhamadhyāsanasthitam ||
vyomamūrdhni gataṃ kuryādaśeṣādya praṇāśanam | kailāśe parvatate vānte yadvarṇaṃ sārddhasaṃsthitam ||
akārāntamurddhalikhya ubhau tristhānamālikhet | haramadhyāsanaṃ lāntaṃ sāntaṃ ca hyagrataḥ sthitam ||
ubhaudaṇḍadharau kuryānmantrametat surārcite | eṣāvidyāmahābhāge siddhalakṣmīti viśrutā ||
akṣarānte tu te sarva navatyadhik śatadvayam |
śrīdevyuvāca ||
adyame saphalaṃ janma adyame saphalaṃ tapaḥ ||
śrutā śaṃbho mahāvidyā tvatprasādādya bhairava | adhunā śrotumicchāmi karāṃganyāsamuttamam ||
yena vinyastamātreṇa sarvasiddhiprajāyate |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi mahābhāge yastvayāparipṛcchatam ||
kathayāmi na saṃdeho nyāsaṃ bhavati yādṛśam | śṛṇu devi samākhyātā siddhalakṣmīti vidyayā ||
oṃkārādi hakārāntā daśonātriśatākṣarī | tasyādyekādaśāvarṇā pūrvavaktre ca vinyaset ||
tasyāgre nandasaṃkhyā ca dakṣiṇāsyeṣu vinyaset | bhānusaṃkhyāntare vaktre paścime rudrasaṃkhyakān ||
ūrddhavaktre ca deveśi dviguṇākṣa tṛṇākṣarāt | namontaṃ vinyasedvaktre yathā saṃkhyākrameṇa tu ||
vaktraṃ nyāsamidaṃ proktaṃ tadagre tvadhunā śṛṇu | bhrukṛnnābhimukhe caiva vāmadakṣa puṭe tathā ||
vāmadakṣiṇa netra ca śravaṇe vāmadakṣiṇe | liṅgādhāra krameṇaiva varṇamekaika vinyaset ||
bhrūpādau guḍaparyantaṃ yojayed dvādaśākṣarān | ṛṣiraṃgā diśā viśvā graharaṃdhrāt krameṇa tu ||
hṛdayādyastraparyantaṃ yathā saṃkhyākṣarāṇi ca | namaḥ svāhā vaṣaṭ hūṃ ca vauṣaṭ phaṭ antagaṃ tathā ||
mantrayānī mayā proktaṃ ṣaḍaṃgānteṣu yojayet | acalābdhi yugāvarṇā āvāhyapretamāsanam ||
śatrukṣayakrameṇaiva yojayed varavarṇini | kapālarudramityākhyā khaṭvāṃgaṃ viśvamakṣarān ||
śūlaṃ cāṣṭavijānīyā khaḍgasaptākṣarānyaset | pāśeśarasamākhyātā aṃkuśe ṛtu saṃkhyayā ||
varadokonaviṃśatyā dvīpasaṃkhyābhavet nyaset | sārddhamuṇḍaṃ camasvarṇāḥ ghaṇṭāpaṃca daśaṃ tathā ||
astraśastrakṣarā proktā karaṃ nyāsamataḥ śṛṇu | tarjanyaṣṭa nyasedvarṇa madhyamekādaśastathā ||
anāmikāgnimākhyātaḥ kanyakāṃ dvādaśākṣarān | aṃguṣṭhākṣara saptaiva tribhirhastataleṣu ca ||
karaṃ nyāsamidaṃ proktaṃ namontaṃ yojayet priye | yoninābhi hṛdimūrddhni vinyasedviddhicākṣarān ||
idaṃ nyāsa mahābhāga kathitaṃ bhrāntivarjitam | adhunā kathayiṣyāmi devārcana vidhiḥ kramāt ||
yena vijñātamātrena dharmakāmārtha siddhyati | snānaṃ kṛtvā varārohe dhautavalānuveṣṭayet ||
arghapātrāstramantrena pūrayedvaravarṇini | dvārapālastataḥ pūjya arghapātrāṃbu puṣpayāḥ ||
mantraṃ tābhyāṃ varārohe śṛṇukalyāni sāṃvratam | ṭakārādha sthitaṃ varṇaṃ binduyuktaṃ ca kārayet ||
tadagre jayamadhyasthaṃ dvidhābhūtaṃ kuru priye | ādyaṃ parakalāyuktaṃ tathā bindusamanvitam ||
oṃ tamadhyagavamadhyasthaṃ oṇamadhyamataḥ param | ramamadhyagataṃ varṇaṃ iḍhamadhyena bheditam ||
akamadhyagataṃ varṇaṃ ṣaḍamadhye tathaiva ca | visargāntaṃ tataḥ kuryādetadvarṇasamuddharet ||
mantreṇānena deveśi dvāraśākhāgradakṣiṇe | pujitavyaṃ prayatnena gaśeṇaṃ(?) varavarṇini ||
kṣāṁ kṣetrapadamuddhṛtya tasyādau praṇavaṃ likhet | kṣetrapālapadaṃ likhya namontamuccaret priye ||
mantreṇānena deveśi dvārasya vāmabhāgataḥ | pūjayet kṣetrapālaṃ ca arghāṃbu puṣpasaṃyutaiḥ ||
dehalyāyai padaṃ likhya praṇavādinamontakai | dehalī pūjayennityaṃ praviśed yāgamaṃdiram ||
praṇavādisamuddhṛtya māyābījaṃ tadagrataḥ | lakṣmībījaṃ ca tasyāgre digmātṛbhyo namontakam ||
mantreṇānena deveśi aṣṭadig paripūjayet | praṇavādi samuddhṛtya māyā tasyāgrasaṃsthitam ||
ādhāraśaktimālikhya kamalāsana padaṃ punaḥ | tato nāyapadaṃ cāgre āsanaṃ mānmanasya ca ||
tatroparisvayaṃ devi hyupaviśyavarānmuni | ādhāraśaktimākuṃcya taḍitkoṭisamaprabhām ||
madhranābhau ca hṛtkaṇṭhe ājñāsthānakrameṇa tu | bheditavyaṃ prayatnena dvādaśānta layaṃ kuru ||
parāmṛtarasaṃ devi śravantaṃ cintayet sadā | dehamāplāvanaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ devī bhavet tataḥ ||
arghapātraṃ tataḥ pūjya mūlavidyāsureśvari | aṃganyāsakrameṇaiva namontaṃ pātrapūjanam ||
svajāti vihitairdravyaiḥ paripūrṇaṃ kuru priye | mudrāmṛtamayī baddhvā pātrasyāpi pradarśanai ||
cchoṭikāṃ ca trayaṃ datvā vighnasyoccāṭanaṃ kuru | pātrapūjā ime proktā ata ūrddhaṃ śṛṇu priye ||
oṃ hrīṁ śrīpadamuccārya ānandabhairavāya ca | phaṭkārānto likhed devī praṇavaṃ likhya cāgrataḥ ||
māyā śrībījamālikhya satrayaṃ savisargajam | surādevyāmṛtaṃ likhya dhamamāyāśca saṃlikhet ||
pavitrī karaṇaṃ devi mantreṇānena kārayet | sakalaśatrumālikhya pramathanipadaṃ punaḥ ||
astrāyaphaṭamālikhya dravyaśuddhiraṇena tu | antaryāga punardevi kartavyaṃ suviśeṣaṭaḥ ||
vāmena pūrayed vāyuṃ kuṃbhayet tadvanantaram | recayet sūryamārgena kiṃcidākuṃcayed guḍam ||
śaktiḥ śiva pade yojya jihvāmūrddhagataṃ kuru | antaryāgamidaṃ devi kathitaṃ bhrānti varjitam ||
aṣṭapatra likhet padmaṃ sakeśarasakarṇikam | tadbāhye ṣoḍaśāraṃ ca prayatnena samālikhet ||
pretañca karṇikāntasthaṃ devīṃ tasyoparisthitam | viṃśasyārddha bhujopetāṃ viṃśāddhārddhamukhāni vai ||
ṣaṣṭhisyārddhārddha netrāni śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibhā | kuṃdendu sadṛśaṃ rūpaṃ hāranūpūramaṃḍitam ||
triśūlavaradaṃ ghaṇṭhā khaṭvāṅgaṃ pāśameva ca | vāmabāhu ime proktā āyudhāni varānmukhi ||
aṃkuśamabhayaṃ muṇḍaṃ khaḍgaṃ ca pātrameva ca | dakṣabāhudhṛtāśastāmasurāṇāṃ vadhārthataḥ ||
dhyāye tadrūpamātmasthaṃ karṇikānta pratiṣṭhayet | āvāhanādi satkāraiḥ puṣpāṃjalitrayaṃ dadet ||
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathā gaṃdhaṃ arghapātrādikārayet | paścādātmani pūjā ca nyāsamārgeṇa kārayet ||
pūrvokta jvālapālāni vāmadakṣe ca madhyagān | gaṇeśaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca dehalyā ca tṛtīyakā ||
guruṃ paraguruṃ caiva parameṣṭhiṃ tathaiva ca | pūrvācārya caturthaṃ ca ādi siddhiṃ ca paṃcamam ||
gurupaktiṃ samabhyarcya devī urddhagataḥ sadā | praṇavādinamontasthāmuccared gurupaṃcakam ||
ata ūrddhaṃ mahādevi śaktipūjāṃ samārabhet | kaṃ ṭaṃ kamalākarṣaṇyai dhūta nyāsilatādharī ||
krodhinī vajrinī caiva cchedinī ca kapālinī | hrīṁ śrīṁ praṇavayogena namontaścāṣṭaśaktayaḥ ||
indrādau īśaparyantaṃ śaktiścāṣṭa dale yajet | ṣoḍaśāre mahāpadma viśeṣā cchṛṇupārvati ||
caṇḍāyai ca pracaṇḍāyai subhadrāmukuṭī tathā | laṃbākhyā bhūridhārā ca marutā ca suvarṇabhā ||
guhanāsā jvāladāyai vitālāguhakāstathā | manodhyakṣāpracaṇḍā ca khaḍgālā phetkāriṇī tathā ||
yathā pūrvakrameṇaiva ṣoḍaśāni prapūjayet | paścādvaṭukaṃ mahābhāge pūjayed devi cāgrataḥ ||
devi putrapadaṃ likhya vaṭukanāthapadaṃ punaḥ | ehi ehi padaṃ likhya gṛhna gṛhneti coccaret ||
hrīṁ śrīṁ ādi svāhānte ca baṭuka pūjā imataḥ | kṣetrapālāya saṃlikhya ehi ehi padaṃ punaḥ ||
baliṃ gṛhna gṛhna svāhā oṃ kṣāṃ ādi svāhāntagam | kṣetrapālavalirhyeṣā sarvabhūta baliṃ śṛṇu ||
devatebhyaḥ padaṃ pūrva yoginībhyaḥ samuddharet | baliṃ gṛhna gṛhnoddhṛtyaṃ hrīṁ śrīṁ ādi svāhāntagam ||
sarvabhūtabali hyeṣā kathitā bhrānti varjitā | dātavyāmīśā digbhāge sarvāpadravanāśanīm ||
[iti śrīkālikulasadbhāve mahātantre paṃcācalanirgata prastāre śrīsiddhilakṣmīmate mantrarājoddhāre dvipaṃcāśattamodhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ] || ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīpratyaṅgirā devyai ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
parameśa sudhāsrūti kalālaṃ kṛta śekhare | nīlakaṇṭha vṛṣārūḍha gaṅgādhara maheśvara ||
tāṃ vaḥ pratyaṃgirāṃ devīṃ trailokya bhayanāśinīm | paramantrābhicārāṃśca yā nāśayati līlayā ||
śāntipuṣṭikarī śuddhā grahāpasmārabhakṣaṇīm | bhūtavetāla śamanī kṛtyā khārkhodanāśinī ||
sarvasādhāraṇī ghorā sarvāpaplavanāśanī | sarvasaṃpattidā śreṣṭhā sarvasaubhāgyadāyikā ||
yayā vijñātayā samyak vibhūtiḥ saṃpravartate | yasyā ghoratarānānyā vidyate bhuvanodare ||
tāmākhyā hi mahādeva prasādādviśvanāyikām |
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu vīrendra namite rahasyamidamadbhutaṃ ||
sarvasaṃkaradoṣaghnaṃ sarvāpadravanāśanam | sarvaśatrunihantāraṃ duṣṭadāridramarddanam ||
vidhānamatulaṃ devi yannākhyātaṃ kadācana | manorama śucaudeśe sugupte lakṣaṇānvite ||
sudhūpāmodavahule candanāgurucarcite | prastāryamātṛkāmantrī prapūryā ca yathākramam ||
tataḥ samuddhared vidyāṃ trailokya bhayanāśanīm | dīpakaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya namaskārasamanvitam ||
sarvasiddhipadaṃ caiva yoginībhyaḥ padaṃ tathā | namaskāraḥ punaḥ kuryāt sarvasiddhi padaṃ tathā ||
mātṝbhyaḥ padamuddhṛtya namaḥ śabdaṃ tataḥ kuru | nityoditānandapadaṃ naṃditāyai padaṃ tathā ||
padaṃ sakalanāmānaṃ tatparaṃ parikīrtitam | kule cakrapadaṃ yojya nāyikāyai padaṃ tathā ||
bhagavatyai padaṃ paścāccaṇḍa śabdaṃ punardadet | kāpālinyai padaṃ dadyāt tad yathā padamuddharet ||
ṣaṭpaṃcāśākṣareṇoktaṃ prathamaṃ tu samuddharet | punastripadamuddhṛtya ḍambaraṃ tadanantaram ||
sadāśivau punardeyaṃ haṃsamaṃkuśasaṃyutam | bindunālaṃ kṛtaṃ kṛtvā kuṇḍalaṃ yonisaṃyutam ||
golakenasamāyuktaṃ punaḥ sarvakṣayaṃ dadet | tripadena samāyuktaṃ bindunāsamalakṛtam ||
praṇavaṃ karttanaṃ vahni biṃdumekatra yojayet | namaskāramatodeyaṃ mahāmantrapradīpanam ||
deyaṃ parama śabdaṃ ca haṃsinīti padaṃ tathā | nirvāṇamārgade deyaṃ padaṃ sarvottamottamam ||
viṣamopaplavapadaṃ praśamani padaṃ tathā | amṛtaṃ yojayet paścāt kalaśabdaṃ punardadet ||
duritāriṣṭasaṃkleśa śabdayuktaṃ punardadet | padaṃ dalanisaṃyojya padaṃ sarvā padaṃ tathā ||
tathaivāṃbhodhitaraṇi punaḥ sakala śatrukam | pramathani padaṃ paścād devi śabdaṃ punardadet ||
āgacchāgacchasaṃyojya hasayugmaṃ dvidhā kuru | valgayugmapadaṃ yojya naraśabdaṃ punardadet ||
rudhirātravasāyojya bhakṣiṇīti padaṃ tathā | mamaśabdaṃ svaśabdaṃ ca śatrunmarddadvidhā vadet ||
khāhikhākhi padaṃ datvā triśūlena padaṃ tathā | bhiṃdicchiṃdi dvidhāyojya khaḍgena punaruddharet ||
tāḍayeti dvidhā yojya cchedayeti padaṃ dvidhā | tāvadyāvatpadaṃ dadyānmamaśabdaṃ tato vadet ||
vadet sakala saṃjñaṃ ca padadeyaṃ manorathān | sādhayaṃ dviguṇaṃ deyaṃ padaṃ paramasaṃjñitam ||
tathā kāruṇike cānya padaṃ bhagavatīti ca | mahāśabdaṃ punardeyaṃ bhairavaṃ padasaṃjñitam ||
rūpadhāriṇi caivānyatpadaṃ tridaśa ādyakam | varaśabdaṃ punardeyaṃ namiteti padaṃ tathā ||
punaḥ sakalaśabdaṃ tu mantramātaḥ padaṃ tathā | praṇateti padaṃ yattajjanaśabdaṃ punardadet ||
vatsaleti padaṃ caiva yojayet parameśvari | devi śabdaṃ mahādeyaṃ kāliśabdaṃ punardadet ||
kālanāśani saṃyojya padamatra pradīpakaṃ | mahānilapadaṃ datvā brahmaṇāparidarpitaṃ ||
lāṃcchitaṃ golakenaiva piṇḍaṃ santu tridhāvadet | paścāt prasīda padakaṃ madanāturaśabdakam ||
asyāstimaṃkuśākrāntaṃ bhūṣitaṃ mūrdhni bindukam | kuruśabdadvidhāyojya surāsurapadaṃ tathā ||
kanyakāpadamuddhṛtya ḍaṃbaraṃ tu samuddharet | varuṇāntaṃ ḍambareṇa vahni binduvibhūṣitam ||
sarva śrīmukhadātāra mahābhogaparāvaham | kālānalaṃ mahāhaṃsa bindurddha tu vibhūṣitam ||
bhīmapadaṃ tridhā yojya vahnibhāryā samanvitam | uddhṛtā paramāvidyā sukhasaubhāgyamokṣadā ||
śatadvayantu varṇānāṃ navatyekakamuddhṛtā | eṣā vidyā mahāvidyā nāmnā trailokyamohinī ||
lakṣmīśvarī mahākāntā sarvasaubhāgyadāsmṛtā | asmin śrotasi deveśi nānayāsadṛśī parā ||
alakṣmī samanī jñeyā duṣṭadāridramardanī | kali duḥsvapnaśamanī sarvāpadranāśanī ||
rājopasarga praśamanī duṣṭadaityavighaṭṭinī | caurāraṇye mahāghore siṃhavyāghrādi saṃkaṭe ||
viṣame gahane vahnau bhūtāpasmāraje bhaye | smaraṇīyā sadāgorī kṛtyāsaṅgrāmadāruṇe ||
sakṛtsmṛtvā dahatyeṣā pāpaughaṃ tṛṇarāśivat | hatvājagadidaṃ ghoraṃ brahmavidbhiḥ prasūcitam ||
guruhā pitṛhā devi mātṛhā bhruṇahā tathā | liṃgotpātādikaiḥ pāpaiḥ sakṛt pāṭhāt pramucyate ||
pāpairmahāpātakaiśca tathā caivopapātakaiḥ | tathā pātaka rājaśca sakṛnmocayate smṛtā ||
lakṣmī yuktā bhavecchrīmān madonmattagajendravat | sakṛdāvartya deveśi pādāt sarvottamottamaḥ ||
saptasāgaraparyantaṃ tīrthasnānakṛtaṃ bhavet | trirāvartya sureśāni divi bhūmyantarīkṣa ca ||
tīrthasnātā bhaved devī nātrakāryāvicāraṇā | saptā vartena śubhagā dīkṣitaḥ sarvamaṇḍale ||
daśavartena śubhage putrako bhavet bhṛśam | saptāviṃśatijāpena jñāyate mātṛmaṃḍale ||
sādhako vīrarājāsau yathā bhairavanāyakaḥ | śatārddhaparijāpena bhavedbhairavavatsvayam ||
tamnāsti yannakurute tamnāsti yannasādhayet | nigalārgalayantrāṇi nāśayellīlayā sadā ||
trisaṃdhyā varttanād devi saptāhānnātrasaṃśayaḥ | baṃdhanān mucyate nūnaṃ yadikālena pāśitam ||
śatāṣṭapari jāpena śaktaraughaṃ vinikṣipet | yatra yatra maheśāni nigadā sphoṭanaṃ bhavet ||
nāvāśakaṭayantrāṇi stambhayen mocayet tathā | sikatāsapta japtvā tu kṣiptvāmaghānnivārayet ||
rājikāsapta japtvā tu kṛtvā sādhakapuṃgavaḥ | bhūtāpasmāra yaṣmādi yaṃ yaṃ tāḍayate krudhā ||
taṃ taṃ nāśayate kṣipraṃ na bhūyaḥ smarate tataḥ | jvarā cāturthakādyāśca sapta japtādekena tu ||
abhyutkṣaṇānnivarttante nātrakāryā vicāraṇā | lū(?)ṭāpasmāravisphoṭa vyādhayā vividhāstathā ||
saptajaptādakenaiva tadvaddevi vināśayet | trisaptamantritaṃ kṛtvā pāṇopāṇīyamuttamam ||
yasya taddīyate mantrī viṣārttasya sadaiva hi | kulikenāpi daṣṭasya viṣanirṇāśanaṃ bhavet ||

vallabhaḥ sarvanārīṇāṃ kāmadevasamobhavet | acintitāni cārthāni sadā tasya bhavanti hi ||
dhanadasya na sā bhūti sādhakasya tu yā bhavet | yathā nārāyaṇo devo lakṣmīkāntaḥ sadā sthiti ||
tadvatsādhaka rājasya smaraṇānnityameva hi | garayantraṃ viṣaṃ duṣṭaṃ ye prapuṃjanti sādhake ||
yo duṣṭadhiyaḥ kurutasteṣāṃ kṛtyā prajāyate | baṃdhuputrārthanāśaśca dehanāśaśca dāruṇaḥ ||
bhavatyeṣāṃ na saṃdeho yadiṣṭa sādhakottame | karmaṇā manasā vācā ye duṣṭaṃ tasya kurvate ||
teṣāṃ pratyaṃgirā jāyet sarvanāśaśca bhairavi | kruddho bhaved vā yasyaiṣa sādhako vīravatsale ||
kulakṣayaṃ bhavet tasya devyā smaraṇa mātrataḥ | yaḥ sadā cintayet kāmaṃ tat tat sādhakamiṣyate ||
sarvarūpadharā devī viśvarūpāmaholvaṇā | padmapretāsanā dīptā varadābhayaya pāśinī ||
nānārūpadharādevī nānāśastraikaśobhitā | bahuvastrā bahubhujā bahurūpā maholvaṇā ||
viśvarūpā maheśāni nīlakuṃci mūrddhajā | yathābhimatarūpā vā mahālakṣmī nibhāṃ smaret ||
śitahārendu sadṛśīṃ paṃcavaktrā trilocanām | daśadordaṇḍasaṃhitā nānāyudhakarodyatā ||
raktāruṇāmbarāṃ devīṃ smaret sarvasukhapradām | cintāmaṇinibhāṃ devīṃ cintitārtha phalapradā ||
mahāpātre dhānyagaṃje madyapūrṇe prapūjayet | akṣayaṃ tu bhavet tasya nityapūjāratasya ca ||
arthakope bilvagatāṃ saṃpūjya parameśvarī | dhanadena samaṃ dravyaṃ na kadācid vinaśyati ||
gajasāle muktidāmne pūjayet parameśvarī | na kadācid vinaśyanti gajāvṛddhiṃ prajāyate ||
kṛtvā caṃdana kāṣṭhānāṃ pratimāmaśca maṃdire | saṃpūjya parayābhaktyā na naśyati hayeśvarā ||
vṛddhimāyāntite nityaṃ sūryasyeva niveśanam | gogṛhe citraphalake citrayitvā samarcayet ||
vṛddhimāyāntite gāvā bahu pīyūṣadā sadā | dhānyakṣetrādike devi rājikāṃ saptamantritām ||
prakṣiped devadeveśi na kopi praviśet tataḥ | mahāśayyādi saṃpatyā vṛddhimāyāṃtite sadā ||
vāṇijyāya prakurvīta tatprokṣaṃ mantravāriṇā | tadā ca vikramaṃ yāntu sadāsaurya ca ye sadā ||
bālānāṃ śarṣyapāmaṃtrya baṃdhanīyāt sadāgale | vṛddhimāyākite bālā āyuṣmān prajñayā dṛḍhā ||
jyeṣṭhāhano vāhanasthā pūjyakāmānavāpnuyāt | yonyākāmayate devi vāhane mraṣṭukopari ||
atha kiṃ bahunoktena yadyat sādhi tu mutsahe | anya granthopacāreṇa tat tat sādhayate balāt ||
saptāviṃśati japtvā tu sarṣaṣākṣīra yoṣitām | saṃkāsthāne tu vikiret sāyaṃ prātastu saṃkaṭe ||

tatarutpadyate vegānnāgaloka gatā yadi | nidhāne parameśāni nirvighnamupatiṣṭhati ||
yatra yatra nidhisthāne japed vidyāṃ mahābalām | tatra tatra nidhiḥ sākṣādeti sādhakasattamam ||
japtvā cāṣṭasahasrantu sarvamantrāgramātaraḥ | parvatāgre maheśāni padmamaṣṭadalam likhet ||
juhuyādgugguluṃ sājyaṃ suprasannena cetasā | paścācchrī saṃmukhāgrantu maṃgalaṃ lokaviśrutam ||
dīpaparvaṇi deveśi rātrauhomaṃtryahasmṛtam | anantaraṃ viśet tatra nirbhayā gṛha ceṣṭavat ||
yatoyataḥ praviśati sādhakaḥ susahāyavān | tatastato viśīryake yantrānadyaśca śṛṃkhalā ||
unmādo jāyate tīvraṃ strīṇāṃ madanadīpanam | tataḥ praviṣṭapātāle strīṇāṃ svāmi bhaviṣyati ||
mahābhogabharāśakto bhaved brahmā purevasaḥ | athavā śrīmukhāgre tu japantiṣṭhanti niścalaḥ ||
dīpaparvaṇi vīrendra tadāgacchanti yoginaḥ | tābhiḥ sahaviśed devi pātālaṃ bhogasāgaram ||
pūrvavadbhogabhogī syāt sādhakaḥ sānugovalī | evaṃ pātāla saṃsiddhi priyamelāpamucyate ||
raktabhasmāpavītāṃgaḥ śragdāmābharaṇānvitam | madirānaṃda cetanyaḥ khaḍgamuṇḍakarānvitaḥ ||
hasan gāyanmudāvalgane vrajedvīravaraṃ gṛham | tatroccaranmahāvidyā vedimadhyagataḥ sudhīḥ ||
yāvat tṛsaptake devi tāvadā yānti devatāḥ | tāsāmarghyaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhitvāvāmāṃgamātmani ||
dattarghakhecaraḥ sākṣāt sādhakosau bhaviṣyati | yathāsau bhairavo devo nigrahānugrahakṣamaḥ ||
taddvaddevi na saṃdeho bhavatyeva hi sādhakaḥ | asyāḥ prabhāvamatulaṃ kalpakoṭyā yutāyutaiḥ ||
na ca varṇayituṃ śaktaṃ sohaṃ vaktrasahasrakaiḥ | ataḥ saṃkṣepataḥ khyātaḥ tava devi yathārthataḥ ||
sarvasaṃpatkaraḥ sāraḥ sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ | yathā vai brahmaṇā devi naranārāyaṇārcitam ||
vasiṣṭha hetostu purā sahasrākṣaramālikā | prakāśito devadevi tadvadeṣā prakīrtitā ||
iti rahasyamidaṃ tava sundari tridaśavarṇitametadalaṃ mayā | nigaditaṃ paramārtha vicitritaṃ satatameva jayadrathavatsale ||
na hi tadasti jagatrayamandire vividhavatsala dṛśā tava suṃdari | yadi hana prakṛti kṛtamaṃjasā tavamayā priya bhāṣiṇi hṛdgatām ||
iha tu kālikulārṇavamadhyato nigadita tridaśendra vilāsini | kramavicitra kalā pravicāritaḥ tama cireṇa guhāgatamadbhutam ||
tridaśaḍāmarayāgamahotsavaṃ kramaparaṃ mihayatkathitaṃ tava | atra mantra vipulāśa yadvato vidyate nikhila bhāvagocare ||
yo na kutra vidhirihopa varṇitā vīryabhāvavilayodayeśvarī | ṣaṭka metadupavarṇitaṃ mayā kālisaṃjñakamalaṃ sureśvari ||
viṃśatitridaśabhāga citrite bhūrikalpa śatavatsurārcitaḥ |

oṃ navatyadhika dviśatākṣaramālāmantra mātṝkānāṃ jayadrathoktānāṃ vivaraṇam ||

mantroddhāram ||

tryāhikaṃ vāḍamādevī cāturthakamathāpi vā | nāśayen nātra saṃdehaḥ saptāvarttena cottame ||

sthūlā sūkṣmā parādevi devī saṃsūcitā mayā | yā tvidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi guhyādguhyakulakrame ||
agrāhyā manasā vākyaiḥ kaivalyānaṃdanirbharāḥ | yogibhiḥ sūkṣmarūpasthā vidyāsaptādaśākṣarāḥ ||
śūkṣmā cintāsvarūpena manovyāpāradharmiṇī | mānasī siddhidā tuṣṭā sthūlasthā sādhakātmanām ||
prākṛtāvimano vākya dehakarma trikaḥ punaḥ | sthūlatvena samāsthāya phalaṃ yacchati yoginām ||
tasmāt sthūlā sthitā bhāgaistrikaiḥ sthūlā vasānakaiḥ | parādi dviśatānte tu navatyarṇādhike priye ||
mantradehā varṇadehā padadehāmaheśvari | tatvadehā ca yairjñātā teṣāṃ siddhirbhavatvalam ||
vighnaṃ vināśayet sarvaṃ tatvadehā yadā bhavet | padadehā mahāsiddhiṃ sādhakebhyaḥ prayacchati ||
varṇadehā mahāgauri jñātāsaṃnihitā bhavet | mantradehā mahāsphāra pūjāsiddhau ca saṃukhā ||
mantravarṇāṃghri tatvena yena bindati tatvataḥ | na teṣāṃ jāyate siddhirjaptvākoṭiśatairapi ||
ḍāmare kula jhaṃkāre tathā devi jayadrathe | vidhihīnā mayāproktā vedasaṃkhyā kulāmbikā ||
vidhihīnā na siddhyanti caturdehavivarjitā | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena satkriyaṃ dehamanyaset ||
gadidaṃ śaṃkarasyetthaṃ śrutvā bhairava vallabhā | pṛcchate bhairavī devī praṇipatyaśivaṃsatī ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
abhyudbhutamidaṃ vākyaṃ devākhyāhi mama prabhā | kāruṇyādvidhisaṃyuktaṃ nirvighnaṃ saṅgavarjitam ||
mantradehaṃ varṇadehaṃ padadehaṃ tṛtīyakam | tatvadeha caturthantu sasphūṭaṃ parameśvara ||
