śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu vīrendranamite rahasyamidamadbhutaṃ | yatnakasya cidākhyātaṃ catuḥpīṭhasamāgatam ||
divyarūpācca śrīkaṇṭhā dānavāccaiva rāvaṇāt | vibhīṣaṇācca dharmācca mahākaṃkāradhāriṇaḥ ||
jayadrathān mahātantrāt tathā jhaṃkāra bhairavāt | vibhīṣakāratantrācca tathā tridaśaḍāmarāt ||
atraguhyāśramasamyak śrīmatsiddhikulakrama | kāmapīṭhādi mārgeṇa pāraṃparya krameṇa tu ||
mantradehaṃ varṇadehaṃ padatatvadehasvarūpakam | vidhānaṃ cānuṇāhīnaṃ nyasyādyatsmāt kvacit kule ||
tasmāt pūrvaṃ pravakṣyāmi vidyāmantra mahodayam | sarvasiddhipradaṃ sarva siddhisaṃghairnnamaskṛtam ||
susame bhūpradeśe tu kuṃkumāgurucarcite | puṣpaprakarasaṃkīrṇe mahādvipārcciśobhite ||
mahādhūpādi saugaṃdha gaṃdhisaurabhapūrite | mahānaivedya saṃpūrṇe mahāpātrārcite śubhe ||
mahākaṃnyādi saccakra paramānandanirbhara | mahāṭṭahāsasaṃnāde nādite sajjanānvite ||
mahākuṃbhasamāyukte pūjite vastrakādibhiḥ | mahāvali padākīrṇe tṛptānaṃdamahāgaṇe ||
mahāyāgot savākīrṇe vīrabhasmacchaṭākule | mahācakrasamāveśa pariprāpte samādarāt ||
mahotsā khaṭikā yukta mantreṇa deśikottamaḥ | prārthitaḥ pūjitaḥ śiṣyairyathābhairavanāyakaḥ ||
śivādi gurusantāna vidaḥ śakti samanvitaḥ | caturddehakṛtābhyāsa abhinnaśaktivigrahaḥ ||
prokṣayitvā mahāpātramastramantraiḥ sa pīṭhakam | dakṣiṇasyāthavā saumya mukho deśika nāyakaḥ ||
caturasrantu ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaiḥ parisaṃmatam | tatra brahmadhruvaṃ datvā gṛhe dakṣiṇapṛṣṭhake ||
mahāvane yamāsyasthaścaturaṃgulamānataḥ | bhrāmayet tu tathā vṛttaṃ caturaṅgulamānataḥ ||
caturaṅgulamānena caturaṅgulamānataḥ | aṅgulaikapramāṇena punaścaiva tu paṃcakam ||
paścāt ṣoḍaśamānena dhruvaṃ kuryād yathā kramam | prathame karṇikākāryā vṛtte ca vasuparvikā ||
dvitīyakeśarālaṃ ca dalasaṃdhi tṛtīyake | caturthe ca dalā prāṇi vyomarekhā tu paṃcame ||
varṇamānāṃgulaṃ devi aṣṭapatraṃ samālikhet | tato varṇādayaṃ madhye keśarāle kadambakam ||
pūrvapatrasya mūle tu viśikhaṃ madhyake khagam | agremeghaṃ samālikhya maṃkasthaṃ īśakeśare ||
caṃdrahāsaṃ ca āgneyyāṃ kharapucchaṃ ca pūrvavat | gajarojhastathā nyasya aṃjanamīśamūlake ||
ṭaṃkahastamahāpīṭhaṃ vṛtaṃ rudakadaṇḍake | aṇḍasphoṭaṃ tathāśāne tārakaṃ kharakaṃ priye ||
mada baṃdhaṃ tathā nyasya īśāgre aṃkakaṃ punaḥ | padmanābhaṃ tathā rephaṃ rāvakuṃbhaṃ tathā jale ||
aṃbaraṃ saumyapatrārthe yogadaṃ ca calālaye | naraṃ balaṃ śavaṃ nyasya pūrvayuktyā mahojvalam ||
sambaraṃ saumyakeśasthaṃ puruṣaṃ ca mahaujasam | gakārādau ṇakārānte amṛtaṃ gagaṇadvaye ||
saṃlikhya ca tathā cānte dāruṇā binduśeṣaram | evaṃ dvayaṃ dvayaṃ nyasya svaradvādaśakaṃ kramāt ||
sarvakṣaya khakhāvṛttau saṃpūrṇaṃ śabdakārṇavam | pūrvāgrātpacchimaṃ yāvannavavarṇā vyavasthitā ||
āgneyyāṃ vāyavaṃ yāvadrūdhvavarṇābhavanti hi | dakṣiṇāduttarāgrānta grahavarṇā maheśvari ||
nair(-)ṛtyādīśa patrānta nābhavarṇāya śasvini | medhena sahitāḥ sarvadiśaṃ pratidiśaṃ guṇāḥ ||
yathā tathā bhavantyevaṃ kuryādāmnāya yogataḥ | akārādi visargāntāścaturviṃśati maṇḍalāt ||
bhavanti cakrarāje ca vidyāmantrodaya priye | devatā gaṃdhapūṣpādyairyugmakairvastracaṃdanaiḥ ||
ratnasvarṇaiḥ savicchedyaiḥ parāmṛtakulodbhavaiḥ | yasmāt samuddhared vidyāṃ aśeṣārtha pradāyinīm ||
etasmin cakrarājākhya śatārddhasvaraśobhite | pūjitā ca sadāśīghraṃ mahāsiddhiṃ prayacchati ||
sādhakasya mahādevi pratyaṅgirā mahaujasā | siddhilakṣmī mahācaṇḍā śivākhyā parameśvarī ||
[iti śrīmahākulakrame ḍāmare karavīrayoge vidyāmantrodayacakravarṇano nāmaprathama paṭalaḥ] || 1 ||
vidyāmantrodayaṃ cakraṃ śrutvā dvārasamanvitaḥ | punaḥ saṃpṛcchate devī vākyametat kulodayam ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
vidyāmantrodayasyānte kathamuddhriyate sphuṭam | aśeṣamantramātṝṇāṃ kāriṇāṃ tadvadasvame ||
devyānigaditaṃ śrutvā atiguhyatamaṃ mahat | provācedaṃ mahādevo ruddhāra vidhipūrvakam ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi vidyāprastāramadhyataḥ | urddhāraṣaṭkamāyātaṃ kīlahīna sa bhedakam ||
madhyasthaṃ varṇamuddhṛtya o au madhyāsane sthitam | jalapatrasya mūle tu vāyupatrasya mūlakam ||
adhaḥ krameṇa saṃyojya la ḹ madhyamalāṃcchitam | saumyāghraṃ mastakākrāntaṃ dīpanaṃ khecarodayam ||
śmaśānavāsināṃ bhadraṃ paṃcamudrāvidhāriṇīm | gakārād daśasaptantu navamadhyasamanvitam ||
kaulikaṃ dīpanaṃ yojyamucchutsvāṅgākhagaṅgatāḥ | gāḍimaṃtrādi saṃyuktaṃ nādimastakabhūṣitam ||
dīpakaṃ gṛhasasthānā śubhadaṃ brahmavarccasam | tridīpakasya madhye tu adhikārakrameṇa tu ||
yojayet kevalaṃ varṇaṃ prathamaṃ bījamuttamam | īśāgraṃ saumyapatrāgaṃ sapaṃcamasamanvitam ||
ṣamāttaṃbhamamadhyasthaṃ ṣaphamadhyaśiro jvaram | o au madhyasamuddhṛtya jakārādisamanvitam ||
ṛ ṝ madhyaṃ dakārāntaṃ yojitaṃ jādi bhūṣitam | paśamadhyasakārādi yojitaṃ dāraṇādimam ||
dāraṇāntasamāyuktamīśāgraṃjāttasaṃyutam | haramadhyena saṃyuktaṃ pūrvāgrāt navamahyadhaḥ ||
e catuṣka samāyuktaṃ dvipāntarakasaṃyutam | saumyāgraṃ dāraṇākrāntaṃ ṭhāntādhastaṃ samuddharet ||
dāraṇāṣṭamavarṇena saṃyuktaṃ rudramaṃ punaḥ | dvipāntaṃ dvitayaṃ paścād daśamaṃ hrasva yojitam ||
hathamadhyaharāntena yuktasādi vibhūṣitaḥ | ṛ ṝ madhyaṃ jakārādi yuktaṃ ca paṭamadhyagam ||
gakārāntasamāyuktaṃ dvitīyaṃ kevalaṃ likhet | ṛ ṝ madhyadvitīyena bheditaṃ ca dvitīyakam ||
aṣṭāviṃśajakārādi bheditaṃ ca samuddharet | ṣadviṃśati tathā yojyaṃ lāntena haramadhyagam ||
o au madhyaṃ caṇḍamadhyaṃ varadhūkhahamadhyagam | gakārasya rasāśaktaṃ ekārāntaṃ samuddharet ||
iha madhya khakārordhaṃ vahnisaptasamanvitam | ghamamadhyaṃ gakārāntaṃ yojitaṃ haramadhyagam ||
dāraṇāntasamāyuktaṃ cādigāntasamanvitam | rāsanaṃ e tṛtīyena yojitaṃ pacchimāgrakam ||
indramadhyajalāntasthaṃ pādidhāntasamanvitam | sādādyena samāyuktaṃ kaṭamadhyasamuddharet ||
īśamadhyāsane yojya yamapatrasya madhyagam | visargapaṃcamākrāntaṃ gāntaṃ khādho niyojayet ||
jalasthaṃ keśaraṃ gāntaṃ yojitaṃ vāyumadhyagam | sāntānte sayutaṃ vāyu keśaraṃ nāśanasthitam ||
olamadhyena saṃyuktaṃ caturthakeśaraṃ likhet | ṛ ṝ madhye halāntena saṃyuktaṃ haṭhamadhyagam ||
ghādhontena samāyukta mādyaṃ khaṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam | ṣaṭpaṃcāsākṣaraṃ devi brahmasaṃjñaṃ sumātṛkam ||
vidyārūpeṇa sthūlākhyamaśeṣa samayapradam | mātṛkāvṛndamelāpa kārakaṃ mātṝnāyakam ||
vidhānavihitaṃ devi dīpakaṃ punaruddharet | uḍamadhyatridhākṛtvā saumya patrāgrasaṃyutam ||
lāsa(?)naṃdāpayecchādyaṃ gakārasya tu paṃcamam | jātāntaṃ ca dvitīyasya gakārāntaṃ trikasya ca ||
rathamadhyavanāntena gapaṃcatrikamaṇḍitam | vyomarekhāgataṃ varṇaṃ sādi saumyāgrasaṃyutam ||
kha ha madhyaphapāntasthaṃ sādisaumyāgrasaṃyutam | īśāgraṃ caiva saumyāgraṃ nādharāntenasaṃyutam ||
etaddvitīyakaṃ khaṇḍaṃ viṣṇusaṃjñaṃ prakīrtitam | mantrākṣaṃ sarvasiddhyarthaṃ mādhakaṃ navavarṇakam ||
punaruddhṛtya deveśi dīpakaṃ vidhivadyathā | prāk ṣaṭkaṃ saptamaṃ vāyau yamasya navamaṃ priye ||
nair(-)ṛtyāt paṃcamaṃśādi saṃyutaṃ dakṣiṇāṣṭamam | ājamadhyena cākrāntaḥ īśāgraṃ ca maheśvari ||
punarevasamuddhṛtya cābhādyaṃ tantrikānvitam | īgamadhyena cākrāntaṃ rākṣasasyāṣṭamaṃ likhet ||
navamaṃ yamapatrasya gayugmena vibhūṣitam | a ā madhyaṃ samuddhṛtya vahnisaptārddhalāṃcchitam ||
ṛ ṝ madhyalakārādi bheditaṃ ḷ ḹ madhyagam | jhādharādi samāyuktaṃ o au madhyāsanasthitam ||
vanamadhyasakārādi saṃyutaṃ jalakeśaram | punastadevacorddhādhaḥ sasthitaṃ bhasamadhyagam ||
ṭatāntalādharārūḍhaṃ pahamadhyavanāntagam | ghanāntaṃ jādisaṃyuktaṃ dvātriśāntaṃ trikaṃ likhet ||
ṛ ṝ madhye ḍakārādi saṃyutaṃ yādijādinā | pādigāntasamāyuktamūdamadhyaṃ punarlikhet ||
rañtra madhyaṃ haṭhāntādhaḥ khaphamadhye lasaṃyutam | la ḹ madhyena saṃyuktaṃ dakṣābjaṃ nāstamaṃ likhet ||
e ai madhye maghāntaṃ ca gatrikena samanvitam | o au madhye paṃcamaṃ ca gāntena saṃyutaṃ likhet ||
pha ha madhye dhathāntaṃ ca i ga madhyasamanvitam | saumyāgraṃ pacchimāgrasthaṃ ai sa madhyena bheditam ||
ṭabhamadhye jhādharādyena ṭāntaṃ phāntaṃ la saptamam | jhādharādhyena saṃyuktaṃ dvātriṃśāntaṃ trikaṃ likhet ||
mahāntaṃka caturthantu ṭhacaturthāsanasthitam | ṭhādiyuktaṃ pha hāntantu ṣādipīṭhe vyavasthitam ||
navāntaṃ ca ṭha phāntaṃ ca īśajādi samanvitam | ḷ ḹ madhye lakārādibhāditaṃ lorddhajādi ca ||
igamadhye a ā madhye cāsane jāsane sthitam | igamadhyena cākrāntaṃ a ā madhye punarlikhet ||
kāntasya āsanaṃ khāntaṃ kayamadhye samālikhet | o au madhyapunardeyaṃ dvitīyantu samuddharet ||
horddhaṃ rorddhaṃ samuddhṛtya a ā madhyāsana sthitam | punareva dvidhālikhya ghādikhādi dvayaṃ likhet ||
phāntaṃ ḍādi samāyuktaṃ bhādyaṃ jādisamanvitam | layamadhyagakārādi saṃyuktaṃ śorddhakaṃ likhet ||
pādikhādisamāyuktaṃ bhamamadhyaṃ gakārādi | pāntagāntasamāyuktaṃ dhāntanemi sthitaṃ punaḥ ||
īśāntaṃ jādisaṃyuktaṃ saumyāgravidhivallikhet | nādyaṃ mādhaṃ lakārorddhaṃ saṃyutaṃ ṣorddhagaṃ punaḥ ||
samamadhyerthavālaika dhādhuraṃ lādhalāṃcchitam | punarevantu vidhivat cchādyaṃgāntasamanvitam ||
śaṭamadhyajakārādi saṃyutaṃ ca punardvidhā | pādyaṃ dādisamāyuktaṃ nādharaṃ ḍāntasaṃyutam ||
lādilārddhasamāyuktamīśāgraṃ vilikhet punaḥ | jalāgraṃ jādisaṃyuktamīśāgraṃ dhādhare sthitam ||
evaṃ dvidhāsamuccārya khaṭhāntaṃ jādināhatam | īśāgraṃ pādharārūḍhaṃ punareva dvidhā kuru ||
gādharaṃ dakṣamadhyaṃ ca pūrvamadhyoparisthitam | lādyenasaṃyutaṃ kṛtvā īśānāgraṃ samālikhet ||
pādyagānta samāyuktaṃ u ū madhye halāntagam | etat trikaṃ samālikhya ṭhāḍhyalāḍhyasamanvitam ||
ṛ ṝ madhyahalāntaṃ ca punaretattrikaṃ likhet | pādyāntaṃ gāntasaṃyuktaṃ mādyathorddhapagāntagam ||
ekatra yojayedgātraṃ saṃyutaṃ mādimaṃ punaḥ | īśāgrasyāsane nāghaṃ navamadhye punarlikhet ||
dvātriṃśāntaṃ trikaṃ paścādvanamadhyamaghāntimam | lāntāntasaṃyutaṃ lādhaṃ dādhaṃ gāntrasamanvitam ||
hana madhye mādharasthaṃ dorddhaṃ yāntatrikaṃ punaḥ | vidhivacca samuccāryya oṃ kārāntaṃ trike trikam ||
cādimaṃgāntayā krāntaṃ lādharaṃ ḍādisaṃyutam | īśāntaṃ gatrikākrāntaṃ cādimaṃ cādisaṃyutam ||
tricatvāriṃśāntatrikaṃ pādyaṃ jādi pādyādisaṃyutam | nādyaṃ madhyaṃdyagāntena saṃyutaṃ paścimāgrakam ||
olamadhyena cākrāntaṃ phāntaṃ bhāntaṃ layāntagam | ḍādyenasaṃyutaṃ tāntraṃ bhādyaṃ gāntasamanvitam ||
phāntajādisamāyuktaṃ ādharaṃ jādisaṃyutam | ṭāntadāḍisamāyuktaṃ ṛ ṝ madhyemaghāntagam ||
mādyaṃ khāntaṃ maghāntaṃ ca saumyajādisamanvitam | hathāntaṃ lādisaṃyuktaṃ dvātriśāntaṃ trikaṃ likhet ||
lādyaṃ mādyaṃ thahāntena lādhareṇa samanvitam | nādyagāntena saṃyuktaṃ pādyanāntena saṃyutam ||
phādharaṃ lādharārūḍhaṃ mādharaṃ thādharaṃ ṛdham | dyādyaṃ mādyakaṭānte ca khāntārūḍhaṃ parānugam ||
la ḷ madhyena rākrāntaṃ lādi vā ṛ ṝ madhyagam | mādyaṃjādisamāyuktaṃ jādyaṃ cchāśāgramīyutam ||
dvitīyasya tṛkaṃ bījaṃ tridhākuryāt phahāntakam | phāntāsanamasārūḍhomādharaṃ jāntasaṃyutam ||
ṛ ṝ madhyavanāntaṃ ca dhādharaṃ norddhagaṃ paraḥ | gātvena saṃyutaṃ kṛtvā pādyaṃ ḍādyena bhūṣitam ||
layāntaṃ igamadhyena ṇādimastakabhūṣitam | khādharaṃ ḍādisaṃyuktaṃ ādharaṃ iḍamadhyagam ||
evaṃ dvikaṃ samuccārya o au madhye vaḍādinā | phāntagāntasamāyuktaṃ punarevadvidhā kuru ||
antastha kevalaṃ kṛtvā khādharaṃ ghādi śādinā | khahāntaṃ gādisaṃyuktaṃ auna madhyena saṃyutam ||
dvitīyasya dvitīyaṃ ca evaṃ yantrasamuddharet | tṛtīyasya tṛtīyaṃ ca rādyaṃ tādyasamanvitam ||
trividhaṃ patitaṃ datvā mādyāmādi samanvitam | igamadhyena saṃyuktaṃ madhyegāntena saṃyutam ||
paṃcaviṃśādhikaṃ varṇagaṇaṃ ca dviśataṃ matam | mantrākhyaṃ rudranāmānaṃ parāvidyā bhidhānakam ||
tṛtīyaṃ kathitaṃ khaṇḍaṃ vidyāmantrodayottarāt | tribhiḥ khaṇḍaistu militā vidyā bheda vibheditāḥ ||
rudraiḥ śatadvayaṃ caiva navatyedhika śobhanaiḥ | siddhasiddhiprabhedena vilomātha kvacit smṛtāḥ ||
mahākāruṇi ceti dedevīti kvacit smṛtāḥ | māyālakṣmī vilomasthā trihaṃsa paṃcapiṇḍakam ||
ambena tu kvacit proktā cchindirityādi kutracit | yena yena prabhedena yuktā saṃsavyate satī ||
tena tena phalaṃ yacchet sādhakasyapidhasya ca | eṣāvidyā mahāvidyā nāmnā trailokyamohanī ||
lakṣmīśvarīti vikhyātā bahubhogabharāvahā | mahālakṣmī mahākrāntā sarvasaubhāgyadāyinī ||
alakṣmī samanījñeyā duṣṭadāridramarddanī | kaliduḥsvapnaśamanī abhyupadravanāśinī ||
rājopasargasamanī duṣṭadasyavighaṭṭinī | pratyaṅgirāmahābhadrā siddhalakṣmī mahodayā ||
caṇḍākhyā caṇḍasaṃhatṝ śivākhyā śivadāyinī | guhyeśvarī kamalākhyā mātṛmaṇḍalavāsinī ||
kālasaṃkarṣaṇī nāmnā gaurīrakṣaṇanāmikā | mahākālībharāśāntā mahābhairavavallabhā ||
brahmavyūhakṣayātīvrā mahārudravalapradā | vidyādehā varṇadehā padadehā maheśvarī ||
tatvadehāsamuddhāryā mālāgarbhasya garbhitā | itthamuddhripate devi vidyāmantrodayāntare ||
narāṇāṃ svādhikāreṇa pādadātīpsitaṃ phalam ||
[iti śrīmahākulakrame mahākaravīrayāge vidyoddhāro nāma dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 2 ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
śrūtaṃ devasamuddhāraṃ vidyāmantrodayāntare | adhunā śrotumicchāmi caturddehasusiddhitam ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi varṇadehamahodayam | pāraṃparya kramāyātamaprāpyaṃ mandabhājinām ||
siddhisaṃtānajātānāṃ siddhānāmihajanminām | narāṇāṃ caiva nārīṇāṃ bhaktānāṃ sulabhākule ||
sthāne mānorame mantrī kulasaṃbhārasaṃyutam | uddharenmaṇḍalantatra sarvakāmaphalodayam ||
ekavīrābhidhānaṃ vā yāmalendramathāpi vā | rajasā paṃcavarṇena mahāśoṇādibhiśca vā ||
tato guruṃ namaskṛtya arghapātrapuraḥsaraḥ | recakakādigatiṃ kṛtvā vīravīgrahamaṇḍale ||
padmāsane sthito yogī cintayen mantravigrahām | hṛtpadmakarṇikāmadhye śrībījaprakaṭī kṛte ||
sattārūpā smaret tatra mahādvīpakamaṇḍale | tatotpannāṃ smareccaṇḍāṃ mantrayogasamanvitām ||
pūrvavaktraṃ smaret pūrvaṃ rudravarṇairyathā sthitam | grahākhyairdakṣiṇaṃ tasyā dvādaśairuttaraṃ tathā ||
rudravarṇaistathā prācyaṃ diśāvarṇaiḥ khamasthitam | bhrūmadhyahṛdaye nābhau tadyathā cakramā smaret ||
mukhemāṃbā manāśāyāṃ dakṣiṇe ca tṛtīyakam | vāmadakṣiṇa netre ca paṃcamāntayugantathā ||
vāmadakṣiṇakarṇe dve liṃge caiva guḍenavam | saptarṇairhṛdayaṃ tasyāḥ tathā caiva śiromatam ||
digvarṇaiścaśikhāraudrā dvādaśāntaiśca puṅgalam | grahākhyai netrasaṃdohaṃ āyuni ca tathā viduḥ ||
paṃcārṇai sthānayeddevīṃ mūrddhau vā maṇḍalethavā | hasa yugmaṃ hasantītāṃ paśyedanugrahātmikām ||
caturbhimantrajāṃ siddhiṃ yacchantīṃ cintayedgirām | kapālaṃ cintayet tasyā rudrārṇaiḥ pānapūritam ||
dvādaśāntaiśca khaṭvāṃgaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ trikānvitam | aṣṭakaiścintayecchūlaṃ saptakaiśca mahātvasi ||
ṣadbhiḥ pāśaṃ kare tasyā aṃkuśaṃ ca tathā viduḥ | ekovaviṃśakairddānaṃ saptakaiścābhayaṃ śubham ||
ciṃtayet kandalaṃ divyaṃ varṇaiścaiva caturddalaiḥ | tathā paṃcadaśairvarṇairghaṭaṃ saṃcintyapūritam ||
mahārudrāśanaṃ cāṣṭau rudrākhyaiḥ śvetasaṃnibhām | adhorddhasphāratejaughāṃ cintayecca tribhiḥ kramāt ||
ekonaviṃśakairvarṇairmahāmudrāprabaṃdhanam | caṃdrāgnibhāskare puṣpaistribhirbījaiḥ prapūjayet ||
khādakena tridhāpādā svāhākāreṇa bhājanam | saṃcintyaparamāṃ devīṃ mūrtisthāṃ mantravigrahām ||
varṇadehācca visphārya bhāvābhāvapadāntagān | kaṃdātkuṇḍalinī cakrānmadhyavṛrtti svarūpataḥ ||
varṇasvarūpamākhyātaṃ śvetādiguṇasaṃbhavam | viprādi saṃbhavaṃ vāpi akārādi tathāpi vā ||
viriṃcādyaṣṭajātisthaṃ aṣṭadhācāpyanekadhā | anekāṣṭakabhedena avarṇe varṇarūpakam ||
śivaśaktimahānādo biṃdūdendabhagālayam | avarṇādi tridhābhinnaṃ vidyāmantrodayābjagam ||
tacca hṛdvāmajalajaṃ tatra śvetādi vigraham | varṇākhaṃ saṃsmared devyāḥ sarvavarṇaprakāśakam ||
jyeṣṭhāṅgabāhu hṛtpārśva kaṭipādāvaśānakam | bahubheda mahāsphāra jñātvā sarvaṃ prakalpayet ||
viriṃcādi tathā cāṣṭa dehabhūtaṃ hi cāṣṭakam | śivavarṇamabhedena śaktiṃ caiva vicintayet ||
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśāṃ paṃcāsyāṃ daśabāhukām | mahārudrāsanārūḍhāṃ sudehāṃ varṇavigrahām ||
nīlakuntaladhṛtendu japamukuṭamaṇḍitām | nānāratnamahāhāra kādyamaṇḍita śekharām ||
śitaśonyaśitā raktaśveta khādiramujvalā | nānāratnasamāyuktāṃ susamāsthiṃ sukuṇḍalām ||
sūryabimbāruṇākāra tripaṃcanayanojvalām | īṣaddhāsya lalajjihvā daṃṣṭrāśobhi mukhojvalām ||
nānādaityādi sadduṣṭa kaṇṭhekaṃ dalamālinīm | anekaratnanirmāṇa ṭāraghṛṣṭonnatastanām ||
trivalītaraṅgaśobhāḍhyāṃ madhyakṣāmādarāṃ śubhām | kiṃkiṇī jālasadvastra vyāghrāṃśu kaṭibhūṣaṇām ||
varāsi śūlakādyaṃ ca muṇḍaṃ dakṣe kare dhṛtam | abhīkhaṭvāṅga satpātraṃ baṃdhanaṃ kalaśottaraiḥ ||
vīraghaṃṭāṃśukā sphāra jānuyugmasuśobhitām | ghargharī nūpurārāva bhūṣitaṃ caraṇa dvayam ||
suśvetasya trinetrasya dvibhujaika mukhasya ca | skaṃdhe rudrasya cārūḍhā vīrāsanasthitasya ca ||
jvalatpāvakasaṃkāśaṃ jvālāsamūhasaṃghakam | romakūpācca niryāntaṃ gagaṇaṃ cāruṇopamam ||
mātryaṣṭakasya madhyasthāṃ paṃcāsyāṃ kāṣṭhayānvitām | bahusiddhi samākīrṇāṃ siddhāyogini pūjitām ||
ekavīrāṃ smaredvātha ghaṃṭā hasta ghaṭānvite | caṇḍāmbā śivapṛṣṭhe ca kartikā kheṭadhāriṇī ||
dānābhayakarābhyāṃ ca śivāmbā kheṭakaṃ vinā | mahālakṣmī mayīmbātha abhaye cintitārthadām ||
itthaṃ mūrtiraśekaiśca bhāvabhedairmaheśvarī | śitāsyaṃ paṃcakairvātha yuktānāgendrabhūṣaṇām ||
atisaumyātidragrā ca varṇadehasvarūpataḥ | dhyātvāvarṇātma yogena padadehamatho bhavet ||
tryakṣaram tu padaṃ cādyaṃ śirodeśeṣu vinyaset | daśākṣaraṃ dvitīyantu lalāṭa taṭamaṇḍalam ||
navākṣaraṃ tṛtīyaṃ hi nāśāvaṃśogra yogataḥ | daśākṣaraṃ caturthantu vāmanetravyavasthitam ||
ekādaśākṣaraṃ devi paṃcamaṃ dakṣai locane | caturbhiḥ ṣaṣṭhamaṃ proktaṃ tṛtīya netramaṇḍale ||
saptamaṃ ṣaṣṭhavarṇaṃ tu vāmagaṇḍe vyavasthitam | trivarṇe cāṣṭamaṃ devi dakṣiṇe gaṇḍamaṇḍale ||
padāṣṭakairbhaveccādyaṃ brahmākhaṃḍābhidhānavam | yāmalāṣṭakasaṃvyāptā layādiyogayojitaḥ ||
ekavarṇaṃ bhaveccādyaṃ vāmakarṇe vyavasthitam | kaivalyārṇa dvitīyantu dakṣiṇaśravaṇe nyaset ||
caṃdrāntārṇa tṛtīyantu adharoṣṭhe vyavasthitam | caturthaṃ śivavarṇantu uttaroṣṭhe vyavasthitam ||
paṃcamaṃ śitavarṇaṃ tu adhodanteṣu sākṣiṇaḥ | ekavarṇaṃ bhavatyaṣṭaṃ ūrddhadantālimaṇḍale ||
saptamaṃ kevalaṃ varṇaṃ jihvāyāṃ savyavasthitam | aṣṭamaṃ pakṣavarṇastu samastamukhamaṇḍale ||
padāṣṭakairdvitīyedaṃ viṣṇukhaṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam | sidhyaṣṭakasamutthānaṃ śaktyaṣṭakapadānugam ||
saptavarṇaṃ punaścādyaṃ kaṇḍamadhye vidhīyate | ṣadvarṇantu dvitīyaṃ syād vāmaskaṃdhe tu vinyaset ||
tṛtīyaṃ daśavarṇaiśca vāmavāhau vyavasthitām | trayodaśaiścaturthantu vāme ca maṇibaṃdhake ||
navākhaiḥ paṃcamaṃ devi vāmahastāṃgulīṣu ca | ṣaṣṭhamaṃ raṃdhravarṇaiśca vāmāṃgulinakheṣu ca ||
saptamaṃ saptavarṇaiśca dakṣaskaṃdheṣu vinyaset | aṣṭamaṃ ca caturvarṇairbāhordakṣiṇake nyaset ||
navamaṃ ca caturvarṇairdakṣiṇe maṇibaṃdhake | ekādaśaistu daśamaṃ dakṣapāśyāṃgulīṣu ca ||
ekādaśastu navakairdakṣāṃgulinakheṣu ca | dvādaśaṃ tu caturvarṇairnyasevudaramaṇḍale ||
trayodaśaṃ tathāṣṭākhyaistanye vāme prakīrtitāḥ | caturddaśa caturvarṇairdakṣastaneṣu vinyaset ||
tripaṃca navavarṇaiśca kṣīve ca vāmadakṣayāḥ | ṣoḍaśaṣaṣṭhavarṇaiśca nāḍimadhye vyavasthitam ||
saptādaśonaviṃśaistu nyaset kālānalālaye | aṣṭādaśaṃ saptavarṇairyoni madhye vayavasthitam ||
caturbhirekonaviṃśañca vinyased guḍamaṇḍalam | viṃśamaṃ daśavarṇaiśca nyased vāmasphikastaṭe ||
aṣṭakaireka viṃśākhyaṃ dakṣiṇeva sphive nyaset | dvāviṃśaṃ saptavarṇaiśca vāmārausavyavasthitam ||
aṣṭābhiśca trayoviṃśadvāmārāvadha vinyaset | ekādaśaiścaturviṃśadvāmajānau vyavasthitam ||
paṃcaviṃśatibhirvarṇairvāmagulpha niyojayet | aṣṭābhiścaiva ṣaṭviṃśadgulphau caiva tu dakṣiṇe ||
caturbhiḥ saptaviṃśaistu vāmapādāṃgulīṣu ca | aṣṭāviṃśasaptavarṇai dehapādāṃgulīṣu ca ||
ūnatriṃśacaikavarṇairdakṣora adhare nyaset | triṃśamaṃ śivavarṇena dakṣajānau vyavasthitam ||
ekatriṃśattathaikena pāde caiva tu dakṣiṇe | dvātriṃśantu tribhirvarṇairvāmapādāṃgulīṣu ca ||
tribhirvarṇaistrayastriṃśat pṛṣṭhavaṃśe vyavasthitam | gurupadeśavarṇaiśca catustriṃśatimaṃ padam ||
śaktisthānācchivaṃ yāvanmudrārupeṇa vinyaset | catustriṃśatpadaṃ proktaṃ rudrakhaṇḍaṃ tṛtīyakam ||
śuddhavarṇātha saṃdhyāna mahāsiddhiphalapradaḥ | tribhirekatrayogena śatārddhapadakaṃ bhavet ||
dehadevyāḥ suniḥpannaṃ tatvavyāptimakhaṇḍitam | tatvavyāpti prabhedena tatvadehaṃ vadāmyaham ||
tridehaṃ yogasaṃdhāna kāraṇaṃ vahusiddhidam | brahmakhaṇḍe nātmatatvaṃ kālānalārddha maṇḍale ||
vinyasen mukhasaṃdhāne kāraṇa bahudhāhitam | dvitīye khaṇḍakaṃ nābhi maṇḍalārddhakajopari ||
ṣaḍaṃgayogasaṃdhāna kāraṇaṃ guṇadāyakam | rudrakhaṇḍatṛtīyantu śivatatvapadānugām ||
mūrtyāsanasya saṃdhyānaṃ kāraṇaṃ mantrasiddhidam | rudragrahārkarudrāśā sṛṣṭyārṇairmukhapaṃcamam ||
kṛṣṇāsakarṣaṇī caṇḍā śivāpratyaṃgirābhidhā | saptaṣaddaśakāmaiśca graharaṃdhrān ṣaḍaṃgakaiḥ ||
sarvajñādi tribhiryuktaṃ kalpayed vividhakramāt | sarvajñatātha tṛptiśca anādi bodhameva ca ||
svatantratā luptaśaktiranantaścet purāmataḥ | hṛcchiraśca śikhāvarma netrādastraṣadaṃgakam ||
namaḥ svāhā tathā vaṣaṭ hūṃ vauṣaṭ phaṭtrikaṃ tathā | haseti dviguṇaṃpīṭha sadāśiva puraḥsaram ||
tṛtīyakhaṇḍaviṃśena mūrti tasyāḥ padena tu | mantrakhaṇḍaṃ bhavenmantraṃ saptādaśaprabhedakam ||
nirmalaṃ kathitaṃ gauri caturdehavivarṇanam | dīpakādyantasaṃyuktaṃ yojayen manasā hṛdi ||
pūjayecca yathā nyāyaṃ tato mudrāṃ virecayet | tataśca svāśanapīṭhaṃ mūrtiṃ cātmani vinyaset ||
mantreṇa caiva cātmānaṃ pūjayecca yathā vidhi | tatastalau samāstreṇa sapṛṣṭho nati mudrayā ||
kaniṣṭhikau pūraskṛtya pīṭhakaṃ saṃpravinyaset | kaniṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ vāmāvartaparibhramāt ||
ekaikaṃ mūrtivarṇantu vinyasedupadeśataḥ | kaniṣṭhikau puraskṛtya paṃcakaṃ ṣaṭṭasaptakau ||
talayorvāmadakṣe ca vāmapṛṣṭhatalāṣṭamam | navamaṃ dakṣapṛṣṭhaṃ ca natyāmantranayasmaret ||
aṃguṣṭhakau pūraskṛtya kaniṣṭhāntānanaṃ nyaset | kaniṣṭhikau puraskṛtya syāntādi paṃcakaṃ nyaset ||
astrapṛṣṭhatalābhyāntu nyaṣṭvākhaṇḍatrayaṃ smaret | mastake kaṇṭhahṛnnābhau saṃkare cāśanaṃ nyaset ||
guḍādi trisamedhādi brahmānta mūrtivarṇakam | guḍaguhye mukhe karṇe netranāsādi bhedataḥ ||
vāmādikramayogena mantrarūpaṃ pravinyaset | golake caiva vāhāgre dakṣavāmaśruti pathe ||
śikhādheyā nibhaṃgena vinyasen mukhapaṃcakam | hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ nyasya śiraḥ śirasi vinyaset ||
śikhāyāntu śikhānyasya tanutre dehamaṇḍale | tribindumudrā netraṃ ca astrenāstraṃ diśāsu ca ||
tritatvaṃ ca nyaset paścā cchivādi kramayogataḥ | padaṃ nyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryādvarṇabhūtaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ||
mantradehaṃ tataḥ paścānmudrābhiḥ paripūritam | tato vidyāṃ smaret sarvāṃ vidyārūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ ||
vaṃdhayed vividhā mudrā yena saṃpūrṇatāṃ vrajet | itthaṃ deha catuṣkantu vinyasya sādhakeśvaraḥ ||
astrapūrva yathā yāgaṃ kuryāttathā vadāmyaham | astreṇakṣālitaṃ pātraṃ hṛdāsurādi pūritam ||
gunthitantu tanutreṇa netranaivāmṛtīkṛtam | rakṣitantu mahāstreṇa sthāpitaṃ hṛdayena tu ||
guhyamudrāprayogena śikhāyā ca pradīpitam | pūjayedāsanaṃ madhye mūrtimantrāsanāṃśakaiḥ ||
khaṇḍatrayenasaṃpūjya uparyupariyogataḥ | tatastu pūjayen madhye gāyatrīṃ surapūjitām ||
caturviṃśākṣarā devi tāṃ ca te kathayāmyaham | saumyāgraṃ madhyamūrdhnisthaṃ layamadhyavibhūṣitam ||
ītrikena samāyuktaṃ prathamaṃ bījanāyakam | saumyāgramadhyamaṃ gāntaṃ yutaṃ māḍhānta ṛtrikam ||
mādimaṃ jādisaṃyuktaṃ ṛ ṝ madhyena saṃyutam | madhyalādi samayuktaṃ bījāntaṃ dvitayaṃ punaḥ ||
kāntaṃ bādhaṃ javedāḍhyaṃ jādiyuktaṃ phalāgrakam | pūrvasvareṇasaṃyuktaṃ nai(-)ṛtyāgragrapaṃcabhṛt ||
dahīnau pūrvapādau ca bījānta dvitayaṃ punaḥ | saptamaṃ keśaraṃ jādi śādimaṃdādisaṃyutam ||
layāntaṃ pacchimakeśāḍhyaṃ kāntasādi samanvitaḥ | ṛ ṝ madhye halāntaṃ ca na kārāntenasaṃyutam ||
eṣā tridhā tataḥ paścāt puṣpādānanda yā tridhā | astramantrenasaṃsicya guṇṭhanādya samācaret ||
guṇṭhanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ caiva amṛtīkaraṇaṃ tathā | tanutreṇāpi mantreṇa cakṣuṣā ca krameṇa tu ||
tato nandi mahākālaṃ tathā bhṛṃgivināyakam | vṛṣaskaṃdaṃ śriyaṃ caṇḍaṃ pūrvādau dvāripūjayet ||
novā vyāghramajāṃ bhadrāṃ karṇāṃsanā balī calām | vajinī saumyaparyantaṃ dvāradvārayugaṃyugam ||
gaṇeśambāmbikāyuktaṃ śrīputraṃ ca tathaiva ca | saṃpūjya cāstrakādyantaṃ mantreṇānena dāpayet ||
sadāśivādyau dvau varṇau nāmakaṃ śaktinā sadā | nabhyante vātha vādāntaṃ pūjayedupadeśataḥ ||
tataścāntaṃ śivāntaṃ ca sārddhaṃ dvitayamakṣaram | dvārānta dehalī sthāne sthāpayet kusumānvitaḥ ||
tataḥ pṛṣṭhahalāntaṃ ca vāyvādau gurusantati | puṣpādau pūjayed devi dīpādau cāccivarṇakaiḥ ||
guruvat pūjayeccādau paramaṃ tadanantaram | parameṣṭhinaṃ tṛtīyantu pūrvācāryaṃ tathaiva ca ||
anādi siddhisaṃjñāśca paṃcamaṃ saṃprapūjayet | sthānakena tato rakṣet puruṣaṃ vāstunāyakam ||
svakramaṃ gurudevānāṃ vahnikoṇe samarcayet | tata anādi saṃpūjya svagurornāmapūrvakam ||
ye bhūtā vividhākārā divi bhūmyantarīkṣagāḥ | pātālatalasaṃsthāśca śivabhāgeṣu bhāvitā ||
dhruvādi sarvabhūteṣu tṛptiṃ labhanti te sadā | sārddhaṃ ślokena puṣpāḍhyaṃ puṣpānāṃ hṛtamudrayā ||
dīpakaṃ saumyamadhyasthaṃ palāntastha ca māditaḥ | ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca saptamaṃ cādyaṃ gāyatryāḥ ṣaṭtrikātrikam ||
hṛdayaṃ tridaśāntaṃ ca gāyatryā tritayaṃ punaḥ | kaṃnyakādi caturdadyād gāyatryante catuṣṭayam ||
caturviṃśākṣarā proktā gāyatryeṣā surāsurāḥ | triruccāraprayogena prokṣayet karṇikā dalam ||
brahmādyāścaiva śakrādyā yāmalena prapūjayet | amṛtādyā tathā cāṣṭā vīṇāntaṃ kramaśothavā ||
kevalaṃ vāsanaṃ japtvā mūrti cāvāhayet tataḥ | caturdeha vibhāgena tato mantreṇa pūjayet ||
bhogāṃgane yathā śaktyā vahnyādau vā purāditaḥ | ekavīrā vidhānena yajed dvāracatuṣṭayam ||
gurukramaṃ tathā pīṭhaṃ mūrtiścaiva caturvidhā | āvāhya vidhivanmantrairyoni saṃsthāpanī tathā ||
sannidhānāṃ sannirodhāṃ sanmukhīkaraṇantathā | triśūlaṃ ca ṣaḍaṅgena kramaśaḥ saṃpradarśayet ||
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca arghakhaṇḍaistribhiḥ kramāt | atragaṃdhaṃ tathā puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpaṃ ca pāraṇam ||
naivedyā casanaṃ caiva tāmbūlaṃ darpaṇaṃ tathā | prīṇanaṃ mūrdhnavaktrādi astrānte tu samācaret ||
tato mudrāmahāmudrā guhyamudrātṛtīyakam | astramudrāvadaśadhā pradarśyasaṃjayaṃ bhavet ||
mahākaṃ vṛkṣasūtreṇa sphāṭikanāthavā priye | rudrākṣanāthāśaṃkhena śatārddhādi vibhāgaśaḥ ||
daśāṃśena ṣaḍaṅgāni prasīdeti samarpyayet | tato homārthato gacchedvahnyārīśe ca saumyake ||
pūrvavāso bhavasthāne saṃprārthyakulamātaram | saṃskṛtiṃ kārayet tatra asaṃskṛtimasiddhidam ||
vṛttasya vā ṣaḍasre vā trikonasyāthavā priye | catasrasyātha padmasya meṣalā triyutasya ca ||
samābhiskaṃdhayuktasya kaṇṭhopakaṇṭhaśobhitaḥ | hādikādyānta hastāntaṃ pramānasya samasya ca ||
sthaṃḍilollaṃghitasyāpi vīrabhasmādibhiḥ priye | kuṇḍasya daśasaṃskārā tāḍanādīni kārayet ||
tāḍanaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ caiva ullaṣaṇamataḥ param | uddhāraṃ sevanaṃ caiva astramātrena kārayet ||
mārjanaṃ ca pralayaṃ ca tanutreṇavarānane | hṛdārccā ca caturmārge akṣavāḍhaṃ daśaiva tu ||
kuṇḍe pūjā prakartavyā madhye vai vistaraṃ kuru | ṛtu snātāṃ tu vāgeśīṃ uttānāmīśamūrddhagām ||
nīlotpaladalaśyāmāṃ arghapādyādibhiryajet | hṛdā vā śakti yuktena dvibhujā ca trilocanā ||
agnerācamanaṃ hṛnnāsthāpanaṃ tadanantaram | veṣṭanaṃ tāḍanaṃ caiva prokṣyādghāṭanameva ca ||
netrena cāmṛtīkāryā marccānaṃ cāvaguṇṭhanam | garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanantathā ||
vaktrasaṃklapanaṃ kāryaṃ tathāvaktraviniḥkṛtiḥ | niḥkramo jātakarme ca vaktrodghāṭanameva ca ||
vaktraśuddhiḥ prakartavyā māmaśuddhistathaiva ca | garbhādhānādi nāmāntaṃ kartavyaṃ hṛdayena tu ||
daśaivakuṇḍavāhye tu aṣṭau kuṇḍāntare priye | aṣṭādaśaiva saṃskārāḥ kartavyā deśikena tu ||
tatastu devīṃ vāgeśīmarcayitvā visarjayet | paryagnikaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ saṃmukhī karaṇantathā ||
surādānaṃ vistarāṃśca pūjanaṃ paridhīni ca | lokeśasāstraṃ saṃpūjā pūrvādi kramayogataḥ ||
prīṇīta vahniṃ saṃpūjya cāṣṭaṇaiva ghaṭaṃ yajet | vahnisaṃtarpaṇaṃ pūjā kartavyā ca vidhānataḥ ||
śrukaśruvā sādhya cāstreṇa upayāmoparisthitam | paścād dvādaśasaṃskārān suvilīnā ghaṭāntare ||
adhiśravaṇamādau tu upādhiśravaṇaṃ tathā | utaplavaṇasaṃplavanaṃ nīrāṃjana nirīkṣaṇam ||
vahnersaṃtarpaṇaṃ caiva paṃcadhā daśadhā tathā | āsanaṃ pūjayed devyā hṛtkaṃje pāvakasya ca ||
paścād devīṃ nyaset mūrtiṃ caturddeha samanvitam | tatastu yajanaṃ kāryaṃ vidhānena yathoditam ||
paścāt saṃtarpaṇaṃ kuryāt vidhānena yathā ruci | cchāgamāṃsaistrimadhvaktrairdevī saṃtuṣṭa hetave ||
bilvapatraiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpairariṣṭaṃ baṃdhanaṃ rujam | naśyate kramaśo mohādrājyaṃ syācchata padmajaiḥ ||
raktairvāṇijya lābhaṃ ca śasyalābhaṃ tathotpalaiḥ | nīlotpalairbhavet puṣṭi kumudairiṣṭanāśanam ||
kundaiḥ śāntimavāpnoti vakulairatulaṃ yaśaḥ | mallikābhirbhavet puṣṭi jātibhirbrāhmaṇāvaśam ||
campakaiḥ kṣatriyāvaiśyā tagareṇa vaśaṃnayet | sūdrāścaiva tu baṃdhukaiḥ pāribhadraiḥ piśācakāḥ ||
yakṣākadambapuṣpaiśca arkaścaiva jayaṃ labhet | jayantī kusumairhomānnidhānaṃ labhate sphuṭam ||
palāśakusumairddevī vidyā vāgīśatāṃ labhet | nṛmāṃsenāṣṭa siddhiśca adhamaścottamāṃ labhet ||
rājikālavane naiva ākṛṣṭiśca prajāyate | karavīrairbhavatkṣobhaṃ staṃbhane karṇikārakaiḥ ||
guggulaghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ catuḥsamena saṃyutam | hutātsayacchate sarvaṃ yatkiṃcinmanasi sthitam ||
kākapakṣāryahomena uccāṭayati bhūdharān | mūkatvaṃ vartulaiḥ kuryādunmattaiśca nakādibhiḥ ||
khādiraiḥ sapalairhutvā mārayennātra saṃśayaḥ | āyurdūrvā yutaiḥ puṣpaistilaiḥ kaṃnyāmavāpnuyāt ||
yavaiḥ saṃvarddhate dhānyaṃ dhānyaiḥ koṣaṃ vivarddhayet | rakṣā siddhārtha homena pītavarṇaiḥ prajāyate ||
dīkṣā guggulahomena irāmāṃsayutena ca | phale caiva phalāvāpti vaśago vṛrttivarddhanam ||
itthaṃ home tu nirvarvatya pūrṇāśaktyā pradāpayet | hṛdāsarpya yadyajñaṃ hṛdācāgniṃ visarjayet ||
tribhiḥ khaṇḍaiḥ surāṃ pūjya svāntaśaktyau niyojayet | kṣamasveti hṛdācātmamudrayā guhyasaṃjñayā ||
baliṃ datvā tu putrādi gaṇeśāntaṃ yathākramam | itthaṃ dehacatuṣkantu mayāte saṃprakāśitam ||
sa bāhyābhyantaraṃ devyāḥ kimanyat paripṛcchati ||
[iti śrīkulakrame karavīraśmaśāna yoge caturdehavarṇane tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 3 ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
śrutaṃ devamayāsarvaṃ caturdehavinirṇyam | idānīṃ kulasadbheda dīkṣāṃ bruhimamāgrataḥ ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kuladīkṣāvinirṇayam | guhyaṃ kaulakramāyātaṃ yathānukramayogataḥ ||
parikṣitasya śuddhasya kramayogaratasya ca | bahukālaprabhaktasya sevāmaṇḍala vāriṇaḥ ||
anugrahaṃ prakartavyaṃ guruṇānanda cetasā | niḥpannayāgadravyasya hyarthaśūnyasya cetasaḥ ||
hemādibhājanaṃ pātraṃ śoṇaṃ netrāṃśukaṃ śubham | ca rudravyavidhānena jalādhāraṃ ca hemajam ||
raupyajaṃ vātha tāmraṃ vā ājyapātraṃ tilasya ca | nālikā cchedanī kartī dhūpadīpasya bhāṇḍakau ||
tilādi havya dravyāṇi lakhanī caṃdanādikam | rocanākalaśāścaiva cchatraṃ candrā tapaṃ tathā ||
rajāṃsi paṃcaratnāni hyevamādiraṇekadhā | yāgadravyasamākhyātaṃ kriyāmārgaprabodhakam ||
mahāvīraraṇe ghore mahāpitṛvane tathā | manorametha saṃsthāne kuryādyāgasya mandire ||
nāvābhāvena saṃkalpya deśikaḥ susamāhitaḥ | pūrvavadyajanaṃ kuryādvahyantaṃ vidhipūrvakam ||
saṃprārthyamātarī saṃdhyā satkaṃnyādi mahākulam | gurudevavidhānena arghahastaḥ pratīkṣayet ||
udyacchāstreṇa saṃprokṣa svānta svāntaṃ samuddharet | gavatrayena gāvau tu rodhayedvāmakāditaḥ ||
antaḥ khaṇḍena cāṃjalyāṃ sapuṣpāṇi pradāpayet | mācāpya pūrvamuccārya sapraveśyasumaṇḍale ||
kaṇḍānte vinyase cchakti saptadhānāpalaṃ hunet | saṃprokṣya ca vidhānena maṇḍalānte tataḥ punaḥ ||
mantradehaṃ tu vinyasya dṛśānetra prakāśayet | saptāvartana śubhage dīkṣitaḥ sarvamaṇḍale ||
bhavatyeva samākhyātaṃ saṃskāraṃ samayātmakam | evaṃ caruntu saṃprāpya svapnamāvaśakāntikam ||
daśāvarteṇa śubhage putrakatvaṃ pravartate | sevanācca hunāccaiva nātrakāryāvicāraṇā ||
apare ca dine prāpte praviśya yajanāntare | saptāviṃśatihomena viplusaiḥ prokṣitena vai ||
jāpyanāpi mahāgaurī samantrakamalena vai | sevitena prajāyacca sādhakatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
evaṃ samantrakamalaṃ sevyaścānandabhairavam | navakaiśca ghaṭaiḥ siktā sūtrādyaṃ saṃpradāpayet ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā bhaktyāsiktā krameṇa tu | ācāryasaṃbhaved devi guhyamālākulaṃ mahat ||
samayī sevayed vidyā gurvārādhana tatparaḥ | putrakaṃ śṛṇu yā cchāstraṃ sādhakaḥ sādhane kṣamaḥ ||
dīkṣā vyākhyā pratiṣṭhāṃ ca nityanaimittikānyakam | ācāryaḥ kārayet sarvaṃ janānugraha hetukaḥ ||
itthaṃ hotravidhānaṃ tu kīrtitaṃ tava suṃdari | punaścānyaṃ pravakṣyāmi mahāmelāpasiddhidam ||
prāpte mahātanau puṃsi sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyute | svārādhya tadvināvājñāṃ gṛhītvā yāgamārabhet ||
vīrarūpaṃ rūpaṃsamāsthāya samāruhya tanuṃ tataḥ | caturddhā yojayeddehaṃ ekacittaṃ samāhitaḥ ||
japaccaiva hunaccaiva sevaṃ caiva samācaret | sa śakti hīno vā jñānaśaktisamāśrayet ||
sādhakasya varārohe bhayaṃ kurvanti devatāḥ | kāyavākvittayogena tasmādbhītiṃ vivarjayet ||
saptāvartana subhage dīkṣitaḥ sarvamaṇḍale | paśyate maṇḍalaṃ devyāḥ purastādvyomasaṃgatam ||
daśāvartana śubhage putrakosau bhaviṣyati | devi putraṃ puraḥ paśyen mahāsiddhipradāyakam ||
saptāviṃśati jāpena paśyate mātṛmaṇḍale | sādhakaḥ sādhake bhāti purastānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||
śatāṣṭaparijāpyena bhavedbhairavavatsvayam | paśyate bhairavī rūpaṃ śivasāyujyakāraṇam ||
maleke cchomalaṃ dṛṣṭi bhāṣācāraṃ carukramam | jñātvā kulāgataṃ samyak tataḥ siddhiṃ labhet kramāt ||
itthamelāpayogena vīradīkṣā prakāśitā | kuladīkṣāvidhānaṃ tu punarvakṣyāmi sundarī ||
saṃprokṣanetrakaṃ baddhā praviśya ca yathā kramam | kuṇḍalinyā hataṃ kṛtvā śaktihastaṃ niveśayet ||
ānandamapyanaṃ kuryācchatāṣṭāntamanukramāt | caruṃcāpi mahādīpaṃ pāraṃparyakramāgatam ||
vinātrikena saṃsiddhiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi | nasyāt tasyāt trikaṃ kṛtvā gurupūjanamārabhet ||
tridhā caiva khadehena arthenāṣṭa vidhena ca | tridhā ca vacasā gaurī cittenāpi prapūjayet ||
itthaṃ yā dīkṣito martyairnārī vā bhaktavatsalā | sādhayedakhilaṃ sarvaṃ siddhisaṃghatridhā sphuṭam ||
trividhā kathitā devi dīkṣāpratyaṃgirā kule | guhyaṃ mahākulā yātā saṃkṣepānna tu vistarāt ||
[iti śrīkulakrame karavīrayoge dīkṣātrayakathano nāma caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 4 ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
yathā saṃsādhayed deva siddhisaṃghastridhā sphuṭam | sādhakaḥ saṃvibhāgena tathā kathaya śaṃkara ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tridhāsiddhi samūhakam | yena saṃsādhayedvīrā vīrā vā kulasantate ||
vīradīkṣā na śaktāyaḥ saṃpūjyavidhivat purā | śmaśāne śivadakṣe vā gṛhe vā vāhanasthite ||
dīpādi trividhairnityamabhāvāt parvaṇi punaḥ | satyavāk dhairyasampannaḥ kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ ||
śakti sahāyasaṃyukto vīraḥ sahāyakothavā | sahāya dravyahīnātha bhīkṣāsī ca niśāgame ||
sahasraikaṃ japaccādau kāya śuddhyartha hetave | devī tuṣṭā huneccaiva yathā pūrvaṃ mayoditam ||
tato lakṣaṃ japen mantrī divā cāhāravarjitaḥ | bhuktorddhabhāvanāśaktaḥ saṃdhyāyaṃ śatamekakam ||
gāyatryā tu jayenyugmaṃ nyaṣṭā caiva ṣaḍaṅgakam | tato rātrau japaṃ kuryād yathā śaktyā krameṇa tu ||
daśāṅgena hunet paścānmantra saṃsiddhi hetave | homānte kanyakā pūjyā kṛtasiddhirbhaveddhruvam ||
athavā dviguṇaṃ jāpyaṃ yāvad vai saptavāsaram | krurādau cāṣṭamasekāddhomānta grahaṇāntikam ||
trisaṃdhyaṃ madhyarātrau ca ekadvitridinaṃ ca vā | vātādirogasaṃśānti homādau sevato labhet ||
aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ samārabhya haraṇatam | daśāṅga homataḥ sakāt mahāśānti bhavet sphuṭam ||
japet paṃcaśataṃ mantrī yacchaśyaṃ triśataṃ hunet | homānte sekataḥ paśyet puṣṭiṃ caivastvamāpnuyāt ||
triśataṃ triśataṃ japtvā japtvā caivāṣṭame dine | homāntaṃ sekato dehapuṣṭimāpnoti mānavaḥ ||
japtvā caiva tu sāhasraṃ juhuyāt paṃca śatāni vai | nāgāśvagoṣṭha lokānāṃ puṣṭimāpnoti sekataḥ ||
nigalārgala yantrāṇi ātmanotha parasya vā | trisaṃdhyā varttanāddhanyāt saptāhānnātrasaṃśayaḥ ||
śmaśāne śarkarāṃ gṛhyamantrairaṣṭaśataṃ japet | yatra yatra bhaved gauri nigaḍā sphoṭanaṃ bhavet ||
bhūtāṃ kuśasya daṇḍena tridhābhimantritān dṛḍhān | nāvāśakaṭayantrāṇi staṃbhayet mocayellavāt ||
dūrvā tantu viṣakṣobhaṃ duḥkulaṃ duṣṭajantukam | vālukā saptajaptvā tu mahāmedhyāntu vārayet ||
rājikāṃ saptajaptvā tu grastaṃ bhūtadināvadhi | tāḍayeddhṛdi mudrāyāṃ kṛtvā saṃtyajyate dhruvam ||
jvarā cāturthakādyāśca saptajaptodakena tu | abhyutkṣaṇānnivartante citrādgunurudhūpataḥ ||
lūtāgardabhavisphoṭa vyādhayo vividhāstathā | saptajaptodakaḥ sekāt pānāllepādvināśayet ||
ekaviṃśati vāraistu jalaṃ caivābhimantritam | sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ cāṅgaṃ viṣaṃ pānādvināśayet ||
puṣpānna siddhisiddhārthaṃ śmasānasya ca bhasmakam | saptamantrya bhanecchatruṃ saśatruṃ mohanāya ca ||
mahāpātre dhānya puṃje madyapūrṇe ghaṭeṣu ca | akṣayaṃ tadbhavet tasya nityapūjāratasya ca ||
arvakoṣe bilvagatāṃ saṃlikhyapaṭake yajet | dhanadena samaṃ dravyaṃ na kadācid vinaśyati ||
gajaśālamuktadāme pūjayet paṃkajotpalaiḥ | na kadācid vinaśyanti gajā vṛddhiṃ prajāyate ||
vṛkṣamāyāntitā gāvo bahukṣīraṃ dadanti ca | rājikā saptajaptvā tu dhānyādi kṣetrake kṣipet ||
mahāśasyādi vṛddhiḥ syāt kīṭādyāna viśettutam | śitaguṃjjā ca sarpakhyāṃ dhāmavyāghravarāṭikā ||
saptajaptvāmukhe dhāryā astrabhaṃgona jāyate | bālānāṃ sarṣapāmantryaṃ śatakenātasaṃkhyayā ||
kaṃṭhevaddhā vṛddhimāyānti āyuṣā prajñayā dṛḍhāḥ | puṣpārke śrīphalaṃ pakvaṃ sahasrārddhena mantritam ||
tajjalaiḥ sevitānārī aputrā suyate sutam | aṣṭādhikaśataṃ japtvā jalapūṇṇaghaṭasthitam ||
tenābhi secanā nānyā dapasmāraṃ vinaśyati | aṣṭottaraśate naiva puṣpamālābhimantritā ||
yasya saṃdīyate kaṃṭhe ekayuddhajayī bhavet | ahorātro ṣito bhūtvā anudigyo japet tu yaḥ ||
svārthaṃ vātha parārthaṃ vā apamṛtyorvimucyate | puṣpārkke vātha cāṃgāre yadyaṣṭamī caturdaśī ||
ārabhyalakṣakārddhena kuṣṭhī kuṣṭhādvimucyate | puṇḍarīkāṃśunāvartyākāṃ guhyaṃ dīsaṃ mukhe ||
vane jāyāt sahasreṇa aṃjanī paśyate nidhim | catuḥ pathamṛdaṃ gṛhya gṛhārddhe paṃcaviṃśati ||
japtvā saṃkṣepayennidrāṃ vaśyā bhavati durbhagā | tilataṇḍulasiddhārthaṃ pratyekaṃ daśamantritam ||
ekīkṛtya kṣiped yatra padaṃ nā kramate ariḥ | phallālimiśrakaṃ paṃcaviṃśādhikaśatābhidam ||
bhūtāyāṃ sakṣipedyatra tatrarogī bhavejjanaḥ | lājācākṣatasiddhārtha sabhasmaṃ śatamantritam ||
yatra yatra kṣipenmantrī tatrārogyaṃ pravarttate | kaṃthamātrodake sthitvā japet paṃcaśataṃ yadi ||
varuṇena tathā homān mahāsṛṣṭibhaveddhruvam | arkkacitrakapuṣpāṇi saṃprajapyasahasrakam ||
yasmin grāme kṣipenmadhye pakṣāt pakṣāt pradahyati | aṣṭādhikaśataṃ hutvā japtvā vai madhuguggulam ||
agnināne vadahyeta uddharet svakṛtaṃ yadi | śatārddhaṃ tu japen mantrī śatārddhaṃ homayet tathā ||
vaśīkuryānnasaṃdehaḥ saptāhenaśacīpatim | japtvā paṃcaśataṃ mantrī siddhārthantu samanvitam ||
mastake kaṃṭhabāhau vā dhṛtā divyasya nāśanam | apāmārgaśataṃ hutvā tatkṣāraṃ yasya yojayet ||
durbhago jāyate satyaṃ prītināśamavāpnuyāt | paṃcādhikaśataṃ hutvā trailokyaṃ rājikā puṭam ||
yasya nāmnā tu saptāhāt mahāsphoṭaṃ sa gṛhyate | sidhārthaṃ guggulaṃ caiva ekīkṛtyaśatatrayam ||
homānte ca mahāprīti viprītiḥ sa ca jāyate | hema bījaiḥ śatāṣṭau ca homayet saptavāsaram ||
uttanmattau jāyate śīghraṃ vartulaṃ vā ghṛtānvitam | masūrajāghṛtairyuktaṃ sahasraṃ tridinaṃ hunet ||
vadhiro jāyate śatruḥ satṛyuktaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | godantāṣṭa śataṃ hutvā kṣārakṣopāṃdhatāṃ vrajet ||
saptāhācca niśārātryai divādinaniśāniśau | karpāsāsthi tuṣā tailaṃ yuktaṃ paṃcaśataṃ hunet ||
ekaviṃśadine devi śakrasyāpi śriyaṃ haret | gurau śukla tṛtīyāṃ pūjākuṃbhe śataṃ japet ||
hutvā trimadhuraṃ sakācchī bhraṣṭā labhate śriyam | kākapakṣāruṣahomāt paṃcatriṃśatakaṃ hunet ||
bhasmacitra patākāyā śatroruccāṭanaṃ param | bhasmasiddhārthakāmiśrā japtaṃ paṃcaśatena tu ||
śatrvā(?)gamapathe kṣiptvā jayatyeva na saṃśayaḥ | yadrajo varttikākāmī vaso dīpapuraḥ sthitaḥ ||
samabhyarcyā na yannārīḥ śatapaṃcapurasthitam | piṣṭena prakṛtiṃ kṛtvā aṃguṣṭhāmastakāvadhi ||
cchitvā paṃcaśataṃ hutvā svakulaṃ parineṣyati | siṃdūramakṣatā yuktaṃ śatāṣṭaparimantritam ||
kṛtvā kanyākare dadyāddrāviṣṭāvaṣṭakavadhet | rājikā dhūmrajaṃ kṣāraṃ daśadhā cābhimantritam ||
kṛtvātajjalakasnānaṃ kāmalaplīharoganut | tailambathe jalaṃ vātha aṣṭadhā cābhimantritam ||
yā nāmnābhi pradānācca prasūte sukhanidrayā | śirasthāne ghaṭaṃ pūjya aṣṭottaraśataṃ japet ||
hitāhiteṣu kāryeṣu svapna caivodayaṃ labhet | paṃcaviṃśati vā japtvā rājikā lavanaṃ krudhā ||
graṃthau nibaṃdhanādrātrau aṃdhaḥ paśyati sarvathā | haste tīkṣṇāṃghriṇaṃ kṛtvā arddhalakṣmaṃ śmaśe japet ||
khaḍgasiddhi bhaven pretāccakravarttitvadāyinī | arddhadagracitākāṃṣṭha na pādukau kṛtyalakṣakam ||
tathaiva pādukau siddhirdaṇḍācchatrujagāminī | hatāmbara samādāya kṛṣṇamāvartya lakṣakam ||
tathaivā dṛśyakaḥ satya krīḍate vasudhā tale | paṃcā jyena prabuddhyantu(?) kapālakṛtakajjalam ||
lakṣārddhārdhāṅgite netre divyadṛṣṭiḥ prajāyate | pātrau bhūtatarau sthitvā lakṣārddhārddha japet sudhīḥ ||
bhūtāḥ kṣudhāpahārantu dadatyauṣadhamuttamam | paṃcaviṃśati sāhasraṃ kare kṛtvā vacāṃ japet ||
japānte bhakṣayet prājño vāgīśvarasamo bhavet | lakṣāddhārddha japet prājñāstadante śivaparvaṇi ||
śmaśāne tu śataṃ japtvā siddhākṣastu labheddhruvam | vaṭasyādho japellakṣaṃ tadante rajasā kṛtaṃ ||
yakṣiṇī kāmayennityaṃ jīvatyeva śataṃ naraḥ | jānumātrodake sthitvā lakṣārddhantu japet sudhīḥ ||
nāminī kāmagredvīraḥ sahasrāyuḥ prajāyate | lakṣārddhahomayadvīraḥ kadaṃbakusumairyadā ||
kuṇḍāduttiṣṭhate śīghraṃ vetālaḥ siddhyate tadā | kākinī vīrahomena tuṣṭā yūthā piśācakā ||
lakṣāddhārddhena homantu nityaṃ dadāti palaikakam | kanyā hastatalaṃ gṛhyalakṣārddhantu śmaśānake ||
japtvā bhūtabhaviṣyaśca varttamānaṃ bhavantyalam | lakṣekānta tu bhūtāyāṃ vīradehoparisthitaḥ ||
śatāṣṭādhikajāpena merusthānaṃ sa gacchati | vīramaṇḍalasaṃsthāne lakṣānte vigrahotthitaḥ ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā rudrasthānaṃ sa gacchati | lakṣānte tu kaliṅgantu vīrakaṃ daramūrddhani ||
japtvā cāṣṭa sahasrantu īśalokamavāpnuvāt | itthaṃ devi samuddiṣṭaṃ geyamadhyamavottamam ||
trikarmamantrasiddhiḥ syāt siddhiḥ syādadhuvā(?) śṛṇu | tṛgorocanakau gṛhṇa salākṣāśatamantritam ||
lalāṭa tilakaṃ kṛtvā yaḥ paśyet savaśaṃ nayet | kuṃkumāguru karpūrai secanāhvayamiśritaiḥ ||
śatābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā tilakaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati | raṇerāja kule dyūte vivāde svajayī bhavet ||
vallabhaḥ sarvanārīṇāṃ kāmadeva samoyadi | siddhārtha kavacāśvetā pratyūṣṭhekabhāvodare ||(?)
kṛtvā prātacaturddaśyāṃ saṃpūjyamadhusaṃyutam | mukhaprakṣipya japtvā tu paravāde jayo bhavet ||
evaṃ jayati kāśārddha ghaṭastaṃbha mudāhṛtam | śitaśare paṃkhikāmūlaṃ śatāṣṭyādhika yojitam ||
mukuṭoṣṇīṣake dhṛtvā paravyavyanivāraṇam(?) | kṣaseśakālimātāṣu(?) śatāṣṭādhika mantritam ||
tena saṃprokṣaṇādviṣṭagrāhādvidveṣakārakam | saptāddhika śatermaṃtrya gokṣīrāntara vāsinam ||
siddhārthāṣṭaśataṃśaṃkā sthāne saṃdhyāsu saṃkṣipet | anyasmin divase tatra yadi cchidraṃ prajāyate ||
sphoṭavāśoṇa vṛṣṭiṃ vā tapaṃ kuryācca tatra vai | saptāhānte samuttiṣṭhe vidhānaṃ vighanavarjitam ||
sādhakasya kare tiṣṭhennāgalokagataṃ yadi | citi bhasmasamādāya kharakṣārasamanvitam ||
śatāṣṭaparijāpena sainyaṃ kṣiptvā kṣayaṃ bhavet | cāṇḍālāgniṃ tu prakṣālya khādiraiśca samiṃdhanaiḥ ||
yasyā kṛtiṃ tu piṣṭena pādācchitvā prahomayet | sapalāli samāyuktaṃ ghṛtena dinasaptakam ||
praveśo bhāvate satvaṃ ātmano ca dhanena ca | khādirantu sahasraṃ tu ajārakta palānvitaḥ ||
saptāhe tu vyati krānte ānaye tu śacīpatim | evaṃ cūtānale kṣāra kaṭu aṃgamala krudhā ||
madhyarātrau saptāhāddhomācchatru kṣayo bhavet | rocanāśveta dūrvā ca akṣatāsita sarṣapā ||
śatābhimantritaṃ mūrdhni dhṛtāt sarvatraśobhane | śivarātryāsamārabhya japellakṣaṃ yathā sukham ||
punaśca śivarātrau ca saṃpūjya vidhivat tadā | nṛghṛṇaṃ tu kare kṛtvā dakṣe vā sugamālyakam ||

tāluraṃdhra vinirgate || tālupālapātāle | randhranavāntaḥ tatraiva ṣoḍaśāntaḥ | urddhakaṃdāduccarita yāvannilālambaṃ | atha dvādaśāntaṃ vā uccarati jvālā rūpa brahmanāḍi yogena brahmanāḍi suṣṭamnāmadhye sūryabimba bhedayet | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ yāvat somabimbaṃ tribhi ekīkṛtaṃ vāmasotraraṃdhra vāmanetraṃ vāmanāśāpuṭe brahmavilaṃ | dakṣanāśāpuṭākṣa śrotraṃ brahmakapāṭaṃ | etat samastai śilā jvālāmuṃcatī | tataḥ pāṇī igheva | vahniśikhā jvālā yathā vaduritāraviḥ | niśākara yathā pūrṇaṃ tatra cittaṃ nirodhayet | iha vamarthaḥ | etaddhyānaṃ vāhyeva pūrvavaditi | mantrameva ca lakṣayād bhavet siddhi yatheṣṭa phalasādhakaḥ || lakṣajāpaḥ || antalakṣaiḥ kanda cakre brahmasthāna nābhi cakra viṣṇusthāne | etatya kleśa kṣaya yatra yatra mana viśrāntaṃ lakṣajapayati | yāvacca bhavitāvasthā majjānta ca viśasya ca | paratatva vilīnasya spandā spandaṃ namāmyahaṃ | etallakṣajapyate saptāviṃśati jāpena dikṣito sau bhaviṣyati |||
