evaṃ sahasrajaptvā tu vṛṃhate daṇḍanāyakam | japtvātha susahasrantu rājyaṃ bhavati tatkṣaṇāt ||
athavā yuta jāpena devatvaṃ ca prakīrtitam | ayutaṃ dviguṇaṃ japtvā rudrasya mama darśanāt ||
tathā triguṇitaṃ japtvā īśvaratvaṃ sadāśivaḥ | tathā maṣṭaguṇaṃ japtvā khecaratvaṃ prajāyate ||
tathā daśaguṇaṃ japtvā devīnāṃ mamatulyatām | yathā devi tathā dehe mama tulyo bhaviṣyati ||
samakāyaśirogrīvā dhārayeda cala sthitam | sapaśyannāsikāgre tu diśaśca nāvalokayet ||
homaṃ caiva daśāṃśena kṛtvā japamanuttamam | makārasahitaṃ kṛtvā svacchakāreṇa tatkṛtam ||
ācamyāpyākṛtaṃ ādau paśubhaṃga vivarjitam | mūrcchamānakṛtaṃ yāgaṃ madirānanda cetasam ||
guptāguptavicāraṇa paṃcaratna suśobhanam | āharet siddhi micchanti paścājjāpa vidhāya ca ||
śmaśāne ekavṛkṣe vā athavā ca catuḥ pathe | parvatāgre nadītire śūnyāgāre ||
etajjāpaṃ prakūrvīta paścāddhyānaṃ samācaret | śmaśānaṃ kandu vṛkṣaśotraśānta ||
catuḥpatha iḍāpiṃgalā suṣūmnā ekatraṃ | parvataṃ bhrūmadhyaṃ | śūnyāgāra suṣūmnā | hṛdayaṃ manaḥ |
nadī iḍāpiṃgalā || etajjāptaṃ kurvate ||
dhyāyet ghorāṃ parāṃ bhīmāṃ ṣaṭvaktrāṃ ca trilocanām | ṣaṭtriṃśā caturbhujā devī sāyudhā ca prasiddhidā ||
ghorā bhīmā rūpāṃ dhyāyate || ṣaṭvaktrāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśabhujāḥ || trilocanā | yoginīnāṃ madhye dhyāyate ||
mahāyogeśvarī pūrvaṃ kālasaṃkarṣaṇi dakṣe | karaṃkiṇī uttare proktā krodhinī paścima tathā ||
vāma vāmeśi urddha tu bhāsānākhyā parātparam | ūrddhavaktraṃ niyuṃjīta evaṃ ṣaṭvaktramucyate ||
a aḥ kālagrāsantu mahāpātaḥ vidyutpātaḥ aśanipātaḥ | ūrddhapātaḥ apātapātaḥ kalpānta pātaḥ mahāsaṃhāra saṃpātaḥ ||
evaṃ saptamahotpātā pātayantīti pāvitam ||
prathamaṃ pātanipāta piṇḍapaṃcākṣaraṃ bhavet |
dvitīyaṃ pātasthaṃ sthitaṃ |
tṛtīyapātaṃ nirddiṣṭaṃ navavarṇaṃ prakīrtitam | caturthanimittayātaṃ saṃkhyātrayodaśa smṛtaḥ ||
paṃcamapātasthaṃ deśasaptaistu vyāpitam | ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca vyāpitaṃ pātaṃ vācyavācaka varjitam ||
pūrvavaktrantu yogeśī yogaśabda iti yogeśī | odyāna pīṭhaṃ | khphreṁ saṃhārarūpaṃ | tatra madhyāt paṃcapiṇḍaṃ nāthasya cotpatti | sadgurumukhasaṃhāpradāyaṃ |
dvitīyavaktraṃ kālasaṃkarṣaṇī dakṣiṇavaktraṃ | klīṁ kāraṃ jālaṃdharapīṭhaṃ | tṛtīyavaktraṃ uttaravaktraṃ karaṃkiṇī pūrṇapīṭhaṃ kubjikā devī śrīṃkāra utpannaṃ ||
caturthapaścimavaktraṃ krodhinī vāmavāmeśī | kāmarūpapīṭhaṃ hrīṁkāramutpannaṃ | paṃcamaṃ śaktipīṭhaṃ vyomavāmeśvarī devī aikārotpannaṃ | tadūddhamamākhyā bhāśeśvarī nimnārnāmapīṭhaṃ hsauṃkāracotpannaṃ evaṃ vaktraṣaṭkaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ kathyate ||
anyadgurumukhāllabhyate etat ṣaṭvaktraṃ || anyacca | kīdṛśī bhagavatī pratyaṃgirā siddhilakṣmī devī ṣaṭtriṃśā caturbhujā devī āyudhā sarvasiddhidā āyudhaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi yathāvat kathayāmite || khaḍga (1) || kapāla (2) || triśūla (3) || śilā (4) || khaṭvāṅga (5) || aṃkuśa (6) || pāśa (7) || vīṇā (8) || paraśu (9) || dviphaṇi (10) || vajra (11) || mudgara (12) || vāṇa (13) || cāpa (14) || cakra (15) || padma (16) || pustaka (17) || varada (18) ||
evaṃ te dakṣiṇe proktā śṛṇu vāme varānane ||
gadā (1) || cchurikā (2) || vetra (3) || cakoda (4) || kartarī (5) || liṃga (6) || muṇḍa (7) || ḍamaru (8) || gadā (9) ||
śakti (10) || kamaṇḍalu (11) || maṭaka (12) || kalaśa (13) || brahmakaṃkāla (14) || pāśupatāstra (15) || āgneyāstra (16) || vāruṇāstra (17) || abhaya (18) ||
vāmamārge mahādevyā prasādaṃ devi ucyate ||
vāmamārge ca tatproktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadbhujamāyudhā ||
saṭtriṃśattatvāni dhārayantī ||
pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca ||
śabdasparśara sarūpagaṃdhaḥ vākyāṇi pāyūpastha pādā śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā nāśāmano vuddhyahaṃkārapradhānāni ||
puruṣayamaniyamāni rāgokāla vidyāyāśurddhavidyā ||
īśvara sadāśiva śaktiśivaṃ ||
evaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattatvāni || 36 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśa āyudhānāṃ ca vakṣyate ||
evaṃ tatva samākhyātaṃ ityapāṇi pradhārayet | vahupāda vahubhujā tatsaṃkhyā na ca vidyate ||
etat smāt sakalaṃ rūpaṃ niṣkalaṃ sakalādyataṃ ||
iti || āsanastu pūjyate || padmāsanantu pūjyante tatpṛṣṭhe preta ucyate | tatpṛṣṭhe indramuṇḍaḥ syādindrapṛṣṭhe ca brahmakam ||
tatpṛṣṭhe viṣṇumuṇḍaṃ syādviṣṇu pṛṣṭhe ca rudrakaṃ | tatpṛṣṭhe tu sadāpūjye sādājyaṃ muṇḍameva ca ||
etat paṃca mahāpretāt tatpṛṣṭhe devi pūjayet | mahāpadma hṛdayaṃ saṃkocaṃ vikāśaṃ ||
tatpṛṣṭhe madhyakarṇikāyāṃ paṃcaṣaṣṭhi pretaḥ pretaśabdena tama tasya antarvarttī śabdasparśa rasarūpagaṃdhaḥ etad brahmaviṣṇurudra īśvara sadāśivatvaṃ ca ||
kācidiyaṃ vahiḥ kroḍī karaṇārthaṃ indrapavilāyate muṇḍa indramuṇḍaṃ pūjyaṃ || 1 ||
madhye viśvādayaṃ brahmāsattā viditāṃ brahmamuṇḍaṃ pūjyaṃ || 2 ||
madhye vṛrttiṃ galitā viśrānta saṃhitā saha viṣṇumuṇḍaṃ pūjyaṃ || 3 ||
samastakāraṇa tanmātravṛtyā na kiṃcit prasarate rudramuṇḍeti rudramuṇḍaṃ pūjyaṃ || 4 ||
sadāsanavṛtyābinbadanyabhūtānāmīśvara muṇḍeti īśvaramuṇḍaṃ pūjyaṃ || 5 ||
cidārddhamātrādi ravasphuratimanteti sadāśivamuṇḍaṃ pūjyaṃ |
tatpṛṣṭhe devīṃ pūjya kiṃ svarūpaṃ samarasaparamānandaughana prasarati devi svarūpaniḥśamaśamabhūmikāni rālambaṃ tadā bhagavatī kālasaṃkarṣaṇī samayā khphreṁ śrīṁ hrīṁ siddhilakṣmī ambā śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi ||
śaraṇāgataṃ māṃ rakṣa rakṣa ||
etat nyāyena paṃcamudrāsate namaḥ ||
devīnāṃ śārīra abhiprāyena pūjayet |
kha pha ra e ma || khphreṁ mantreṇa pūjayediti ||
khaphareṇa tu mantreṇa pūjayet parameśvarīṃ ||
kha ākāśaṃ || pha vāyu || ra teja || e āpa || ma pṛthvī || o jā pū kā mā cā || kā kāmarūpātītaḥ || ākāśaḥ pūrṇagiri rūpaḥ || vātaḥ jāladharaḥ padaḥ || tejo odyānaḥ piṇḍaḥ pāpa | yogapīṭhaḥ | śarīraḥ pṛthivī tvacā || śivāmbu | apārakta tejaḥ | asthivātaḥ | majjā ākāśaḥ evaṃ paṃcadhā sphurate | paṃcaraṅga || iti paṃcapiṇḍa nirṇayāmantraḥ | ityevaṃ pūjayet || mokṣārthī śvetapuṣpena bhogyārthī raktamucyate | kāmārthī pītavarṇena māraṇe kṛṣṇa ucyate || ityabhiprāyaḥ | karaṅkiṇī krodhinī ca tathā saṃkarṣaṇī vahiḥ | vāmapārśve prapūjyante dakṣiṇe adhunā śṛṇu || devī akāmarūpaḥ akārādi akārāntaṃ yāvat sūryasya vyāptiḥ kakārādi bhakārāntaṃ yāvadagnervyāptiḥ makārādi yāvat sakārāntaṃ somasya vyāptiḥ etat nyāyena akāra cotpattiḥ karaṃkiṇī rūpaśaktiḥ saṃkarṣiṇī parśaśaktiḥ | etat nyāyena vāmamārgeṇa pūjayet || khecarī lelihānā ca tṛtīyā yā ca bhairavī |
dakṣe mārge prapūjyante madhye pūjyā kṛśodarī ||
paramaśakti lelihānā parāśakti bhairavī ||
parāparaśaktiḥ evaṃ pare aparaparādya parā ca ||
pūjayed dakṣiṇe mārge pūrvoktayā devyā madhye pūjyā ||
trailokya mohanī cādau trailokyaṃ mohayet kṣaṇāt | sā dvitīyā ca jayadratho vatsale (2) siddhilakṣmī pratyaṃgirā devī (3) ||
caturthe navatyadhika dviśatā || siddhi saṃketake caiva siddhilakṣmī jayadrathe || 5 ||
paṃceti nāmagṛhnīyā atītānāgatajño vadanti ca | mahādevī rājyalakṣmī rājyeṣṭa devatā nānyā anyaiva adhunā śṛṇu ||
pūjanaṃ kathayiṣyāmi mukhapāraṃparaṃ sthitam | gaṇeśavaṭukaprāṇāpāṇau dvau gurū īśvara akāraṃ akārasya yadvaṃ citasphuliṃga paṃcāśadvarṇa sphurati ||
ādau ca devi pūjyante pūrvasmi devyā kathitaṃ | devyā dvādaśasaṃyutā || dvādaśadevyā dhyānaṃ vakṣyate ||
paṃcavaktrā cāṣṭabhujā trinetrā pretasaṃsthitāḥ | triśūlakhaṭvāṅgadharā padmamuṇḍakarārpitā ||
pustakābhaya hastā ca kapālaṃ kararājate | khaḍgaṃ ca aṣṭamaṃ proktaṃ dhyānametacca dvādaśaṃ ||
ete dvādaśa māsāḥ ||
atha dvādaśa kalā atha dhātu muni saṃkhyā ca |
punaḥ ṣaḍāraṃ pūjyate || pūjayet parameśvarīṃ | kṛṣṇāsu bhīṣaṇāraudrī antrasragdāmaśobhitā ||
ekavaktrā trinetrā ca muṇḍamālā caturbhujā ||
muṇḍaṃ padmāśanā dīptā pāśāṃkuśa vidhāriṇī ||
athavā khaḍgacchurikā ṣaḍete dhyānamuttamam | punarmadhye prapūjyante samayā pūjayet tataḥ ||
paṃcavaktrā daśabhujā tripaṃcanayanairyutā | pretarudrāśanā dīptā candrāśu kundasaprabhā ||
khaṭvāṅga khaḍgapāśañca aṃkuśaṃ śūlapātrakam | kuṃbhaṃ ca nṛśiraṃ caiva varābhayakarairyutā ||
vaiśvānaraṃ mārttaṇḍa candramaṇḍalamadhyagā |
nānā yudhakarā devī yatheṣṭa phaladāyinī | śaṃkhinī ca śivādūti vāmadakṣiṇa pūjayet ||
etat sarvaṃ prapūjyante pūjayet parameśvarīm |
[iti śrīkālasaṃkarṣaṇīmate caturviṃśati sāhasre pūjanavidhi ṭippiṇakaṃ tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 3 ||
śrīdevyuvāca ||
carukaṃ saṃpradāyaṃ ca mukhānmukhakathaṃ bhavet | kathamantraḥ kathaṃ bāhyaṃ kathaṃ sthāno papadyate ||
kathaṃ sthānantu deveśa vadasva parameśvara ||
etacca ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi rahasyamatidurlabham | yoginīnāṃ paraṃ prāṇamākhyātaṃ na kadācana ||
uttamādhamamadhyañca palāṃḍulaśunaṃ tathā | gaṃjanaṃ viśvakṣāraṃ ca harāmbu rudrameva ||
nālājyaṃ yoni puṣpaṃ ca mīna prākāśikaṃ caru | hālāhalaṃ suraśreṣṭhaṃ ṣoḍaśaite prakīrtitāḥ || 16 ||
pradhānatrayodaśa caruṃ ||
manaḥ śrotraścakṣu jihvānāśā buddhirahaṃkārān manonmanatā ||
ghṛṇiśaṃkābhayaṃ lajjā vijugupsā kulaṃ śīlam || 16 ||
anyacca ||
snānaṃ janmakaṃdanābhiḥ hṛdayaṃ kūrmanāti sūkṣmamadhyādarddha candraṃ nirodhīnādānta nilālambaṃ ||
evaṃ (13) || pradhānasthānāni || amāvāsyāntu pūjyante yāvat prati padā sthitā ||
pratipadāt paṃcadaśī pūjayedanulomakaṃ | amāvāsyāt prati padāntaṃ yāvat ||
carukaṃ || ekaṃ pūjya pūrṇimā amāvāsyā yāvat prati anulomaṃ pūjya kṛṣṇāpūrṇā ubhayāmāsau | ekamekaṃ dināharet ||
kṛṣṇapakṣastathā śuklapakṣapūrṇā śṛṇu ||
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi vidhānamadhunā śṛṇu | taraṇḍadaṇḍadracitaṃ yā kācit kalādrāvitā ||
manaṃ ca mārayet tatra na māhāmāṃsabhakṣayet | taraṇḍamiti taraṇḍa iti daṇḍaṃ vāmamārgo vāta svarūpam ||
takāraṃ taraṇḍadaṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇamārge vahni svarūpam | rakārarūpadaṇḍa madhya anaskaṃkalā rūpaṃ |
drāpitaṃ tat sthānaṃ manaṃ mārayet | mahāmāṃsaṃ na bhakṣayet ||
anyacca || 1 ||
śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā sā dvayā dvaya varjita | kalāpara namaśnañca na tu gomāṃsa bhakṣaṇam ||
śabdaṃ na śṛṇute rūpaṃ na paśyati rasanā na svādayati | hṛdayaṃ na | grāhayati advayā dvaya rahite etat samastaṃ tyajati ||
yogī sāmaṃrambikārasaṃ pratidine dine aśnati bhakṣate ajarāmaratvaṃ bhavati || gomāsahaḥ || 2 ||
kaṃdādhāra ca ullāsaṃ nādarūpaṃ ca ghaṇṭikā | sā kalā amṛtaṃ bhakṣennatu māṃsaṃ ca śākunam ||
kandādhāraṃ ca yāva lambikā sā kalāmamṛtaṃ ||
lambikā yāpī yatekṣadhā tṛṣā varjayet || 3 ||
lambikārasamuṣṇaṃ ca śrāvitaṃ śaśi indurāṭ | ajarāmarakośaśca palāṃḍuṃ na ca bhakṣayet ||
palasya aṇḍumiti palāṃḍuṃ lambikāra sa uṣṇaṃ ||
agnimālayate caṃdravātarūpeṇa śanaiḥ kaṃdādhāra dvādaśāntaṃ yāvat | athavā ajarāmarā bhavati || 4 ||
lakāra laṃbikārasaṃ makāra aśanaṃ tathā tena pānarasonmattaṃ laśunaṃ āharet tataḥ |
lakāraṃ lambikaṃ makāre śaśikalāvahnirdrāvayet ||
pānagulpha na siddyate || yogā va || 5 ||
ghṛṇijighrā tujāṃgra ca bhakṣitaṃ vahnimaṇḍala | vahnikaṃdantamārgena rāvaṃ ucyate ||
kutaḥ gṛṃjanamāharet | viśva carukaṃ yattadvātravānala saṃsthitaṃ | somasūryagrāsā yatra purīṣaṃ āharetyarthaḥ ||
viśva agni caruḥ | somasūryagrasanaṃ | kiṃnimittaṃ vāmamārge kuṇḍalinī pūrakena vātasparśa na utthāpayet | tathā somasūryagrāsī kṛtaṃ tatra vaḍavānala purīṣa āharet || 7 ||
nāḍī yantraśca saṃghaṭya vahnisomasyadrāvitaṃ | lambikārasamuṣṇaśca śivāmbumāharet kutaḥ ||
kuṇḍalinī saṃsrāvitāṃ nāḍī yantra saṃghāṭṭañcatuḥ koṇaṃ tatra śravaṇe || 8 ||
raktaṃ raviśaśi śukra puraśukraṃ tu vārayet | tenamaśna mamaśnī yā jyoti puṣpṇa āharet ||
raktaṃ raviśuklaṃ śaśi golakaṃ vātaḥ | śivaṃ puruṣaḥ śakti strīrūpaṃ śivaśakti trayomārddayati ||
svarūpalabhyate yoni puṣpa || 9 ||
vāḍavaṃ karaṇaṃ datvā malatrayaṃ ca dahyate | amṛtaṃ kaṇṭhakūpe ca na tu śleṣmantu āharet ||
asyābhiprāya || ūrddhasthitā caṃdrakalā suśāntā pūrṇā mṛtā nandarasena devī ||
tayo bhayo vahni viśeṣa yogāt tejaṃ ca candradravinaṃ ca yasmāt ||
tejañca vastrañca visṛṣṭakatvād bhavet tadarkaṃ avatāra rūpaṃ | yasmāt sakāśāt prabhuravya yo sau dviṣaṭka viśrāma pade praviṣṭaṃ || 10 ||
samasta vṛrtti galitaṃ kāraṇaṃ paṃcamarddayet | paiśūnyaṃ kuṇḍamaśnaṃ ca bhaga liṃgaṃ na marddayet || 11 ||
ityevaṃ ||
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃgulaṃ daṇḍaprāṇabhūte vyavasthitam | tatrābhyāsa rato yogī na praṇītantu āharet ||
cāraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgula prāṇadaṇḍaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśa tatvāvat prāṇa daṇḍaṃ |
tatrābhyāsarato yogī tatkiṃcit svarūpaṃ labhyate || 12 ||
somasūrya dvau netrau bhrūmadhye saṃhate na ca | tatrābhyāsaratā yogī na tu prākāśikaṃ caru ityarthaḥ || 13 ||
gaganamambaraṃ patraṃ nirālaṃbaṃ ca yasthitaṃ | tatrābhyāsarato yogī na tu hālāhalaṃ caruṃ ||
hālāhala caruṃ gagaṇaṃ | ākāśaṃ tathā dvādaśāntaṃ nilāmbaṃ dhyāyate |
mana abhyase yogī ca || 14 ||
vāmadakṣiṇanāḍyāṃ ca vasanti ca surāsurau | sā surāpī yate yatra na tu anyāpi vetsurā ||
vāme devāḥ || dakṣiṇe asuraḥ tayorekī bhāvaṃ karoti ||
ānanda svarūpaṃ labhyate guru prasādaṃ | galitā madhyamānāḍī bharita bhairave tanu ||
tantu madyantu maśnīyānnatu drākṣokṣu saṃbhavaṃ || 15 ||
madhyamamvālavaṃ kuntu svabhāvena tu yojayet | tena pānaras'm pītvā na kṣudrākṣokṣu saṃbhavāṃ || 16 ||
itthaṃ ca cakramāyātaṃ carvaṇe yoga yuktibhiḥ | yoginī prāpya siddhyante ityāha bhagavān priye ||
ādau bāhyaṃ prakartavyaṃ paścādantaḥ samācaret | pacarannaprayogena trikoṇaṃ śaktimūlakam ||
tarasaṃpīyate nityaṃ tuṣyate ca kṛśodarī ||
mātā ca bhāryā duhitā vāthavāstriyā | veśyā samaya kālena jugupsāṃśavivarjayet ||
gopanāt siddhimicchanti anyathā patanaṃ bhavet ||
[iti śrīkālasaṃkarṣaṇīmate caturviṃśatisāhasre carukasaṃpradāyo nāma ṭippaṇakacaturthaḥ] || 4 ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yaduktaṃ punareva ca | gayā ca prathamā nāḍī gayā suṣumnā kuṇḍalinī ||
kalevara rasaṃ bhavet |
tasya dvādaśamūlāni dvādaśā hṛdayādiṣaḍaṃgameva ca ṣaṭ || 6 ||
uparitasyaiva pitṛ pātre sa ucyate ||
ṣaṭpitṛpātre devayāne ṣaḍbhiḥ devayāne ṣadbhirdevayānaiḥ | aṣṭādaśa prakīrtitāḥ || evaṃ (18) ||
tālu raṃdhraiḥ ṣaḍbhi gataṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ sūryasya ucyate | ṣaḍbhirmuṇḍapurīṣābhyāṃ madhyama ekamavyāpitaṃ ||
kuṇḍalinī vāyu vāhātribhirudhaiśukra vāhātribhiḥ | adhiyatkriyate karma suṣūmnānāḍi sidyate ||
iḍā ca piṃgalā caiva suṣūmnā ca tṛtīyakā | tadabhyāsarato yogī na bhūyojanmatāṃ vrajet ||
punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi maṇḍalaṃ adhunā śṛṇu | gomayairlepayennityaṃ gomayaṃ satyasūtraṃ samarasaṃ bhavet ||
sūtraṃ manaḥ | tapa japa kriyate | paṃcaraṅga paṃcaratna śālicūrṇantu kārayet |
śālicūrṇantu yoniṃ cūrṇamarddayet | ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ | ṣaṭkoṇaṃ hṛdayaṃ tatra svarūpā labhyate ||
madhye yoniṃ ca dīyate | yoniṃ sūryabimbaṃ tadbāhya caturasrakaṃ ||
o jā pūkā ||
vāma dakṣiṇa dvitīya rekhāḥ prāṇāpāṇau dvau | adhe dvau ca dvau ca dīyate || śivaśakti udvelayā cartula tadatha māyārūpaṃ |
karmakūryādvicakṣaṇaḥ | patākā toraṇayutaṃ toraṇaṃ taraṇḍadaṇḍaṃ ||
patākā dvādaśāntaṃ ||
anyacca ||
dolālayaṃ yantra gamābhyāṃ paṃcadhā kuṇḍalinī paṃcadhā dhvajā acchalāyāṃ etad dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
patākā paṃcakāraṇaṃ || kuṇḍalinī paṃcadhā || pūrakena pātena svarūpaṃ labhyate | ṣaṭkoṇe dvādaśādityā devyā || 12 ||
śivādūtyādyāmadhye caiva kṛśodarī prāṇaśakti caturasraṃ tanmadhye vāmadakṣiṇe pūjayet || devyā ||
śaṃkhinīti śivādūtī adhye dvau dvau prapūjayet |
kṛṣāpūrṇā || urddhe tu vyoma madhye tu samayā pūjayet sadā | siddhilakṣmī anakcarūpātadvāhya dakṣiṇe pūjyā ||
gurupūjārcanantathā | guruṃ namaḥ | akāraḥ | pūrvasmin kathitaṃ || vāmamārge gaṇeśasya dakṣiṇe carukasya ca | gaṇeśa vaṭukā sūtraḥ | prāṇāpānaḥ | etat prapūjayed devi ityāha bhagavān śivaḥ ||
[iti śrīkālasaṃkarṣaṇīmate kuṇḍamaṇḍalo nāma ṭippaṇaḥ paṃcamaḥ paṭalaḥ] || 5 ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi vahnikārya yathā vidhi | ṣaṭkoṇa kuṇḍakartavyaṃ dvātriṃśāṅgulamānataḥ ||
kuṇḍabrahmavilaṃ dvātriṃśadvīra devatāṃ | atha varṇādika kārādi kṣakārānta meṣalā tritayaṃ ||
kṛtvā somasūryāgniḥ | brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraḥ | aṃgulyā ekādvau triṇī | ekaṃ viṣṇuḥ dvaurudraḥ | tṛtīyaṃ brahmā iti meṣalā kṛthā yathāvat kathayāmite ||
homaṃ paṃcāmṛte naiva śrīphalaṃ sahasaṃyutam | bhogyārthe tu varārohe kārayet tu vicakṣaṇaḥ || 3 ||
rakta karavīrapuṣpaṃ cchāgaraktena saṃyutāṃ | tribhirhomaṃ prakartavyaṃ mahābhayavināśanam || 4 ||
mahābhaye samutpanne vṛhatīriṣṭavigrahe | kusumaṃ brahmavṛkṣeṇa guggulaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam ||
tribhirhomaṃ prakartavyaṃ mahābhayavināśanam | ghṛtaṃ caiva ghṛtāktaṃ ca dadhnāntaṃ ca payodanam ||
tilājyaṃ sarṣapā proktā ekaikaṃ pariśarkkarā tilasaṃyukta pāyasaṃ ghṛtamiśritam | bilvajāti phalaṃ proktaṃ guggulaṃ daśama smṛtaṃ ||
yavaṃ ghṛtaṃ tilaṃ caiva taṇḍulaṃ ca yathoditām ||
nityakarma prakurvanti yatheṣṭa phalasādhakaḥ ||
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ bhogyārthī bhogyasaṃpadā | kāmārthī labhate kāmamityāha parameśvaraḥ || 6 ||
ityevaṃ punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi māraṇaṃ adhunā śṛṇu | rātrau homaṃ prakartavyaṃ śmaśāne vā catuḥpathe ||
ekavṛkṣe nadīkūle athavā vanagāgrataḥ | rājikāmastu cūrṇena mākṣikaiḥ sahasaṃyutam ||
mahātailena sahitaṃ samidhā vaṭikāṣṭakam | ṣaḍbhiḥ pūjayate devi cakrākāraṃ tu kārayet ||
aṣṭottaraśataṃ hutvā mārayet tridaśānyapi | dvitīyaṃ ca pravakṣyāmi agnikarmasamārabhet ||
saptaviṃśapalakṣāraṃ puttaliṃkāṃ kṛtvā pratidinaṃ aṃgamaṅgahotavyaṃ kārayed budhaḥ | pūrvamudrā pradātavyaṃ mārayet tridaśānyapi || 2 ||
etasmāt kathitaṃ devi agnikarmasya nirṇayam ||
ityevaṃ ||
atha cihnalakṣaṇaṃ || dhūmitaṃ nīlavarṇantu kapilaṃ visphuliṃgakam | jvālā tejasmatī caiva havyakavyartha vāhanam ||
raudrī saṃhāriṇī devī vaiśvānaraguṇādaśa ||
atha cihna kathyate ||
vakṣyatīyaṃ dhūpite mṛtyubhayaṃ | nīlavarṇe śatrubhayaṃ (2) kapilaṃ āyuvṛddhiṃ ca sarvakāmañca visphuliṃgamārogyaṃ jvālāmuṃcana mokṣadaṃ sutejaṃ putralābhaṃ havyakavyaśabdena sukāraṃ muṃcati ||
āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ dharmārtha kāmamokṣadam | havyakavya śabdena caṭa caṭa jñānaṃ prāptiṃ ca dīyate ||
raudra bhīṣaṇarūpaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ saṃhāraṃ netrahīnaṃ bhavati saṃhāre lelihyamānaṃ taccarate | vyādhirogaṃ jvarāti sāraṃ śastraghāṭa agnipraveśa samastaṃ bhavati | suvarṇavarṇaṃ evaṃ sarvakāmārtha siddhidaṃ bhavati evaṃ daśaguṇaṃ vakṣyate || 10 ||
aṃguṣṭha tarjanī kṛtvā mokṣadaṃ labhate phalam | aṃguṣṭhamadhyamāṃ kṛtvā mohana kriyate sadā ||
aṃguṣṭhanāmikāṃ kṛtvā vaśīkaraṇamuttamam | aṃguṣṭhakanīyasaṃ kṛtvā uccāṭana paraṃ bhavet ||
paṃcāgula prayogena sarvakāmaṃ ca siddhyati | ityetallakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye kathanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi rasyamati kaulike | yoginīnāṃ paraṃ prāṇaṃ yatnāta khyātaṃ kadācana ||
jyeṣṭhā gaṇe vāhanaṣṭhāṃ pūjakāmānavāpnuyāt | yāṃ yāṃ cintayate devi vāhanaṃ veṣṭakopari ||
jyeṣṭhāṃga dakṣiṇe diśābhāgaṃ tadvātamajarīyaṃ vāhanaṃ dravakaṃ tasya dakṣiṇe pūjyapādāropya ||
athaṇḍalvasya śulvaśabde tāmrabhājanaṃ tṛtīyaṃ lohasya māraṇe loha saṃpūjya || arthakāmaṃ yatkiñcit karmarodhye pūjya ||
ebhistribhiḥ kāryapīṭhikāṃ kṛtvā tatpṛṣṭha dravakaṃ sthāpya paṃcāpacāraṃ pūjayediti ||
mudrāṃ datvā pūrvasmin kathitā vai | tatra dakṣiṇadiśāṃ arghapātraṃ pūjya yasya vāhanasya pṛṣṭhe gamayate |
rātrau kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ athacaturddaśyāṃ bhrāmayet ||
yatkiṃci cchubhāśubhaṃ carācaraṃ paśyate | striyākāryaṃ raktāmbaravatīṃ sragdāmābharaṇānvitaḥ | madirānanda cetanyā khaḍgamaṇḍakarānvitaḥ ||
hasangāyantathā valgan vrajedvīravaraṃ gṛhe | tatra smaraṇagatyā ca vedīmadhyagataḥ sudhīḥ ||
yāvanti saptakā devā tāvadāyānti devatāḥ | tāsāmarghyaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhitvā vāmāṃgamātmanaḥ ||
datte ca khecarī sākṣāt sādhakosau bhaviṣyati ||
raktāmbaradharāraktānulepana raktasragdāmavīrabhūtiṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā khaḍgahastaṃ dakṣe vāme muṇḍakarānvitaṃ | madirānaṃda ghūrṇanaṃ rātrau bhrāmayate | khecarī tiṣṭhati vadame svāmī bhavati ||
iti puruṣasiddhiḥ ||
[iti śrīkālasaṃkarṣaṇī mate agnikarmayajano nāmaṭippaṇake ṣaṣṭha paṭalaḥ] || 6 ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
tilakaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tathāsta paca sādhana | aṃjanaṃ guṭikādīnāṃ vaśyākarṣaṇameva ca ||
pātālabhaṃjanaṃ devi yannāsti tannasādhayet ||
he ākarṇaya ||
priyaṃ gurocanaṃ rādhraṃ pippalotthaṃ manaḥ śilā | aśvalālā samāyuktaṃ tilakena vaśaṃ jagat ||
raśerājakuledyūte saṃgrāme sajayī bhavet | vallabhaḥ sarvanārīṇāṃ kāmadeva samo bhavet ||
acintitānicārthāni sadā tasya bhavanti hi | punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi rakṣāṃguḍikamūttamam ||
rocanāṃ kuṃkumaṃ caiva karpūramalayantathā | etat samasta dravyāṇikārayeta vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||
atraiva vyākhyā syāmaḥ || gorocana prasiddhaṃ | kuṃkumamapi prasiddhaṃ | candraśabdena karpūraṃ | malayaṃ śrīkhaṇḍaṃ | malayaṃ candanaṃ | sugaṃdhāni ato vakṣyāsillarasaṃ | mṛganābhikambhūrikā |
kuṇḍagolako śivaśakti saṃyogotpannaṃ | svayaṃbhu kusumaṃ prathamarajasvarastrī bhagarajaḥ |
etat samastamadirānanda cetanyo vīravigraha saṃyutaṃ | sa candraṃ caiva tāmbūla netrakajjalaraṃjitaṃ |
vāme ca śakti sahitaṃ ghūrṇamānaṃ sutejasā ||
puṣpaiśca svarṇarajataṃ bhūryapatraṃ suśobhanam | tato vidyā samuddhṛtya lekhayet kanakākṛtī ||
athavā mālatī kāṣṭhamathavāśikhipakṣakam | śikhīmayūratatpakṣaṃ surabhīkāṣṭhe lekhayecca ||
ādau ṣaṭkoṇamuddhṛtya tanmadhye yonireva ca | tadbāhye ṣoḍaśaṃ patraṃ māyā caiva tu dīyate ||
punardvātriṃśa patrantu bāhye ca caturasrakam | tatpṛṣṭhe ca triśūlaṃ ca māyāṃkuśasamanvitam ||
etaccakravaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bījaṃ ca adhunā śṛṇu | yonimadhye ṣaḍāre ca madhyakhaṇḍañca dīyate ||
punaśca ṣoḍaśakalā dīyate ca vicakṣaṇaḥ | akārādi akārāntaṃ yāvat ṣoḍaśakaṃ kalā ||
mātṛkhaṇḍantu tanmadhye mātṛkā sahadīyate | kakārādi hakārānta yāvanmandarapṛṣṭhayet ||
stuti khaṇḍantu deveśi tatraiva dantapatrake | daśo nātriśatā kṣaryā yatra rājastu pūrayet ||
brahmaṇādhāritaṃ pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭihetvarthameva ca | viṣṇunādhāryate daitya vadhārthaṃ cakramātṛkā ||
śivena dhāritaṃ pūrvaṃ tripurāsuraśāsane | dhāritaṃ lokapālaistu rājyamaiśvarya kāraṇāt ||
raṇerājakuledyūte vivāde śatru saṃkaṭe | mahājvarasamutpanne aṭavyāṃ nirjane tathā ||
mahābhayasamutpanne nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥ | punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi indrajālamidaṃ śubham | svānakasya śirāgṛhya kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ ca grāhayet ||
viḍālapadabījāni śirapṛṣṭhaṃ ca dāpayet | tāvat tāvat phalaṃ gṛhya tasya bīja sunikṣipet ||
śvānakasya tu rūpāni iti satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | athamārjārarūpaṃ ca cillarūpaṃ kariṣvate ||
vyāghra siṃhagajārūpaṃ nānyathā ca bhavet tanuḥ | punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi vahnistambhanamuttamam ||
gorocanaṃ bhṛṃgarājasya mūlaṃ kharjuramisraṃ saghṛtaṃ savaṃdyaḥ | sūtena sārddhamatula prabhaṃ dantasthitaṃ staṃbhati paṃcadivyam ||
asyārthaṃ ||
gorocanaṃ bhṛṅgarājasya mūlaṃ | kharjuramiśraṃ piṇḍakhajuraḥ ||
ghṛtasya puṣpaṃ kṛśaravaṃdyaḥ | havanaśeṣe muṇḍatikaṃ sūtaṃ pāradam |
etat samastaṃ khaṭvābhyantare sthāpitaṃ gagaṇadhūpana ghaṭayet | dantasthitaṃ | mukhe udare kṣipyamutrapurīṣaṃ na tyajet ||
ayamarthaḥ | kena prakāreṇa agnistaṃbhanaṃ paṃcadivyastaṃbhayati || punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi vaśyārthaṃ ca varānane | sarpaśiraṃ tagarajane koṣṭha nārī mada bhramarasya pakṣau | kṛṣṇacaturdaśi yojita samyak ānayate ||
gaganādapi candraḥ | sarpaśīraṃ nakhavī (2) tagarakhaṇḍaṃ | aṃjanaṃ vanā | koṣṭhaṃ brahmasvarūpaṃ | bhramarapakṣaghoṇaśrotra rasanāmalaṃ grāhyate | nārīmadaṃśukraṃ evaṃ ubhayagolakena rudreṇa samayā prathamadivaśe bhājayati ||
ūrṇādikarpatena bhāvyate | samasta oṣadhī tadbāhye | kṛṣṇacaturddaśī prabhātasamaya ravi udayanakāle puṭapāka antadhūmena dahyate ||
bhasmaṃ kumāryā pṛṣṭaye | arddhaśailena dātavyaṃ golakena sahitaṃ tilakaṃ kāryaṃ yaḥ paśyati gaganaṃ candraṃ ānayet ||
athavā khānapānapuṃstrī parasparau kārya ityevaṃ etat prayogona karttavyam | yāgahomasamanvitaṃ vidyācāṣṭasahasreṇa iti satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||
punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi dhūpamaṃjanamuttamam | lasunāmalakoṣṭhā ca kuṃkumaṃ nāgakeśaram ||
āmrapātravalāmoṭā samabhāgāni kārayet | āmrapatraṃ nāgavuvvudī ca ||
valāmoṭāraktaṃ ca | eṣa cintāmaṇirdhūpo rājāvaśī bhavati || valāmoṭā ca saṃgṛhyaraktamayura śikhāstathā ||
prasiddhadau nabhau ca karttavyaṃ dīpaṃ datvā ca varttate | mṛtakarpatavartibhyāṃ tasya varttiṃ antarhitāḍavādvau ekī kṛtastailaṃ caiva tathaiva ca mahātailasya rātrau kajjalaṃ grāhya adṛśo bhavati | te sadā nānārūpaṃ prapūjyate khecaratva mudhāsthitā | yojanānāṃ śataṃ gatvā athavā ca sahasrakam |
mudrā pradarśitaṃ yena yadiśāmyāt kriyā bhavet ||
pūrvasminkathitā mudrā ||
punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi rūpamatyantamuttamam | śubhe nakṣatra divase māse śubhamanohare ||
gṛdhrasya tu śiraṃ gṛhya sarvasnānaṃ ca dāruṇaṃ | sarvasnānamadhya śiraṃ bhāvya ||
māsamekaṃ ca ||
tatra madhye kṣipenmuṇḍamāsamekaṃ na vārayet | japaṃ cāṣṭasahasrantu homaṃ kṛtvā yathā sthitam ||
guggule nātha guruṇā brāhmaṇān pūjyante kanyā vā pūjayet tataḥ | yathā śaktyā tu dānaṃ ca āśīrvādaṃ bhaviṣyati ||
varuṇamadhye kṣipenmuṇḍaṃ yāvadāśaṃ ca gocaram | varuṇā uddhṛtaṃ muṇḍaṃ vālmīkaṃ vālukāṃ nyaset ||
bhūmiśabde sunikṣipya bījaṃ kanakalaṃ nyaset ||
kanakaphalaṃ dhutturaṃ phalaṃ kṛṣṇaphalaṃ atha guṃjāphalaṃ kṣipet ||
raktaguṃjā athavādārikā sahakārabījaṃ athavā ātmarucyate athavā rocayed guruḥ |
varuṇaṃ kṣipyati kṣipya vṛkṣaścaiva suśobhanam | yāvat tāvat phalaṃ gṛhyati sādhakaḥ | phalaṃ vadane kṣipya vadanaṃ mukhaṃ rūpaṃ darśayate sphuṭam | nānārūpadharā devi siṃhavyāghra paśustathā | aṇḍajā śvedajāścaiva yonijodbhidajastathā ||
udbhidajaśca pāṣāṇaṃ yathā manasirucyate ||
khegatirbhūgatiścaiva yatra te manasaṃkhyayā | tatra tatra ca siddhyanti ityāha bhagavāṁ śivaḥ ||
punaranyaṃ pravakṣyāmi yenadaṃ mārayejjagat | guru prasādāllabhyante yadi sākṣāt kṛśodarī ||
vanaspati phalaṃ gṛhya caturmukhasahena tu | vanaspati śabde aṭotkaḥ | te ca kasmīra deśotpannaḥ | caturmukharaudro kṛṣṇapakṣe tu pūjayet | śūnyagṛhe tu ||
mantraṃ cānyaṃ pravakṣyāmi yenedaṃ mohitaṃ jagat | kuṇḍalākṣaṃ yoni yutaṃ athavā dīpakena tu ||
dvidhādeya ca ekataḥ ||
evaṃ hau haḥ ||
trivargañca mahāmantra yoginīnāṃ mukhe sthitam | ekatra mantra || haiṁ hūṁ hūṁḥ varṇa 3 || viṣṇurasa keto yena arghapātraṃ varānane ||
viṣṇurasakaṃ śivāmbuṃ hṛnmārjanaṃ ca dravitaṃ vāhanaṃ dravakaṃ ||
tatpṛṣṭe yaddiśāṃ gatvā tadā hūṃkāraṃ karoti | kaṃdāddvādaśāntantu dvādaśakalāmāharet | sūryasya ravibhaktastu ḍākinyo arghapātraṃ ca āharet ||
sphuryamānaṃ ca draviṇaṃ rāvaṃ vahnisma ucyate | kaṃṭhāntā bindu saṃyuktaṃ yāvat ṣoḍaśamaṃ padaṃ | makārādi sakārāntaṃ yāvaccandrasya ṣoḍaśakalāṃ āharet || candrabhaktistu ḍākinyā vāruṇyā vāta ūdhṛtam | brahmāṇḍaṃ graṃthitaṃ yāvat kṣaṇamātraṃ prayuṃjate ||
na japaṃ na tapaṃ kuryān mukhena caru dṛśyate |
evaṃ ḍākini mantrastu prayogamadhunā śṛṇu ||
kāka jaṃghasya mūlāni gṛdhrasya udarantathā | netraṃ raktaṃ ca pittaṃ ca gṛdhrasya tvacameva ca ||
evaṃ cāṃjanakartavyaṃ sarvājanavaśasya ca | ekamadhyādakameva mārayet tridaśānapi ||
ādyayāgavidhānena vinārcana rate sadā | dadyācca raurave ghore yāvadā bhūmi saṃplave ||
tāvat kliśyanti tatrāsti paścādanusujāyaṃte | paśu saṃgaṃ na kurvīta dīpado adhipātrake ||
tāvanti raurave ghore adhobhāgaṃ ca mantrarāṭ | deśe deśe paribhraṣṭo janānāmayutaṃ vadet ||
duḥkhaśokā ca vahulaṃ kṛtvā cakrasya pūjanam | pṛthivyādīni tīrthāni brahmāṇḍaṃ sa carācaram ||
brahmāviṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ | tasyānte sarvatṛptāśca ādyayāgasya tatphalam ||
kālāgnirudraparyantaṃ śivāntaṃ vā tathopari | saptadvīpasamudrāśca bhuvanāni caturddaśa ||
ekāsya śivayogī ca ādyayāgasya tatphalam | brahmahatyādi naśyanti gohatyā bhrūnahāpi vā ||
guru mātā pitā bhrātā bāṃdhavāścaiva sarvataḥ | sarvapāpaṃ praṇaśyanti ādyayāgaṃ bhajena tu ||
bhuktimukti phalaṃ tasya saubhāgyaṃ dhana saṃpadā | rudraloke vaśennityaṃ trinetro bhagavān haraḥ ||
ṣaṣṭhi koṭi sahasrāṇi gavāṃ kanyā ca dīyate | athavā aśvamadhantu tatphalaṃ ādyayāgakān ||
bālukārāśi saṃsthāya śivāntaṃ yāva copari | ekaikasya tu muddhṛtya saptakoṭigatopi ca ||
tāvanta bhuṃjate lokān yāvadbhūmi divākarau | tasya te kṣayamāpnoti ādyayāgasyamakṣayām ||
guruniṃdā ca ye kecid yekecinmantra dūṣakāḥ | pīṭhadūṣakāśca ye kecid yoginī dūṣakāścaye ||
vīraniṃdāśca ye kecicchivaśaktiśca dūṣakāḥ | pacyate narake ghore yāvadā hūtabhūmikā ||
tāvante raurave kāle yāvat sādāśivampadam | ihaloke ca dāridryamanyavaṃśa kulakṣayam ||
majjāmadāvasā aṇḍā māṃsaṃ rudhirameva ca | te dadyādyoginī manyāṃ nāśayet sakalānvitam ||
gurudevāgni bhaktānāṃ mantradhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | tatra tanmadhya dātavyamityājñā pārameśvarī ||
[iti śrīkālasaṃkarṣaṇīmate caturviṃśati sāhasre pratyaṃgirāyā mālāmantramātṛkāvivaraṇaprakaraṇe mukhakarmanirṇayaṃ nāma ṭippanakaḥ samāptaḥ] ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīmahādevyai ||
śrīmahādeva uvāca ||
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ sarvakāmadam | ekākṣaraparāhyekā mālāmantrā tathā parā ||
parā parā tṛtīyā tu kālasaṃkarṣaṇīti sā | vidyā tritaya vidye sā uddhariṣyāmita cchṛṇu ||
prastaren mātrikāṃ tatra sarvavāgmayamātṛkām | ūrddhabāhuṃ tatoddhṛtya tejomūrddhādhasaṃyutam ||
nāśāyuktaṃ supuruṣamarddhendu śirasāṃkitam | niṣkilikādiyaṃ vidyā saptakoṭeśvarībhidhā ||
mūrtitve vinyaseddevi mālāmantra mataḥ param | asmintantre tu samayā siddhilakṣmī jayadratho ||
jhaṃkāra bhairave caṇḍā pratijñā devi ḍāmare | brahmādyā devatāścāṣṭau sve sve dhyānāsane sthitā ||
māyā catuṣkale caiva praṇavādi namontagā | śrīmajjayadrathe tantre yathā vai sūcitā purā ||
śatadvayantu varṇānāṃ navatyadhika saṃkhyayā | abhedarahitā devi pūjitā sarvasiddhidā ||
tṛtīyā saṃpravakṣyāmi śivāyā vācakā parā | kuṇḍalākhyā vahni yutā e bindu samalaṃkṛtā ||
eṣā tṛtīyā ca parā parā rūpe vyavasthitā | vidyā tṛtīyamuddiṣṭā sarvakarmakarī śubhā ||
na caiṣā dīpake yuktā svabhāve naiva dīpitā | upa dhyāna parāśaktī nādamārge niyojitā ||
lakṣajāpādbhavet siddhi yatheṣṭaphaladāyakaḥ | dhyāyed ghorāṃ parāṃ bhīmāṃ raktakṛṣṇa bhyānakā ||
pretārūḍhāṃ kṛṣāṃgī ca digvāsāṃ vikṛtānanām | kapāloṣṇīśasannaddhāṃ vabhruvarṇāṃśirroruhām ||
aṣṭādaśabhujāṃ bhīmāṃ paṃcavaktrāṃ kṛśodarīm | nānārūpadharāṃ devīṃ nānāstrakaraśobhitām ||
rakta padmāsanārūḍhāṃ dūti yugmasamanvitām | khiṃkhinī tu śivādūtī vāmadakṣiṇa saṃsthitām ||
śivādūtī parāvidyā khiṃkhinī tu nibodhame | khiṃkhinī māyayā pūrvaṃ praṇavādi namontagāḥ ||
madhye kṛśodarī devī dhyāyate sarvasiddhidā | bāhubhiḥ ṣoḍaśairyuktā śavakarṇāvalambinī ||
vāme kapālaṃ khaṭvāṅgaṃ daṇḍaṃ ghaṇṭā tathaiva ca | pāśaṃ caiva tathā padmaṃ kheṭakaṃ hyabhayaṃ tathā ||
dakṣiṇe khaḍgaśūlaṃ ca aṃkuśaṃ vajrameva ca | śaktiṃ muṇḍaṃ gadāṃ caiva mudgaraṃ varadantathā ||
sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ vyālayajñopavītinīm | etat te sakalaṃ rūpaṃ niḥkalaṃ śṛṇu pārvati ||
nādarūpā tu sā devī piṃgalo dhvānugāminī | nirmamāṃgāra sadṛśā śāntāmūrddha pratiṣṭhitā ||
sūkṣmādīpaśikhākārā icchārūpaniraṃjanā | suṣumnaḍānumadhyasthā śiva teja samudgatā ||
nādayantrasamārūḍhā śivavaktrānugā parā | anāmānāmakoṭibhi vyākhyātantu varānane ||
yāgaṃ tu īdṛśaṃ jñātvā paścād bāhye prapūjayet | vaśye tu dhyāyate raktā śitasindura suprabhā ||
kapotābhā tu vādhirye raktāśuklā tu mohane | vidveṣaharitā devi uccāṭe kākasaṃnibhā ||
nānākarmakarī devī bhuktimuktiphalapradā | mudrā cātrapravakṣyāmi sarvabhūtabhayaṃkarī ||
japānte tu smared ghorāṃ rūpamantramanusmaret | adhokarapuṭaṃ kṛtvā mukhāgre ca pratiṣṭhitā ||
kanīyādhotra tāṃ kṛtvā tarjanyāmoṣṭhayorubhau | jihvāmukhe muhurbhrāmya mudreśā vikṛtānanā ||
eṣāmudrā mahīvīrā vīrāṇāṃ siddhidā parā | vivarānte ca yatkruddhaṃ yadi samyakkramājjapet ||
vidveṣamāraṇe śānti ākarṣe pauṣṭhike tathā | paṃcavaktra va yogena ṣaḍaṃgaṃ nyāsa yogataḥ ||
nyastamātrānmahāsiddhirbhūtala saṃpravarttate | mālāmantre tu deveśi mūcitā na prakāśitā ||
bhairavādyā mahāmantrāḥ śivādyāgāruḍātmikāḥ | guḍikāṃjanakaṃdhūpaṃ indrajālādi śambaram ||
sthūlasūkṣma sthitā ṛddhi bhukte śiva puraṃ vrajet | etat tatparamaṃ guhyametat tat paramaṃ padam ||
etat tatparamaṃdhāmametat tat paramādbhutam | sarahasyaṃ mahājñānaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
anyathā dadhate yastu anyathā gṛhyate tu yaḥ | ubhayornnarakaṃ yānti yāvadā caṃdratārakāḥ ||
tasmāt parīkṣyadātavyaṃ svaśiṣyāya ca pārvati | nāstike ca khale mūrkhe pramatte viplute'lase ||
guruśāstra sadācāre dūṣake kalaha priye | nindake cumbake kṣudre samayaghnethadāṃbhike ||
dākṣiṇyarahite pāpadharmahīnetha garvite | paśūnāṃ sannidhau devinoccāryā naiva dīyate ||
[iti śrīkulaḍāmare siddhalakṣmīvidyātritayaṃ sāṃkṣepataḥ saṃpūrṇam] ||
oṃ ||
athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi vidyā sarvārthasādhanī | pattiṃgiri samuddhṛtya mahārāje hyataḥ param ||
mahāśaṃkhantato datvā di uṣāne tathaiva ca | hadumuṇḍaṃ tato yojyamacālini padantataḥ ||
jñāmahekāri datvā tu kārāmi padamuttamam | vivi āvi tathā yojya anthi hanthi padantathā ||
paramaṃthi sa ehaṃthi jogibhauri tathaiva ca | mano ca karmaṇi padaṃ tāhi pattiṃ gire punaḥ ||
nivarji ca tathā santhi navārṇā dvaya dīpitā | saptāśītyakṣarā vidyā vāgīśīnāṃ mukhe sthitā ||
aśarīra parāvāṇī śrutvā padmodbhavena tu | nāradena tataḥ prāptā sasphurā sarvakāmadā ||
nāradāt siddhi saṃghaistu prāptābhūmāvatāritā | vakrā vakrakrameva pāraṃparya krame sthitā ||
[iti śrīmahākullālike prākṛta siddhalakṣmī vidyā samāptaḥ] ||
oṃ namaḥ śrīkāla saṅkarṣaṇyai || śrī īśvara uvāca ||
eṁ khphreṁ namostute mahāmāye dehātīte niraṃjane | pratyaṃgirā jagaddhātri rājalakṣmī namostu te ||
varṇadehā mahāgaurī sādhakecchā pravarttate | padadehāmahāsphāra parāsiddhi samutthitā ||
tatvadehā sthitā devi sādhakān grahā smṛtā | mahākuṇḍalinī bhitvā sahasradalabhedinī ||
iḍāpiṅgala madhyasthā vāyubhūtā khagāminī | mṛṇālatantu rūpiṇyā suṣūmnā madhyacāriṇī ||
nādākenādasaṃsthanā nādātītā niraṃjanī | sthūla vṛhati saṃpūjye acintyācintya vigrahe ||
parāpara pare śānte brahmalīne pare śive | acintyarūpacarite acintyarthaphalaprade ||
ekākinī viśvamātā karavīra nivāsinī | mahāsphāra pradānityā mahāmelāpakāriṇī ||
bindumadhyalayā devī kuṭilārddhati caṃdrike | dvādaśāntālayā devī ṣoḍaśādhāra vāsinī ||
kāryakāraṇasaṃbhinne caitanyā nāḍi madhyagā | śaktimūle mahācakre navadhā saṃvyavasthitā ||
aśarīra parā devī śarīre prāṇarūpiṇī | sudhādrava samākārā oṃkāra paravigrahā ||
vidyullatā nibhādevī bhāvābhāvavivarjitā | khāntapadmasthitā nityā pareśī śāntavigrahā ||
satvarūpā rajorūpā tamorūpātrayātmikā | tvameva devī sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ prāṇadāyinī ||
tvameva sṛjyate viśvaṃ līlayā vahudhā sthitā | mālinī paramā devī śmaśāna pada vaṃdhanī ||
hṛnnābhibhedinī sarva cakra viccakrasuṃdarī | biṃdudvāranirodhena divyavyāptā namostute ||
sūryakoṭipratīkāśe caṃdrakoṭyāti nirmale | kaṃdarpakoṭilāvaśye koṭi brahmāṇḍa vigrahe ||
nirākāśe nirābhāśe nirlape niravagrahe | sakalākhyamahāmāya varade surapūjite ||
khakāra phakāra vahnistha ekārāntare suṃdari | makārāntaravargeṣu paṃcapiṇḍātmake śive ||
sarppavatkuṇḍalākāra nādaśakti paratame | biṃdumadhye sthitā devī jālaṃdharavyavasthitā ||
turyavaitūryapīṭhasthe pūrṇapīṭha vyavasthite | kāmasthe ca kalātīte kāmyākhyā ca bhagodbhave ||
brahmagraṃthikalāṭopa madhyaśrota pravāhinī | śivasarvagate sūkṣme nityānaṃda mahotsave ||
mantranāyiki mantrajñe cicca koṇāntavāsinī | paṃcapīṭhalayānityā merunāyaki survarī ||
khecarī bhūcarī caiva śaktitraya pravāhinī | kālāntāgni samudbhūta kālakālāntakālinī ||
kālikākramasaṃbandhi kālidvādaśamaṇḍala | trailokyadahanī devī sā ca mūrtitrayodaśī ||
sṛṣṭisthiti ca saṃhāra anākhyākhya mahākrame | bhāsā śrī guhyakālī ca nirvāṇeśīniśeśvarī ||
jhaṃkāriṇī bhairavī ca svarṇakoṭeśvarī śivā | rājarājeśvarī caṇḍā aghoreśī niśeśvarī ||
suṃdarī tripurā ugrātārā pūrṇeśvarī jayā | kramamaṇḍala madhyasthā krameśī kubjikāmbikā ||
jyeṣṭhavālavibhedena kujākhyā ugracaṇḍikā | brāhmī raudrī ca kaumārī vaiṣṇavī dīrghanāśikā ||
vajriṇī carcikā lakṣmī pūjayed divyamātarā | asitāṃgorurucaṇḍa krodhīśonmatta saṃjñakam ||
kapālī bhīṣaṇākhyā ca saṃhāraścāṣṭamastathā | bhaktānāṃ sādhakānāṃ ca siddhilakṣmīṃ prayacchati ||
pratyaṃgirā siddhilakṣmīrbhairavena prakīrtitā | bhaktānāṃ sādhakānāṃ ca lakṣmīsiddhiṃ prayacchati ||
sādhako dveṣṭikānāṃ ca sarvakarmāṇi bhaṃjanī | viparītakarī devī pratyaṃgirā namostute ||
kālādigrasate sarvaṃ grahabhūtādi ḍākinīm | sādhakaṃ rakṣate devī kālasaṃkarṣaṇīnnamaḥ ||
śivaṃ prayacchate devī rakṣate līlayā jagat | pratyaṃgirāṃ namasyāmihya cintitānisiddhidām ||
rājyalābhapradāṃ devīṃ rājyeśīṃ bhaktavatsalām | pratyagirāṃ namasyāmi acintitāni siddhaya ||
sarvaśatrupramarddantī duritā kleśanāśinīm | pratyaṃgirāṃ namasyāmi siddhilakṣmīṃ jayapradām ||
āpadārṇavatārantīṃ paraṃ nirvāṇadāyinīm | pratyaṃgirāṃ namasyāmi caṇḍakāpālinīṃ śivām ||
rājyadāṃ dhanadāṃ lakṣmīṃ grahadoṣavināśinīm | pratyaṃgirāṃ mahālakṣmīṃ caṇḍakālīṃ namāmyaham ||
duṣṭaśatru pramarddantīṃ duṣṭagrahavināśinīm | pratyaṃgirāṃ namasyāmi siddhilakṣmī jayapradām ||
kaliduḥsvapnaśamanīṃ mahotpātavināśinīm | pratyaṃgirāṃ namasyāmi siddhilakṣmīṃ jayapradām ||
acintitārthadāṃ dhātrīṃ cintitārtha phalapradām | pratyaṃgirāṃ namasyāmi acintitārtha siddhaye ||
rājyopasargasamanīṃ mahāpadravanāśinīm | pratyaṃgirāṃ namasyāmi siddhilakṣmīṃ jayapradām ||
rājamātāṃ rājalakṣmīṃ rājeṣṭaphaladāyinīm | pratyaṃgirāṃ namasyāmi siddhilakṣmī jayapradām ||
siddhilakṣmī mahāvidyā mahāsiddhi pradāyikā | paṭhedvā pāṭhayedvāpi stotraṃ pratyaṃgirābhidam ||
paṭhanācchagrasainyānāṃ staṃbhayed bhaṃjayet kṣaṇāt | acintitāni sarvāṇi paṭhanāt siddhimāpnuyāt ||
mahādoṣapraśamanaṃ mahāvyādhi vināśanam | siṃhavyāghra grahabhayaṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam ||
grahapīḍā jalāgnīnāṃ nāśanaṃ devi śāntidam | pūjākāla mahāstotraṃ ye paṭhiṣyanti sādhakāḥ ||
teṣāṃ siddhiṃ na dūrasti devyāḥ saṃtuṣṭidāyakam | yannāsti tanna siddhisyāt kaulike kulasādhake ||
yaṃ yaṃ cintayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ siddhyati nānyathā | satyaṃ satyaṃ mahādevi kaulike tat samāna hi ||
arddharātre samutthāya dīpaprajvalite niśi | paṭhyate stotrametattu sarvaṃ cintita siddhidam ||
puraścaryā vinenaiva stotra mātreṇa siddhyate | maṇḍale pratimāgre vā maṇḍalāgre paṭhed yadi ||
idaṃ mahāstavaṃ proktamacintitārtha siddhidam | nānya devaratānāntu na deyantu kadācana ||
dātavyaṃ bhaktiyuktāya kuladīkṣāratāya ca | anyathā putanāṃ yānti ityājñā pārameśvarī ||
iti śrītridaśaḍāmare pratyaṃgirā devyā mahāstavādhikāram ||
saṃvat (738) thvadaṃ śrī (3) bhavānīśaṃkaraprītina śrīkālīdāsa na saṃcayayāhā || umeśa prīṃtayetantrā kālīdāsena saṃcitam ||
oṃ namaḥ śivāyai ||
śrībhairava uvāca ||
nivasati karavīre sarvadāyā śmasāne vinatajanahitāyā pretarūḍhe maheśo hi makara himaśubhrāṃ paṃcavaktrāmamādyāṃdiśatudaśabhujāyā sā śriyaṃ siddhilakṣmīḥ ||
aiṁ khphreṁ jayajayajagadamba praṇataharihara hiraṇyagarbha pramukha suramukuṭamandāra mālāparimaladati paṭala vacāla caraṇa puṇḍalīkeṣu puṇḍarīkākṣa pramukhakarakambu vimalamaṃdākinī saradendu kuṃdārabindasaṃdoha sundaraśarīraprabhe jayajayamahākālikālanāśinī samayacakra melāpakāśini siddhigaṇayoginī vīravidyādharījana nikaramuninikurumbanī tumbinī kadaṃba kiṃ narairavārādhyamāne karālo vidhāne siddhalakṣmī prade virūpākṣa cakṣusaṃvise vā nandarasadāyike tribhuvananāyike sphuradanarghamaṇimuktabalī kalāpamadhyasthitā cakṣuśravābharaṇa jhaṇajhaṇāyamānataruvallarī vahalaprabhāpaṭalapāṭalīkṛta sakala digmaṇḍalagaṇḍastha lollasita raviśaśikuṇḍale samunnata pīta kaṭhina kuca kalaśa yugalāntanuvālalu |
litanaramuṇḍāvalī maṇḍite caṇḍirudhira pāna pramatte pretakala kalottāla vetālakaratālikā tāṇḍavanatāḍavā pramukhā naṭa ḍākinī cakracaṃkramana cakitavitāya camatkāraṃ visphurita piśāca pralayacitkāradhvani mukharakanavīraśmaśānādhivāsinī rudraskaṃdhāḍhi rūḍhe ṣaḍādhāramadhyārabinda mandirodarākuṃcanonnita prasuptabhujagā gamanāyamāna kulakuṇḍalanī śakti prabhā pradīpikā sukha manāsavalerigamadākāśa śaśimaṇḍalāmṛta dhārādhoraṇī payonidhi gamana mānasairudita hasairakhila sādhakairavivibhāvyate mātrikā cakra saṃbhāvite mṛgāṅka kuṃkumāguru mṛgamadāṃgarāgaparimallavāsitā vāsamaṇimaṇḍape khaṇḍindu maṇḍitorujaṭājalāpakalita karavīrodārakarahāra kanaka ketakī navamālikā tatālikā madayantikā mādhavī vividhagaṃdhabaṃdhuragandhavāha vahaladaruṇasavanācale dhyānākāra cakitatrinayanā cale oṃ jaya jaya jagata janani jaya || khphreṁ jaya jaya eṁ navākṣarī navatyadhika diśatākṣaramantramālādhi daivate kālikātyāyini kāpālini nararudhiravaśāpiśita paripūrṇakapāla karavāla triśūla khaṭvāṃga ghaṇṭāmuṇḍapāśāṃkuśavarābhayaśobhita karesu kare vaddhavīrāsane siddheśvari siddhavidyādharāṃragendra dhyāyamānāṃghri valaye śāmbhavā veśavibhave devadevi mahādevi anākhye umākhye sadāpūrṇimākhye lasattārakākhye akārākṣarodarosphuradambarākāre mahāvyomni vyomavāmeśvarī kubjike kṣecarī gocarī dikcarī śāmbarī śakti cakrakriyecchājñānarūpaguṇātīta nityomṛte nityabhoga prade saṃdhyā navaśānasamaye lāsyalīlāvilāse ṭaṭamahānaṭa jaṭājūṭāpagāri rasadalaṃkāra sakalakāvyakalā kalāpa vahaladhītriguṇa prabaṃdha vividhabaṃdhu sundarakavitā siddhide riddhide buddhide jñānade mānade sārade ṣoḍaśākṣarī ṣaṭtulikalita kusumaparimalamilitamadhukara mukhapurinaparisara vipinamaṇḍalī tāṇḍavitakuṇḍalī vipakṣapakṣa
